raw.description:
SailPoint is the global leader in identity security for cloud enterprises. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less.


We are seeking an experienced, operationally minded Triage Team Manager to lead our India-based Triage Team. This is a fully remote team of five engineers (software engineers and one dedicated DevOps engineer) who sit strategically between Customer Support and Product Engineering.


Note on Role Scope: This is not a customer-facing support manager position, nor is it a software development manager role. Your team does not work in sprints or release new product features. Instead, your mission is to run a high-impact, interrupt-driven technical shield that investigates and resolves complex customer system issues before they require escalation to back-end engineering teams.


The Mission

To lead and transform SailPoint’s 5-person remote India Triage Team into an AI-first operational shield—increasing pre-engineering ticket deflection by 25% and slashing Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) through automated triage pipelines within your first 12 months.


Key Responsibilities

  • Operational Management: Oversee the day-to-day triage, deep-dive investigation, and resolution of complex, cross-system customer issues, shielding backend teams from interruptions.
  • People Leadership: Direct, mentor, and coach a remote team of five technical generalists (engineers and DevOps), supporting their technical development and career growth.
  • Cross-Timezone Collaboration: Partner closely with the North America Triage Team to maintain shared ownership, operational alignment, and seamless handoffs.
  • Organizational Bridge: Serve as a collaborative bridge representing Support and customer needs to Engineering, while translating technical Engineering contexts back to Customer Support and Professional Services.
  • AI & Automation Integration: Champion and direct AI initiatives that reduce repetitive Tier-2 workloads, automate triage workflows, and improve team efficiency.
  • Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Monitor team performance metrics, isolate queue trends, and implement data-driven process improvements.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum of 12+ years of professional experience in software engineering, technical support, DevOps, or technical triage, with at least 3+ years of direct people management experience.
  • Remote Leadership: Proven success managing, coaching, and developing high-performing, distributed technical teams.
  • Triage & Troubleshooting: Strong technical foundation to guide generalist engineers through root-cause analysis, complex investigations, and log diagnostics.
  • AI & API Fundamentals: A basic conceptual understanding of connecting AI models or automated workflows to ticketing and monitoring platforms (e.g., Jira, Slack, Grafana) using REST APIs or webhooks.
  • AI Safety & Privacy: Familiarity with data security, compliance, and access risk management when integrating AI tools and assistants into enterprise pipelines.
  • Interpersonal Excellence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with managers and directors across Support, Engineering, and Professional Services.

What You Will Achieve (Year 1 Milestones)

  • First 30 Days (Audit & Alignment): Map current ticket escalation flows, establish deep 1:1 relationships with your remote engineers, and establish seamless, zero-gap daily handoff protocols with our North America Triage Team to ensure optimal follow-the-sun timezone coverage.
  • First 60 Days (Deflection & Process Optimization): Standardize triage verification and investigation playbooks between Support, Professional Services, and Engineering. Drive process improvements that reduce invalid or premature escalations to Product Engineering by 15%.
  • First 90 Days (AI-First Automation): Guide the team to successfully connect AI assistants and models to our operational pipelines (ticketing platforms, Slack, Grafana) via REST APIs or webhooks. Launch at least two automated workflows (such as automated log summarization or telemetry correlation) with zero data privacy or access control risks.
  • Months 4–12 (Scale & Team Leadership): Drive a 25% increase in total pre-engineering ticket deflection and a 30% reduction in MTTR. Conduct regular career development and coaching, evaluate team staffing needs, and foster a highly collaborative, inclusive, fully remote culture.

About SailPoint India & Employee Benefits (Pune Hub)

Even as a fully remote employee in India, you are connected to our vibrant Pune tech hub and enjoy our comprehensive, market-leading benefits package:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: 100% company-paid medical insurance premiums covering employees and eligible dependents; includes accidental and term life coverage.
  • Preventive Care: Annual company-sponsored health check-ups for employees and discounted diagnostic rates for family members.
  • Financial & Equity Rewards: Competitive base salary, annual performance bonus, and eligibility for equity incentives.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 24 paid annual leaves plus 10 declared public holidays each year.
  • Workplace Flexibility: Fully remote work options with flexible hours designed to accommodate cross-timezone collaboration.
  • Community Connection: Access to our state-of-the-art Pune office campus for collaboration, fully stocked pantries, and regular team celebrations.

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!"

Are you passionate about turning data into action?

We’re seeking an experienced Senior Product Analytics Engineer to join our product organization and help shape the future of SoSafe’s data-informed decision-making. In one of Europe’s fastest-growing cybersecurity scale-ups, you will play a key role in translating complex data into clear insights that directly influence product strategy, user experience, and business growth. You’ll partner closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams to uncover opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure we’re building the right solutions and positioning them effectively for our users and customers.

Location Requirement:

Lisbon, Portugal. Candidates must have work authorization in Portugal and because we follow hybrid working model, they should be based in or open to relocate to Lisbon.

Here's how you'll make a difference:

  • Own product analytics across the different product lines: define, track success metrics and respective targets while ensuring alignment with overall Product and Company strategy.

  • Influence Decision-Making: Use a deep understanding of our product, users, and business to craft compelling data stories that guide product leaders in critical decisions.

  • Build reusable, scalable data products: collaborate with other engineers in developing data products that enable self-service analytics and democratize data access.

  • Build a governed self-service layer: define practices on event instrumentation & taxonomy for our event-driven architecture and self-service analytics tooling and enable Product and GTM peers on event instrumentation and insight generation.

  • Drive Data Literacy: Evangelize the use of data and empower teams to self-serve insights by increasing data literacy through enablement and close partnership.

  • Work AI-native: Continuously evaluate where LLMs and AI tooling can compress your workflow — from query generation to dashboard building to insight synthesis — and apply them deliberately to increase the speed and scope of what you and the team deliver.

  • Work cross-functionally with GTM: connect product usage to commercial outcomes (win/loss, expansion, renewal) and scale repeatable analyses/automations.

What makes you a great fit:

  • 5+ years of experience in an data analytics/ analytics engineering/ data science role, with significant experience directly supporting product teams in B2B companies.

  • Expert in the fundamentals of product analytics including building metric trees, experimentation, user activity & retention analytics, funnels & customer segmentation.

  • Excellent SQL skills, and strong experience using DBT for data transformations. Experience coding in Python is also relevant. Strong experience with data modelling for scale and reusability.

  • Demonstrated experience using current LLM offering to meaningfully improve your own or your team's workflows or results — with concrete examples of what you automated, sped up, or offloaded, and the measurable impact it had.

  • Ability to combine curiosity and ambition with a strategic mindset — continuously seeking better ways to deliver impact, scale insights, and drive business outcomes.

  • Experience working with event-based tracking data for web or mobile, and hands-on experience with a behavioral analytics tool e.g. Amplitude, Heap, MixPanel etc.

  • Ability to communicate findings succinctly and clearly to a wide variety of stakeholders so that they can draw conclusions quickly and make rapid decisions.

  • Relevant experience in cross-functional projects with GTM: proven valuable projects with Customer Success, RevOps or Product Marketing (e.g., churn early-warning, renewal/expansion predictors, win-loss usage mapping).

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample- you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

raw.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is looking for an experienced Retail Media Manager to lead advertising strategy and execution across Amazon (and eventually Walmart and other marketplaces). This is a client-facing role where you’ll serve as a trusted strategic partner and the primary point of contact for your accounts.

You’ll be responsible for managing day-to-day campaign performance, providing insight-driven recommendations, and driving measurable growth for our clients. This position requires deep technical fluency with Amazon Ads, strong communication skills, and the ability to think both strategically and analytically.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop and execute full-funnel Amazon advertising strategies (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) with a focus on ROAS, TACoS, and profitability based on client goals and sales targets.

  • Perform daily and weekly analysis of campaign performance; flag issues early and make proactive optimizations.

  • Build, maintain, and present campaign performance dashboards and reports with clear takeaways and action steps.

  • Conduct competitive audits, category research, and translate macro trends into actionable client strategies.

  • Act as the lead contact for client relationships—owning strategy, campaign execution, and performance conversations.

  • Lead monthly or weekly client calls and performance reviews, driving discussions around investment levels, media strategy, KPIs, and growth opportunities.

  • Communicate technical performance data and marketing metrics to clients in a clear, confident, and structured manner—translating insights into actionable business recommendations.

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Creative and Marketplace Strategy) to ensure cohesive execution across advertising, PDP optimization, and promotions.

  • Stay up to date with Amazon platform changes and retail media innovation; proactively communicate impacts and opportunities to clients.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience managing Amazon Ads with a proven track record of driving growth through paid media.

  • Hands-on experience in client-facing account management and the ability to independently manage client relationships.

  • Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel/Google Sheets capabilities and comfort working with large datasets.

  • Experience using Pacvue for campaign management, bid automation and reportingis a very big plus.

  • Experience with Walmart Connect, Instacart Ads, or other retail media networks is a plus.

  • Confident and clear communicator who can present technical performance metrics in a way clients can understand and act on. Full professional fluency in English required.

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple accounts and priorities on deadline.

  • Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.

Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.


About you and this role


Dow has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Customer Manager with special focus in Dow Construction Chemicals (DCC) business. The preferred locations for this position are Midland, MI, Collegeville, PA, Marietta, GA or Houston, TX, however virtual office in the United States or Canada can be considered.


In this role, you will manage a portfolio of medium to large, complex and geographically diverse customer accounts, with accountability for strengthening customer relationships and delivering profitable growth. You will develop and execute customer strategies, identify and advance growth opportunities, and bring market and customer insights into commercial decisions. Working across DCC and Dow, you will lead customer initiatives and mobilize the organization to deliver differentiated solutions and long-term value.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to strengthen DCC’s position and deliver sustainable growth.
  • Lead complex customer relationships, building strong connections with key decision makers and influencers.
  • Own delivery of account revenue, volume, price, profitability and growth commitments, including recovery actions when performance is off plan.
  • Maintain credible customer-level forecasts and proactively manage opportunities, risks and upside.
  • Develop deep understanding of customer needs, market dynamics and competitive activity, translating insights into commercial actions.
  • Lead customer negotiations and pricing actions to capture value and support long-term customer and business objectives.
  • Lead cross-functional teams across Marketing, Technical Service, Customer Service, Supply Chain and Product Management to deliver customer commitments, advance growth opportunities and resolve business issues.
  • Maintain strong commercial discipline and effectively uses CRM, DSR, CMT and Smart Pricing to manage opportunities, account plans, forecasts and pricing
  • Leverage Dow’s broader portfolio and capabilities to create additional customer value and identify cross-business growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications


  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree or relevant military experience at or above a U.S. E5 or Canadian Petty Officer 2nd Class or Sergeant ranking.
    A minimum of 7 years of relevant working experience, including experience in sales, commercial or customer-facing roles.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%.
  • A minimum requirement for this position is the ability to work legally in the United States or Canada. No visa sponsorship/support is available for this position, including for any type of permanent residency (green card) process.

Preferred Qualifications


  • A degree discipline in business, chemistry or engineering.
  • Demonstrated sales excellence and commercial acumen.
  • Experience managing complex customer relationships and negotiations.
  • Building, construction, infrastructure and/or specialty chemicals experience or knowledge preferred.
  • Experience working across functions to deliver business and customer outcomes.

Skills


  • Negotiation: Prepares and leads customer negotiations by understanding each party’s priorities, identifying areas of agreement and managing conflicting interests. Evaluates trade-offs to reach agreements that capture business value and support longtermcustomer relationships.
  • Action Oriented: Takes initiative, prioritizes opportunities and issues, and follows through on commitments to deliver results.
  • Influence: Builds support for commercial decisions through credibility, a clear value case and an understanding of stakeholder priorities, without relying on authority or coercion
  • Interpersonal Relationships: Builds trusted customer and colleague relationships through active listening, empathy and clear communication, resolving conflict constructively and collaborating effectively
  • Adaptability: Learns quickly and adjusts approaches as customer needs, market conditions and business priorities change
  • Crisis Management: Leads cross-functional teams through unexpected disruptions, aligning priorities, mobilizing resources and communicating clearly to resolve issues and protect customer relationships and business outcomes
  • Business Development: Identifies and advances growth opportunities by connecting customer needs with business capabilities and building relationships that create long-term value.

Additional Notes

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Benefits – What Dow offers you

We invest in you.

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

  • Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
  • Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
  • Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.
    • Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).
  • Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
    • Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.
  • Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
  • Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
  • Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
  • Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
  • Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
  • Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
  • Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
  • On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
  • Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
  • Additionally, some of our locations might offer:
    • Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
    • Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
    • Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.

About Dow
Dow (NYSE: DOW) is one of the world’s leading materials science companies, serving customers in high-growth markets such as packaging, infrastructure, mobility and consumer applications. Our global breadth, asset integration and scale, focused innovation, leading business positions and commitment to sustainability enable us to achieve profitable growth and help deliver a sustainable future. We operate manufacturing sites in 30 countries and employ approximately 36,000 people. Dow delivered sales of approximately $43 billion in 2024. References to Dow or the Company mean Dow Inc. and its subsidiaries. ​​​​Learn more about us and our ambition to be the most innovative, customer-centric, inclusive and sustainable materials science company in the world by visiting.

As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. Job Description: Mathlib Contributor

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Global, Fully Remote
Time Commitment: 15+ hours per week
Schedule: Flexible

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Mathlib contributors with verifiable Lean 4 experience to support an AI training project. You will create formalization tasks, develop machine-checked proofs, evaluate generated Lean code, and establish standards for mathematical correctness.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Create challenging mathematical tasks using Lean 4 and Mathlib.
  2. Convert mathematical requirements into formal definitions, theorem statements, and acceptance criteria.
  3. Write complete, machine-checked reference proofs following Mathlib conventions.
  4. Evaluate AI-generated Lean code for mathematical correctness and technical validity.

Required Qualifications

  1. Demonstrable experience with Lean 4 and Mathlib.
  2. Publicly verifiable contributions, such as merged Mathlib pull requests, GitHub repositories, or formalization projects.
  3. Strong understanding of mathematical proofs and formal verification.
  4. Ability to review Lean code and assess proof correctness.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multiple substantive Mathlib contributions.
  • Experience reviewing or maintaining Lean code.
  • Contributions to mathematical proofs, tactics, infrastructure, documentation, or testing.
  • Research papers or technical projects involving Lean.

Application Process

  1. Submit your application and GitHub username.
  2. Share links to your strongest Mathlib contributions.
  3. Complete an AI interview covering contribution ownership, Mathlib expertise, and programming.
  4. Complete hiring manager review and onboarding if selected.

raw.excerpt: Overview TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.
raw.description:
Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.

The Scrum Master will support Agile delivery across the VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP), working with the Platform, Integration, and Data Management Scrum teams.

This position is responsible for facilitating Scrum ceremonies, coordinating cross-team dependencies, removing impediments, managing sprint execution, and supporting Program Increment (PI) Planning within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.

The VALIP platform supports integration and data exchange across VA supply chain, inventory, financial, and clinical systems. The Scrum Master will collaborate with technical teams working with technologies including InterSystems IRIS for Health, Databricks, and Red Hat OpenShift.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTAassociates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

  • Facilitate daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Support Agile delivery across the VALIP Platform, Integration, and Data Management Scrum teams.
  • Coordinate sprint planning, execution, and delivery commitments with Product Owners and technical teams.
  • Identify and manage dependencies across integrated systems, shared resources, and external teams.
  • Prepare teams for quarterly PI Planning, including capacity planning, feature readiness, dependencies, and risks.
  • Participate in Scrum of Scrums, Agile Release Train (ART) syncs, and other SAFe ceremonies.
  • Coordinate shared testing, architecture, cybersecurity, and configuration management resources.
  • Maintain Jira boards, sprint backlogs, user stories, story points, dashboards, and Agile reports.
  • Monitor team velocity, sprint predictability, cycle time, and carryover to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Identify, track, escalate, and resolve impediments affecting team productivity and delivery.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners and Business Analysts to maintain prioritized and refined backlogs.
  • Ensure backlog items are appropriately defined, estimated, and ready at least two sprints ahead.
  • Manage unplanned work through established intake and prioritization processes.
  • Coordinate with development, testing, security, and release management teams to support release readiness.
  • Ensure deliverables meet established definitions of done, security requirements, testing approvals, and change control processes.
  • Coach Scrum teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum practices, and SAFe methodologies.
  • Promote collaboration, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across assigned teams.

Qualifications

  • Minimum five years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams.
  • SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I) certification.
  • Experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and managing Agile teams through multiple sprint cycles.
  • Experience working within a SAFe Agile Release Train, including participation in at least one PI Planning event.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira boards, sprint planning, dashboards, filters, and Agile reporting.
  • Experience using Confluence or similar collaboration and documentation tools.
  • Experience supporting geographically distributed or fully remote Agile teams.
  • Strong understanding of Scrum principles, Agile methodologies, backlog management, and sprint execution.
  • Experience identifying and resolving impediments and managing cross-team dependencies.
  • Strong communication, organizational, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience collaborating with developers, testers, Product Owners, technical leadership, and customer stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Scrum Master experience supporting enterprise integration, API development, data platforms, or DevSecOps teams.
  • Experience supporting teams that develop and test interfaces using formal Interface Control Documents (ICDs).
  • Experience supporting legacy system modernization, data migration, and platform transition projects.
  • Experience coordinating data migration activities, including cutover planning.
  • Experience supporting federal healthcare IT programs, particularly VA, DHA, CMS, or HHS.
  • Familiarity with InterSystems IRIS for Health, Databricks, Red Hat OpenShift, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release management.
  • Experience coordinating Agile delivery across multiple Scrum teams and shared technical resources.
  • SAFe Advanced Scrum Master (SASM), SAFe Agilist (SA), ICP-ACC, or PMI-ACP certification.
  • Active or recent VA background investigation and identity credential.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA identity credential.

Location:

  • Remote within the United States, subject to VA approval. Occasional travel within the continental United States may be required.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $80,000 to $140,000 annually.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
  • Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.

Allara is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by thousands of women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved health outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

The Opportunity

We're hiring board-certified Internal or Family Medicine Physicians who want to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care to women with complex hormonal and metabolic conditions. This role is ideal for physicians eager to deepen their expertise in women's health. To learn more about our mission and clinical approach, visit.

Location: Fully remote within the U.S.

Your Impact

  • Conduct thorough patient assessments and develop personalized treatment plans via video visits

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary care team to deliver the highest standards of care

  • Complete required trainings and uphold Allara's clinical policies, standards, and best practices

  • Educate patients on preventive care and wellness using evidence-based strategies

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date patient records and complete charting in a timely manner

  • Respond to patient questions and administrative messages with clarity and care

  • Dedicate a minimum of 10-20 patient-facing hours per week, depending on hiring needs, including consultations and medical guidance, with prescribing when clinically appropriate

Primary Clinical Focus

With a willingness to expand expertise across broader women's health care:

  • PCOS, Hypothyroidism / Hashimoto's, Metabolic Syndrome, Menopause / Perimenopause / HRT, PMDD, Obesity / Weight Management, Diabetes, Hyperlipidemia, and Anxiety/Depression (mild to moderate)

Required Qualifications

  • Degree: MD or DO from an accredited institution

  • Board Certification: Active national board certification in Internal or Family Medicine

  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of consecutive clinical experience as an Internal or Family Medicine Physician with a focus on women’s health conditions (see Primary Clinical Focus)

  • Clinical Independence: Proven ability to function as an autonomous provider with strong diagnostic judgment and critical thinking skills

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with an emphasis on compassion and clarity

  • Webside Manner: A natural ability to build trust and connection with patients in a virtual setting

  • Evidence-Based Practice: A genuine commitment to delivering care rooted in current clinical research

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable working across multiple platforms, including EMR systems, text expanders, Gmail, Google Calendar, Zoom, and scheduling tools

  • Telemedicine Experience: Prior telehealth experience is a plus

  • State License Requirements & Hiring Considerations: Active, unrestricted, and unencumbered professional licenses in one or more U.S. state(s) are required, and at least one must be in a state where we currently have an active hiring need. Multistate licensure, or eligibility to license across states through theIMLC, is required.

A note on state licensing: We hire against specific state-level needs that shift on an ongoing basis. All active and pending licenses, including IMLC- eligibility based licensure, are collected, reviewed, and kept on file. We regularly revisit applications as needs expand and when experience, licensure, and role requirements align.

What Allara Offers

  • 1099 Contract: The flexibility and autonomy of an independent contractor arrangement

  • 1099 Longevity Recognition Bonus

  • Competitive Compensation: Per-visit rates plus additional pay for charting, administrative tasks, and other patient-related work

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the U.S.

  • Flexible Scheduling: Set hours that fit your life, not the other way around

  • Malpractice Insurance: Comprehensive coverage provided at no cost to you

  • Mission-Driven Work: Help transform the standard of care for women living with conditions that have historically been underdiagnosed and undertreated

  • Collaborative Provider Network: Connect with and learn from a community of skilled, like-minded Allara clinicians

  • Inclusive Culture: Join a supportive, diverse team that values innovation, equity, and belonging

At Allara, we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against candidates or patients based on race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

raw.title: Head of Growth
raw.excerpt: From the CEO Spikeball is something special.  Every founder thinks their company is special.
raw.description:
From the CEO

Spikeball is something special. Every founder thinks their company is special. But most customers don’t get the logo tattooed, meet their spouse through it, or make lifelong friends and travel the world because of it. Spikeball’s do. I started it in 2007 with family and friends and a simple goal that’s now our mission: to bring people together. Nearly 20 years in, we’ve had some amazing accomplishments that I’m incredibly proud of. There’s a massive opportunity ahead of us, and capturing it will take real work. That’s why this role exists.

Here’s who I’m hoping you are:

  • When you miss, it bothers you. You’re competitive in a way that makes the team better, and a loss makes you hungrier for the next win.
  • You have an unusually high level of drive, and you don’t wait to be told what to do.
  • You bring teams together. Marketing and Sales have been separate for years, and we’re combining them. We need someone who can make that work.
  • You can build a growth strategy, stress-test it, make the call, and change course when it’s not working.
  • You’re a hands-on strategist. Sleeves will be rolled up and your hands will get dirty. If you’re the right person, that excites you.
  • You hold yourself to high standards. We’re a small, efficient, values-driven team, and we hold each other to high standards.
  • You want to talk with our customers and our community. Our brand was built on community, and you’ll build relationships on both the sales and marketing side and let what you learn guide the strategy.
  • You show up with ideas I hadn’t thought of, plus a plan to execute them.
  • Nights and weekends are yours. But like the best people on our team, you’ll glance at Basecamp and email now and then off hours to make sure no one’s waiting on you. You’ll also head to a few tournaments, club meetups, college campuses a year to spend time with and learn from the people who buy and play.

If that sounds like you, I’d love to talk.

— Chris Ruder, Founder & CEO

The opportunity

Spikeball has the brand awareness of a company roughly 20 times our size. Closing the gap between how well-known we are and how big we currently are is the opportunity. That’s what this role is for.

We created a new sport and built a passionate, global community around it. Our distribution is strong: Amazon, Walmart, Target, Dick’s Sporting Goods, Mercado Libre, Scheels, specialty retail, Spikeball.com, and partners across the EU, UK, and AUS/NZ.

We’re looking for a strategic builder who’s always looking for better tools and better ways of working. You’ll own all of Marketing and Sales (wholesale, Amazon, etc). You will build and lead a team that keeps testing new ideas while doubling down on what works, through AI, creators, reach/awareness/consideration efforts, wholesale account management, community, new products, new sales channels, and whatever comes next.

Few growth leaders get to start with a brand people already know and love. The foundation is here. The next chapter is yours to shape.

The role

Your first job: figure out what's constraining Spikeball's growth. Byron Sharp's work shows that brands grow by reaching more buyers, so where are we falling short? Is it awareness (marketing), availability (sales and distribution), or the reasons people buy and come back (product)? Once that decision is made, make that the lead driver, build a two-to-three-year growth strategy around it, and give the other two clear supporting roles. We'll revisit the call as the evidence comes in.

Find the answer

  • Build the evidence base in the first 60 days: channel economics, customer and category data, awareness versus penetration, Category Entry Points (CEPs), product-line performance, and new-market opportunities.
  • Judge each driver on the same criteria: size of prize, time to impact, margin, capability we have or can build, and risk.
  • Run fast, cheap tests where the data can't settle the question.

Build the strategy

  • Name the lead driver and the specific bet within it.
  • Define what each supporting driver does to serve the lead.
  • State what we'll stop doing and what evidence would change the call.
  • Translate the strategy into our EOS 3-Year Picture, 1-Year Plan, Rocks, team design, and budget.

Execute

  • Resource the lead driver first: people, budget, and partners.
  • Put the lead driver's measurables on the weekly scorecard and revisit the call at each quarterly session.
  • Keep supporting drivers in their supporting roles so they don't become competing priorities.

Scorecard

Success is measured by these outcomes. Near-term targets are set together in the first 30 days; the 12-month revenue target comes out of the growth strategy.

First 90 days

  • Deliver a growth diagnosis and strategy to the Leadership Team. It names one lead driver with evidence, defines the supporting role of the other two, and says what we'll stop doing.
  • Audit every vendor, agency, and seat in Marketing and Sales. Recommend keep, change, or cut for each.
  • Review holiday 2026 results across all sales channels, paid social, creators, and TikTok Shop, and fold the learnings into the strategy.
  • Launch the department scorecard and weekly L10.
  • Get the Marketing and Sales org design and hiring plan approved.

First 6 months

  • Make the key hires with limited budget. Every seat has a scorecard and a clear owner.
  • Run a measurable top-of-funnel and creator engine alongside bottom-funnel paid media, using incrementality tests to set the split and decide where paid media should land (Amazon, Retail, Spikeball.com, etc).
  • Work with fractional Wholesale Sales Director and Amazon Leader to build strategy around growing existing accounts, adding new channels and markets online and off.
  • Hit Q1 and Q2 2027 Rocks and have the Summer 2027 peak-season plan in place.
  • Launch the lead driver's first major initiative, with its measurables on the weekly scorecard.

First 12 months

  • Hit the revenue growth target set in the strategy.
  • Hold or improve contribution margin while growing.
  • Show measurable growth from the lead driver against its targets, or bring evidence to change the call.
  • Deliver the Summer 2027 season against plan.
  • Marketing and Sales runs without the Visionary CEO in day-to-day execution.

What this role is not

  • Not a CMO who manages agencies from a distance. You're in the data and the ad accounts, and you run tests yourself when needed.
  • Not a pure sales role. This role is approximately 80% marketing and 20% sales.
  • Not a ROAS optimizer. Bottom-funnel efficiency matters, but the job is identifying and growing demand and capturing it efficiently.
  • Not the brand owner. The Visionary CEO sets the brand vision, and the creative team brings it to life. You own turning the brand into revenue.
  • Not product development or operations. You bring evidence on which products to build and where to sell them. You don't run product design, supply chain, or fulfillment.
  • Not a big-budget, big-headcount role. Lean team, US and overseas talent, AI leverage.
  • Not a caretaker. This seat is for someone who wants to build what’s next, not maintain what exists. Sleeves will be rolled up and you’ll need to be ready to pivot when needed.

Who you are (Must-haves)

  • Has diagnosed the real constraint on a brand's growth, made the call on where to focus, and reallocated people and budget around it, with results to show for it.
  • Built a marketing or growth org from a handful of people into a full department, including hiring leaders.
  • Led a step-change in revenue at an omnichannel consumer products brand.
  • Shipped AI into production workflows (creative, analytics, customer service, or operations), not just pilots.
  • Has managed the creative function, including creative strategy, and can decide how it's best staffed: in-house, fractional, or agency.
  • Commercially and financially fluent: reads a P&L, knows contribution margin by channel, and manages to it and makes it part of the overall strategy.

Strong pluses

  • Amazon expertise and big-box wholesale experience.
  • EOS experience.
  • Launched new product lines or entered new markets, including international.

We'll ask for specific examples with numbers for every must-have.

Our core values:

  • Motivated.
  • Proactive.
  • Collaborative.
  • Challenge the Status Quo.
  • Disciplined.

We take our values seriously. We try to hire, fire and manage by these values. They’re not just hanging in frame in a hallway. We actually don’t have a hallway (we’re remote), but if we did, you wouldn’t find a framed poster of a soaring eagle with our values printed below.

Why work for Spikeball:

  • Autonomy. You are a driven, highly motivated person. You don’t need someone constantly peering over your shoulder. It’s up to you to determine how you will achieve your goals. We’ll support you as much as you want. We will get out of your way so you can do the brilliant things that we know you’re capable of.
  • Help bring people together. That's the mission of the company.
  • We’re a small team, so your efforts will directly impact the entire business.
  • Unlimited PTO plus 13 paid company holidays (work really really hard and relax often).
  • Paid time off for Birthdays (You were born.. life isn’t easy.. you deserve it!)
  • Medical and dental insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield, with multiple plan options. Marriages and domestic partnerships are covered equally.
  • 401(k) through Vanguard with a company match of up to 4% of salary. You’re eligible starting with your first paycheck.
  • Paid parental leave: up to 12 weeks at 100% pay for primary caregivers and up to 6 weeks for secondary caregivers. This covers birth, adoption, surrogacy, and foster placement, plus a phased ramp-back when you return.
  • Competitive compensation, with an annual performance review each fall where you’re considered for raises and promotions.
  • $500 home office stipend (Get what you need to dress up your workspace and be productive)
  • $500 yearly learning stipend for anything that helps you get better.
  • $125 a month phone and fitness reimbursement.
  • Free Spikeball gear
  • Flexible schedule (Want to work out, play Spikeball or hit a yoga class at lunch? Go for it!)

raw.description:
SurrealDB is building a bench of experienced Forward Deployed Engineers for future customer engagements, working inside enterprise customers' engineering teams to design, deploy and scale SurrealDB and SurrealDB Agent Memory in production. You will bring deep expertise in at least one area, such as platform engineering, agentic AI, data engineering or application development, and be keen to broaden your skills across others. Few people have years of SurrealDB or agent memory experience, so we care more about solid engineering habits and how fast you learn than years on a CV. We train and certify every Forward Deployed Engineer before they go to a customer.
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly inside a customer's engineering team, turning architecture into running production systems and leaving their team able to own the platform. You will report to a SurrealDB engineering manager and work closely with our engineering and customer teams.
This role is for engineers based anywhere in the world, including those in the UK or US who are not available for our current engagement. We will contact members of the bench as suitable projects come up.

About the bench
  • Contract engagements, with length, hours and location requirements set for each project
  • Open to engineers globally, subject to location eligibility, which we will confirm early in the process
  • Joining the bench does not guarantee a contract, but you will be pre-approved and among the first we contact when a suitable project comes up
  • Engagements may involve customer-provided equipment, background checks and occasional on-site travel

What you'll be doing

On every engagement, you will:
  • Work hands-on alongside the customer's engineers, from architecture through to go-live
  • Own SurrealDB data modelling in SurrealQL across documents, graph relations and vectors, including query and index tuning
  • Build ingestion and migration pipelines from existing stores such as Cosmos DB, Postgres, MongoDB, vector databases or search services
  • Document architecture decisions, progress and risks for weekly status reporting
  • Contribute to customer architecture and security questionnaires with the SurrealDB team
  • Support knowledge transfer through pair programming, reviews, workshops, runbooks and reference material for future engagements
Depending on the engagement and your strengths, you may also focus on areas such as:
  • Platform and infrastructure: standing up SurrealDB and Agent Memory environments on the customer's cloud or SurrealDB Cloud, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, backup, upgrades and security reviews
  • Agentic AI: agent memory implementation, retrieval design, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails
  • Data engineering and migration: designing pipelines, migrating from existing databases and search services, and data quality at scale
  • Search and retrieval: vector, full-text and hybrid search, relevance tuning and performance optimisation
  • Application development: integrating SurrealDB into customer applications and services using our SDKs and APIs
  • Performance and reliability: load testing, query and index tuning, capacity planning and production readiness

About you

  • Proven experience delivering agentic AI systems, cloud data platforms, or both, in production
  • Experience in database work beyond basic CRUD: data modelling, indexes, query plans and migrations
  • Proven experience running services on at least one major cloud: AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Working knowledge of at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go or Rust
  • Ability to explain technical decisions clearly to customer engineers, architects, security teams and stakeholders
  • Comfortable working embedded in a customer or client engineering team
  • Open to contract engagements, with hours, length and location set for each project
You will also bring deep expertise in at least one specialist area, for example:
  • Platform engineering, with containers, Kubernetes and infrastructure as code (Terraform, OpenTofu or Pulumi)
  • Agentic AI, with agent memory, agent frameworks, retrieval (RAG) and evaluation workflows
  • Data engineering, with large-scale pipelines and database migrations
  • Search and retrieval, with vector, full-text or hybrid search systems
  • Backend or application development, building production services in Python, TypeScript, Go or Rust
Strong plus
  • Hands-on experience deploying or integrating an agent memory tool, such as Mem0, Graphiti or Zep, Letta, LangMem or Cognee (a personal or open-source project counts)
  • Familiarity with SurrealDB, PostgreSQL, Azure (AKS, Entra ID, Key Vault), observability stacks or regulated environments
  • Previous experience working as a contractor or consultant
  • Community contributors and SurrealDB Ambassadors are very welcome to apply
What you will learn
  • In-depth SurrealDB and SurrealDB Agent Memory, certified by our engineering team
  • How enterprise teams take data and AI systems from pilot to production
  • A pathway into future SurrealDB engagements and roles
We understand that each candidate brings a unique set of skills and experiences, and we encourage applicants to apply even if you do not meet every qualification listed in the job description.

About Capitol Lien

Capitol Lien is a dynamic, fast-growing public records research company that provides due diligence for a wide range of industries. We are committed to delivering innovative solutions to our clients, fostering a collaborative work environment, and driving continuous growth. As we grow, we seek a Business Development Specialist to join our team and lead strategic partnerships, drive marketing initiatives, and bring sales to record-breaking success.

Role Overview

We seek a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in the Company’s growth by identifying new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, and developing strategies to augment our market presence. This position requires strategic thinking, excellent communication skills, and a passion for driving results. Frequent travel throughout the United States to trade shows, conferences, and conventions is a requirement- up to 30%+ travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Market Research and Analysis:

raw.excerpt: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know?
raw.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

The Associate Director, Digital Analytics & Data Integration is the global owner of how we measure digital performance, connect data across our digital ecosystem, and ensure customer and marketing data is used responsibly.


In this role, you will set the digital measurement strategy, lead the evolution and governance of our analytics platforms, and establish the data and reporting standards that create a consistent view of digital performance across the organization. You will connect digital activity to business outcomes, including customer experience, adoption, and revenue, while enabling teams to access trusted insights more independently.


You will also help establish how we use AI within digital analytics, building the roadmap for connecting analytics platforms and enterprise AI capabilities to create more scalable, self-service access to digital data and insights.


This is a highly cross-functional leadership role that partners with Marketing, Commercial Operations, regional teams, IT, Security, Legal, and other functions to establish global standards, drive adoption, and continually evolve our digital analytics capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

Digital measurement, insights & reporting

  • Define and maintain the global KPI and measurement framework for digital programs, aligning stakeholders on the metrics that matter most.
  • Own the digital analytics roadmap and establish standards for measurement across platforms, regions, and functions.
  • Translate digital performance into actionable insights tied to business outcomes such as customer experience, adoption, and revenue.
  • Develop enterprise dashboards and standardized reporting that provide leadership and teams with a consistent view of digital performance.
  • Identify gaps in measurement, reporting, and data collection and lead efforts to resolve them.

AI & self-service analytics

  • Define and lead the roadmap for incorporating AI into our digital analytics practice, prioritizing high-value use cases and scaling capabilities over time.
  • Partner with IT, Security, Legal, and other teams to connect digital analytics data with approved enterprise AI capabilities and establish appropriate governance.
  • Develop self-service analytics capabilities that enable teams to access trusted digital data and answer common business questions independently.
  • Establish standards for AI-enabled analytics, including metric definitions, data quality, access, privacy, and responsible use.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled analytics through education, enablement, and ongoing evolution of the capability.

Analytics platforms & governance

  • Serve as the global business owner for digital analytics and behavior analytics capabilities, including platforms such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, ContentSquare, and associated tag management tools.
  • Define the operating model, implementation standards, governance, and data-layer requirements that enable consistent measurement across our digital ecosystem.
  • Evaluate emerging analytics capabilities and platforms and recommend where to adopt, consolidate, or evolve our technology landscape.
  • Partner across technical and business teams to maintain data quality, platform reliability, and consistent measurement as technologies evolve.

Data integration & governance

  • Define how digital analytics data connects with our broader ecosystem, including data platforms, CRM, eCommerce, personalization, and customer experience technologies.
  • Partner with technical teams to improve data flows, reduce manual workarounds, and increase consistency across systems.
  • Establish standards for data quality, documentation, ownership, and monitoring across critical digital data flows.
  • Partner with Legal, Security, and technology teams to ensure customer and marketing data practices meet applicable privacy, consent, and security requirements.

Global adoption & enablement

  • Drive adoption of digital analytics capabilities and standards across global Marketing, regional teams, Commercial Operations, and other key functions.
  • Develop scalable training, playbooks, and onboarding that enable teams to use analytics tools and data effectively.
  • Partner with regional and functional leaders to embed common measurement and data standards into how teams operate.
  • Monitor adoption and data quality, identify areas of inconsistency, and lead improvements across the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 15 years of related experience
  • Significant experience with enterprise digital analytics platforms such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics, including tag management and data-layer concepts.
  • Experience integrating digital analytics data with enterprise systems such as data warehouses, CRM, eCommerce, or personalization platforms.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reporting frameworks, and insights for senior business audiences.
  • Experience using AI or emerging technologies to improve analytics, data access, or business decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of privacy, consent, and data governance requirements, including GDPR and CCPA.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish strategy, governance, standards, and roadmaps across complex organizations.
  • Experience driving adoption of tools, processes, or standards across multiple regions or business functions.
  • Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts and data into clear business recommendations.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and operate independently in a global environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing AI-enabled analytics or self-service data capabilities.
  • Experience with both Adobe and Google analytics ecosystems.
  • Experience with data visualization platforms such as Tableau and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Experience with personalization, experience optimization, or behavior analytics platforms such as Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Manager, or ContentSquare.
  • Experience with Salesforce and eCommerce data ecosystems.
  • Experience evaluating, implementing, or consolidating enterprise analytics platforms.
  • Experience working in a global, regulated, or B2B organization.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic leadership and ownership
  • Digital analytics and data fluency
  • Curiosity and fluency with AI and emerging technologies
  • Change leadership and adoption
  • Independent judgment and decision-making
  • Executive communication
  • Cross-functional and cross-regional influence
  • Strong focus on data quality and governance

raw.excerpt: Join Hamilton Lane, a global leader in private markets, as we scale to meet the demands of our growing client base.
raw.description:
Join Hamilton Lane, a global leader in private markets, as we scale to meet the demands of our growing client base. Here, you’ll work with ambitious, high‑performing teams built on integrity, candor and collaboration, backed by our market-leading data and technology. We invest heavily in our people and our partners, giving you the platform to enrich lives, safeguard futures and grow your career.

What We Do
As one of the largest private markets investment firms globally, we provide innovative solutions to institutional and private wealth investors around the world, specializing in flexibility and full-spectrum access. We currently employ approximately 800 professionals operating in offices throughout North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East, and have $1.0 trillion in assets under management and supervision, composed of $146.1 billion in discretionary assets and $871.5 billion in non-discretionary assets, as of December 31, 2025.

We are seeking an experienced Insurance Strategist for our Global Client Solutions team. In coordination with the client solutions leads, the Insurance Strategist will develop a strategic sales plan for the insurance market initially in the U.S. followed by a global approach. The candidate will work closely with our investment teams to design and develop product focused for the insurance space.

Along with serving as a liaison between client solutions and investments, the Insurance Strategist will join the client solutions leads in being responsible for serving, helping to retain and expand partnerships with our current insurance relationships. The candidate will partner with the Client Solutions regional leaders to help build relationships, deepen trust, and develop new business with Chief Investment Officers, Chief Financial Officers, Chief Risk Officers, and their staffs. This includes a focus on the design, communication, and delivery of a range of services, solutions/analytics and capabilities. The Insurance Strategist will help set the strategic direction for engagements with Life, P&C, Health and multi-line insurers across our strategies.

Team and Position Description

The Insurance Strategist partners with both investments and distribution to promote and drive the growth of our Insurance business. Key deliverables include:

  • Developing innovative portfolio solutions recommendations across our investment strategies to meet the needs of insurers. Provide strategic asset allocation advice and market updates to clients and prospects
  • Providing portfolio, asset class, and security level optimization using regulatory capital, accounting, and economic capital models
  • Identifying product and platform focus areas for the client solutions team by providing key insights into the relative value and attractiveness of asset classes, providing periodic sales training, and helping to align our services with needs of global insurance companies
  • Providing expert support in client/prospect meetings to advance opportunities for single mandate and strategic partnerships
  • Detailed analysis of insurance companies and their peer set. Utilize insurance databases and work with the sales team to identify opportunities and develop target lists
  • Knowledge of asset class structuring and how to most efficiently structure insurance sensitive portfolios
  • Maintaining expertise in and providing updates on industry regulation which impacts our clients and our services
  • Building our brand with insurers globally through thought leadership, digital presence, and other promotional materials for papers, sponsored conferences, and events

Role Success Factors

As an external-facing member of our Global Client Solutions team, critical responsibilities include liaising between distribution and investments and serving as a markets, regulatory, and portfolio expert to our clients and prospects. The Insurance Strategist will also support the development/knowledge sharing, strategy development, and new product development. To support our growth goals in the Insurance space, success in the role will be tied to:

  • Engagements leading to growth in our insurance clients (breadth/number of clients, depth of services for each, growth of existing clients focused primarily on the general account space)
  • Development of new products and solutions for Insurance clients.
  • Brand building of Hamilton Lane as a leader in the Insurance private markets management space through development and communication of thought leadership, market commentary and recommendations, presentations at conferences and events, and positioning
  • Building Trust with internal clients, especially with Global client solutions teams, investments and client operations
  • Evaluating portfolios, analyzing constraints/accounting/regulatory/ALM impacts and developing and communicating solutions. This includes investment policy recommendations, customizing investment strategy, evaluating guidelines and monitoring investments
  • Proactive time management and focus on highest probability of success and value-added activities

Job Qualifications & Key Attributes of the ideal candidate:

  • Courage to demonstrate unquestioned integrity and support for Hamilton Lane values. Thrives in a culture of candor, admits when they don’t have the answer, and seeks new perspectives. Values collaboration across all levels.
  • Ability to build trust through credibility, reliability, intimacy, and a focus on our clients
  • Bias towards action and execution with willingness to take calculated risks, ask questions, and remain accountable for results
  • Concise and intuitive in both written and spoken language. Adept at synthesis to tell a story and arrive at a compelling conclusion
  • Strong investment acumen, especially in Private Alternatives
  • Technical experience/fluency in portfolio management, risk management, or credit analysis. Experience analyzing and presenting insurance specific needs such as Risk Based Capital constraints, regulatory/NAIC frameworks, accounting/reporting requirements
  • Five or more years of successful Insurance related GA asset management or a role working directly or indirectly with insurers. Experience as an Insurance or in insurance client service or product marketing is a plus
  • Location in suburban Philadelphia headquarters is preferred but willing to entertain other locations and remote work options
  • Willingness to travel in North America and globally as required to meet internal and external client needs. 20-40% traveling globally, especially in the US.
  • Bachelor’s degree. MBA and/or CFA, FSA, CAIA, etc. is preferred.

Benefits

At Hamilton Lane, our benefits philosophy is simple: to provide our employees with a competitive suite of benefits and services to help navigate through the complexities and challenges of working, living, raising a family, and eventually retiring. To do this, Hamilton Lane offers the following benefits:


Enhancing Your Physical and Emotional Health

Employees have access to healthcare coverage, mental health resources, health & fitness reimbursement program, and Wellness Rewards Program.


Developing Your Career

Tuition and certification reimbursement programs are available, along with continual education and development trainings for you to grow with Hamilton Lane.


Supporting Your Family & Community

For our communities, Hamilton Lane provides paid time off to volunteer and compensates for referring qualified candidates that join our team.

For growing family, we offer an adoption reimbursement program, paid time off for new parents and newlyweds, and provide travel support for nursing parents.


Safeguarding Your Financial Wellbeing

Hamilton Lane contributes to retirement programs and offers an employee stock purchasing plan.

Com mais de 26 mil colaboradores, a Cogna reúne pessoas com diferentes trajetórias, experiências e perspectivas para construir uma cultura em que a colaboração fortalece o aprendizado, amplia a inovação e contribui para melhores decisões. É dessa pluralidade que nasce Uma Só Cogna, conectando pessoas, negócios e competências em torno de um propósito comum.

Como Analista Senior de Insights, você fará parte da estrutura de Business Intelligence, atuando de forma estratégica e colaborativa com os times de Mídia, CRM e Negócios. Sua missão será transformar dados em informações relevantes, gerando insights que contribuam para a tomada de decisão e a evolução das estratégias de marketing digital e performance.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

• Desenvolver, manter e otimizar dashboards em Power BI, garantindo visualizações claras, objetivas e atualizadas;
• Realizar análises AdHoc de forma proativa e sob demanda, identificando oportunidades e tendências que suportem os objetivos de negócio;
• Garantir a integridade, consistência e disponibilidade dos dados utilizados nos relatórios e análises;
• Realizar consultas e manipulações em bancos de dados utilizando SQL para construção de datasets e extração de informações relevantes;
• Apoiar os times de Mídia, CRM e Negócios com insights que contribuam para o aprimoramento de campanhas, jornadas e iniciativas comerciais;
• Participar de rituais de alinhamento com stakeholders para entender necessidades, levantar hipóteses e propor soluções analíticas;
• Documentar e versionar entregas e análises de forma organizada e acessível aos times envolvidos.

Diferenciais:
• Conhecimento prévio em plataformas de mídia digital (Google Ads, Meta Ads, DV360, entre outras);
• Familiaridade com ferramentas e estratégias de CRM (como Salesforce, RD Station, etc);
• Experiência ou conhecimento com Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e mensuração de performance digital.Requisitos obrigatórios:
• Experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de dashboards no Power BI, incluindo modelagem de dados e uso de DAX;
• Domínio em SQL para consulta e manipulação de dados em bancos relacionais (ex: BigQuery, SQL Server, MySQL);
• Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e transformar informações em recomendações práticas;
• Experiência com análise de performance em contextos de marketing, CRM ou negócios digitais;
• Habilidade de comunicação para apresentar insights de forma clara e direcionada aos diferentes públicos internos;
• Organização e autonomia para condução de demandas simultâneas e gestão de prioridades.

Diferenciais:
• Vivência com plataformas de mídia digital (Google Ads, Meta Ads, DV360 etc.);
• Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM e automação de marketing (Salesforce, RD Station, etc.);
• Experiência com Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e entendimento de métricas de comportamento digital;
• Noções de Python voltadas para automação de análises ou tratamento de dados.

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.
