raw.excerpt: You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact.
raw.description:
You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact.

If you dream of a life that is more like an adventure than a stable life, then becoming the AI-native right hand of our CEO is for you.

This isn’t another chief of staff or right hand job.

Most companies call themselves AI-first because they gave everyone a ChatGPT licence. We think that’s level 2, and there are 10.

At Paradox our ambition is $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. Here, AI doesn’t assist the work. It runs the loops, in every department. Your job is to make that true for the whole company, side by side with the CEO.

But wait a minute.

Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…

  • 🗽Freedom: working remotely or hybrid, and being trusted to deliver

  • 🔥Ambition: building one of the first truly AI-native companies, with teammates who push AI to its limits every week

  • 😍Impact: changing the trajectory of a whole company, not one line of a roadmap, with a product that transforms people’s lives at scale

Then, you have found the next adventure that will fulfill you.

WHAT AI-NATIVE MEANS AT PARADOX 🤖

In a company of fewer than 10 people, the right hand used to be the person who absorbed everything the CEO couldn’t do. Here, the right hand builds the machine that does it.

Our company has to be able to:

  1. Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, decisions, procedures, member stories and past experiments, in one shared company brain that every person and every agent reads before acting.

  2. Turn every decision into execution. A meeting, a voice note or a call with the CEO becomes briefs, tickets, follow-ups and deadlines, without anyone retyping it.

  3. Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: agents read and write in our whole stack, from code to CRM, billing, analytics, ads, email, calendar and documents.

  4. Ship. Produce the analysis, the contract draft, the page, the offer or the process, and put it live.

  5. Measure with real KPIs. Revenue, cash, margin, retention and the transformation of our members, not activity.

  6. Learn and loop on its own. Keep what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

People set the ambition, the taste and the standards. The machine runs the loop, and gets better every week.

This is already real. Our company brain holds our decisions and procedures. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment with its result. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars and audit our tracking after every live. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day, by text and by voice.

But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY? 😉

We believe self-help is broken. Most people use learning platforms the same way: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

They deserve more than content and more than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges and grows with them.

That’s why we merge:

  • Human Intelligence (coaches, peers and mentors)

  • Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)

  • Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

into one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS, the Operating System for Human Greatness, augmented with AI.

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world, and for something that will outlive any individual, its founder included.

Here’s the bet: A small team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

And that’s where you come in.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company.

Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches.

The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls. With fewer than 10 people, there is no department to hand things to. You build it.

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

1 - Be the CEO’s operating system

  • ❌The old way: a chief of staff takes notes in meetings, chases people by email and builds the weekly report by hand.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every CEO decision into execution. Meetings, voice notes and calls become briefs, tickets and follow-ups. Every Monday, the CEO gets one brief: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs his call.

  • You decide what the CEO must see and what he never needs to see again. His time goes to vision, product and members, not to coordination.

2 - Run strategic projects as a Pirate Squad of one, plus agents

Depending on your zone of genius, these are examples of strategic projects you could own:

  • Growth: run experiments with agents that generate, ship and measure them

  • Partnerships & sponsorships: find and close partners aligned with our brand, for our YouTube channel and events

  • International: build the machine that turns our French content into English, and open new countries

  • Launches: take a new offer or product from idea to live

  • People: find and assess the rare people who join a team of fewer than 10

  • ❌The old way: each new initiative needs a team, a roadmap and three months.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: one person with the right agents launches an offer, a channel or a country without disrupting the core. That’s what our Pirate Squad means now.

3 - Build AI-native operations

  • ❌The old way: an ops manager processes invoices, chases contracts, onboards people and answers the same support questions every week.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: finance, legal, HR, admin and customer support each get their agents, their context, their KPIs and their loop. You write the skills, plug them into our tools and write the evals that define "good": a reconciliation that matches to the cent, a contract that respects our playbook, an answer a member is happy with.

  • You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. An agent moves up a level only when its track record earns it.

  • Example: in your first month, you build the agent that reconciles payments, refunds and failed charges every night. In month one it only reports. By month three it fixes the simple cases alone, and you only see the exceptions.

4 - Strategy and business intelligence that check themselves

  • ❌The old way: someone builds dashboards in a BI tool, exports them to a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody fully trusts the numbers.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: agents watch revenue, cash, acquisition, retention, churn and competitors continuously, find where our sources disagree, and explain what changed and why.

  • Strategy: screen markets and competition, build growth models, explore business models, partnerships and acquisitions. Then challenge, formalize and ensure good execution of the strategy.

  • At Paradox things move fast, and our CEO is always reading business books and meeting great entrepreneurs. You’ll turn the best strategies and tactics into systems and agents the whole company uses.

5 - Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul

  • ❌The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: every decision, result and lesson goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before acting. The company never learns the same lesson twice.

  • You measure the machine itself: the share of work done without a human, the time from decision to execution, the agents that moved up an autonomy level this month, and revenue per person. You push those numbers up.

  • You help the team become AI-native too: you spot the work still done by hand, and you build the agent or show a teammate how to build it.

  • And always: our members trust us with their lives. No fake claims, no fake scarcity, data handled with care. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. People do.

How you’ll know you’re AI-native: you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. The company’s output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF? 😍

Experience

  • Top tier Business or Engineering School (HEC, ESSEC, INSEAD, EM Lyon, EDHEC, ESCP, Stanford, …) or other high-level academic training (Les Mines, X, Sciences Po Paris, etc.)

  • A wide-scope role behind you: founder, chief of staff, founder’s associate, strategy, consulting or operations in a fast-growing startup

  • You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, agent SDKs, MCP, automations, APIs, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

Traits

  • Driven with strong work ethic: this position requires a strong commitment and perseverance

  • Entrepreneurship spirit: able to own a project from scratch, with few resources and little guidance, doing a lot yourself

  • Builder, not coordinator: you’d rather build the agent than chase a person twice

  • Taste: you know the difference between an output that works and one that is great, and you hold agents to the second

  • Growth over ego: you are at ease with regular feedback, obsessed with learning and growing, able to put your ego aside

  • Analytical and system thinker: you quickly identify and formulate problems, and solve complex ones with data

  • Excels in communication: both written and verbal

Language

French: native or bilingual. English: fluent, you can hold a detailed conversation with English-speaking colleagues. Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

  • We are inspired by a culture of performance and ambition. Everything is fast-paced and there is a lot of change. You won’t always be told what to do or how to do it.

  • We tell each other things, even if they are uncomfortable. We value growth over ego. At Paradox, expressing disagreement to a manager and knowing how to debate is valued! We encourage critical and strategic thinking.

  • ❌ If you use AI for first drafts but your way of working looks the same as two years ago: wrong role.

  • ❌ If you want to manage a lot of people: we aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each managing a dozen agents.

  • ❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If all this makes sense with you, then we’ll love working with you (and you with us, you’ll be pampered!)

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Build one of the first truly AI-native companies from inside the CEO’s office, and write the playbook others will copy. You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

A work with Impact, Freedom and Ambition

Growth & Ambition 🚀

  • 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform, whilst being in a good mood

  • 🏋️‍♀️No more bosses, but ongoing conversations to support your growth

  • ⚡️Learning to build with AI faster than almost anywhere else

Impact & Meaning 🔥

  • 🦄Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products are used by millions of people

We are hiring a Sr. Business Analyst to join our Medicare Advantage Enrollment & Billing team at BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee!

In this role, you will support complex operational initiatives, system enhancements, regulatory requirements, and process improvements within a highly regulated Medicare Advantage environment. You’ll partner closely with Enrollment & Billing, third-party vendors, Enterprise Information Technology, and other business teams to investigate complex issues, analyze data and processes, develop business requirements, coordinate testing and implementations, and validate that solutions are working as expected. This is an opportunity to take ownership of issues from identification through resolution while helping improve operational accuracy, efficiency, compliance, and the member experience.

Ideal candidates for the role will bring:

  • Experience working with Medicare Advantage Enrollment & Billing or within a similarly complex, highly regulated CMS environment
  • Strong experience investigating operational and system issues, identifying root causes, and following problems through resolution
  • Experience developing business requirements and supporting testing, implementation, validation, and defect resolution
  • Strong data analysis skills, including experience using data to identify trends, discrepancies, and operational gaps

Note:

raw.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Solutions Consultant - Senior Principal, NA ENT

Why We Have This Role

Our pre-sales team helps some of the largest organizations in the world find and close experience gaps with the Qualtrics XM Data & AI Platform, which combines experience management (XM) data with artificial intelligence (AI) to predict what comes next and act on it.

As a Solutions Consultant in our Financial Services and Insurance (FSI) business, you will partner with Sales Teams on opportunities across banking, insurance, wealth and asset management, and payments. You bring the product skills to show what the platform can do and the strategic perspective to help business leaders decide what to do with it. In an industry shaped by regulation, rising customer expectations, digital disruption and retention pressure, you will connect XM and AI to outcomes FSI leaders care about, such as customer loyalty, advisor and agent effectiveness, claims and servicing quality, and operational risk.

While most of your efforts will be focused in the pre-sales environment, some additional cross-functional initiatives may include input in product direction, content generation, contributing to analyst reports/relationships and attending marketing events.

You will report to a Solution Consulting Manager.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Earning trust with Account Executives as their go-to partner on deal strategy and execution in FSI accounts.
  • Becoming a trusted advisor to customer business and technology leaders, helping them build their XM vision and a roadmap toward the art of the possible.
  • Building and delivering compelling product demonstrations that show the value of Qualtrics in the context of FSI use cases and workflows.
  • Winning the technical decision and the business case on enterprise deals with multiple stakeholders.
  • Contributing to team outcomes, including win rate, pipeline, net new annual recurring revenue (ARR) and customer satisfaction.
  • Sharing what works and helping your peers grow.

How You’ll Grow

  • Learn the full XM platform, including customer experience, employee experience and market research, and the AI capabilities that connect them.
  • Build deep FSI expertise across banking, insurance, wealth management and payments, including the regulatory, security and data considerations that shape buying decisions.
  • Deepen your expertise in AI and data and shape how FSI customers apply them to business outcomes.
  • Build influence with Product and Marketing by bringing field insight into product direction and go-to-market strategy.
  • Grow your career through a structured promotion process, career action planning with your manager, and internal mobility (Qmobility).
  • As we build an AI-first company and change the market for Experience Management, you will be at the cutting edge of this transformation in enterprise software.

Things You’ll Do

  • Partner with account executives on deal strategy and account planning for FSI opportunities.
  • Contribute to discovery by owning technical discovery, uncovering business challenges and tying them to measurable outcomes.
  • Design, build and deliver tailored use case solutions and demonstrations, including FSI scenarios such as digital banking journeys, contact center and voice of the customer programs, claims and policy experiences, advisor and agent feedback, and employee engagement.
  • Build business cases and value stories that translate product capabilities into value drivers for FSI buyers, connecting XM and AI to revenue, cost and risk.
  • Facilitate executive briefings and workshops that help customers shape their XM vision and roadmap.
  • Advise customers on XM program design and governance, including use-case prioritization, data sources, closed-loop action, a phased maturity roadmap, program ownership, operating model and regulatory considerations specific to financial services.
  • Answer technical questions on architecture, integrations, APIs, security, privacy and data, including the questions FSI security and compliance teams ask.
  • Position Qualtrics against competitors on both product strengths and business value.
  • Support expansion with existing FSI customers by identifying new use cases across business lines and XM areas, including customer, employee and market research.
  • Share customer and field feedback with Product Management, Marketing and Engineering, contribute to content, events and enablement, and stay current on FSI industry trends, regulation and competitor moves.

Required Qualifications

  • 5 or more years in pre-sales, solutions engineering, solution architecture, consulting or another customer-facing technical or strategic role at a business-to-business (B2B) software as a service (SaaS) company, or as a practitioner leading customer, employee or research programs.
  • Experience supporting sales cycles both strategically and technically with director, vice president and C-level buyers.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the drive to configure, build and deliver software demonstrations tailored to a customer's needs.
  • Ability to explain and resolve common technical aspects of SaaS software, including security, API protocols and integrations, and SLAs.
  • Experience building a business case or value story that ties a solution to measurable outcomes.
  • Working understanding of AI and data-driven solutions.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication, including presenting to executives.
  • Ability to explain industry trends and complex concepts, including regulatory and market shifts in financial services, clearly to business audiences who are not subject matter experts.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the initiative to pivot as needs change.
  • Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics, psychology, computer science, information systems, a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling to or working with financial services or insurance organizations, such as banks, credit unions, insurers, wealth and asset managers, or payments companies.
  • Familiarity with FSI regulatory, security and data privacy expectations and how they affect software buying decisions.
  • Experience with Customer or Employee Experience software or programs, including contact centers and voice of the customer.
  • Experience consulting on the design and implementation of Employee or Customer Experience Management (XM) programs, or working with enterprise CX, EX or research teams at large organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with AI and large language models in a customer-facing setting, including using AI tools to improve how you sell and go to market.
  • Knowledge of survey design, change management, or quantitative and qualitative data analysis.
  • Experience reading and debugging HTML, CSS, JavaScript or SQL, with the support of AI tools

What You Should Know About This Team

  • We play a critical role in the commercial engine, driving innovation and market penetration through direct work with customer decision makers and scaling our expertise across the field.
  • Our team values initiative and independence. Everyone is encouraged to think ahead, anticipate potential issues and solve them proactively.
  • We are known for our collaborative spirit, a strong desire to learn and, most importantly, a commitment to our customers’ success. We help Sales and Qualtrics hit their targets by building customer confidence and demonstrating the value of our technology. We are comfortable in a fast-changing environment, and creativity is often our best tool.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Pension plan match
  • We offer private dental and health insurance
  • Wellness reimbursement - up to the value of $300 per quarter can be reimbursed for a variety of wellness activities

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:Family & Medical Leave Act, Equal Opportunity Employment, Employee Polygraph Protection Act
Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics - upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam - we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info - so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.

description: Are you passionate about being part of a team at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales that delivers extraordinary care to help individuals and businesses prepare for and protect their future?

raw.title: Specialist, Life Underwriter
raw.excerpt: Are you passionate about being part of a team at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales that delivers extraordinary care to help individuals and businesses prepare for and protect their future?
raw.description:
Are you passionate about being part of a team at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales that delivers extraordinary care to help individuals and businesses prepare for and protect their future? If so, then Nationwide Financial could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Join Nationwide’s Life Underwriting team as a Specialist supporting our Hantz Financial partnership. In this role, you’ll apply your life underwriting experience and critical-thinking skills to evaluate cases, weigh available information, and make sound, well-supported risk decisions. You’ll partner with underwriting colleagues and business contacts to deliver responsive service in a relationship-focused business with repeat customers and complex coverage needs, including survivorship cases. Success in this role calls for strong judgment, attention to service expectations, and the ability to manage your work independently from review through decision.


This role is open to fully remote work.


This role does not qualify for employer sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT extension program.


Job Description Summary

Our underwriters work hard to provide the exceptional customer experience for which Nationwide is known. Actively engaging with our firms and financial professionals to get to know their clients and their needs builds our understanding of the market, what is needed to win business and put our best offer out first.

If you thrive working autonomously, making decisions on a variety of impactful issues and continuing to learn and adapt to grow, we want to know more about you!

As a Senior Life Underwriting Specialist, you'll analyze, select and classify applications for life insurance of a more complex nature according to established underwriting policies, practices and standards. You'll coordinate life insurance selection standards according to underwriting practices and procedures to achieve satisfactory mortality and morbidity experience and acceptable administrative results. We'll count on you to use independent judgment based on your underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. You will also likely serve as a referral point for less experienced underwriters and will often have cross distributional experience. You may also represent your distribution on underwriting related projects.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Receives, evaluates and underwrites, on a medical or non-medical basis more complex applications for life insurance up to their maximum handling limit as approved by the Chief Underwriter. Protects the confidentiality of documentation and information acquired throughout the underwriting process. Works independently, but engages referral points, mentors and staff underwriting and medical staff for complex issues and cases.

  • Maintains in-depth knowledge of manuals, underwriting materials, rules, regulations, procedures medical factors and practices impacting mortality and morbidity underwriting. Maintains proven understanding of all underwriting administrative systems to conduct business and provides outstanding service to all internal and external customers and field partners.

  • Evaluates and accesses applications requiring additional evidence of insurability. Determines the need for and authorizes the ordering of, underwriting requirements to include, but not limited to, medical examinations, blood profiles, home office specimens, attending physician reports, inspection reports, client direct interviews, and other essential information.

  • Develops a strong understanding of the accelerated underwriting process and can apply risk-based decision-making skills to determine the appropriate requirements needed to provide protective value as well as determining appropriate risk class. This may include but not limited to, making fluid-less underwriting decisions as well as the utilization of alternative sources of medical information while maintaining appropriate tolerance for accepting risk.

  • Consults with other underwriters and accepts referred cases when designated. Suggests innovative solutions, motivates team performance and facilitates open communication to achieve results.

  • Evaluates, appraises and quantifies data derived from personal or business financial information and establishes insurable interest in keeping with the principle of indemnification. Assists with training other team members in this area

  • Reaches terms on and coordinates both automatic and facultative reinsurance within the contractual terms and conditions of Nationwide's various reinsurance treaties and product and market practices.

  • Meets and presents with field partners as needed. Acquires input and feedback during these visits to build a better understanding of partner needs and expectations.

  • Determines eligibility for temporary insurance and authorizes disbursement of policy refunds if the Temporary Insurance Agreement (TIA)is not eligible. Also authorizes reimbursement for medical records or other fees associated with requirements needed to confirm evidence of insurability.

  • Interprets electrocardiogram tracings received as evidence for life insurance applications. Consults with Medical Director on cases where physician input is required.

  • Consults with Chief Underwriter, Staff Underwriting, Underwriting Consultants, Senior Underwriters and the Medical Director as the need arises.

  • Supports and assists in meeting goals and objectives for varying territories, special agent programs and contests.

  • Resolves challenges with effective solutions while maintaining focus on improving time service, quality of application submissions and underwriting quality

  • Handling up to $5,000,000 for life, up to $750,000 sign off for morbidity underwriting, and ability to sign off on exceptions for Intelligent Underwriting.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Underwriting Manager or Director

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate studies in medical related discipline, marketing, insurance, risk management, economics, finance or business management preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: LOMA Level 1 Certificate (LOMA 280, LOMA 290) preferred. Participation in, or attainment of, professional/technical studies or designation such as ALMI (ALU Level 1 Cert, ALU 201, 202, LOMA 320, 335).

Experience: Five years of life underwriting experience

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Proven foundation for basic financial underwriting. Ability to evaluate the life financial supplement, understand more sophisticated beneficiary situations, e.g., buy/sell agreements, beneficiaries other than immediate family, foreign risks. In-depth knowledge of anatomy, physiology, pathology and non-medical risks. For investment life, proven knowledge of independent distribution systems.

Relationships: Very comfortable negotiating offers and calling out on offers that are other than applied for to explain reasons to the advisor or sales leader.

Basic knowledge of products and reinsurance - is comfortable and has relationships with our facultative reinsurance partners. Advanced ability to effectively communicate verbally and in writing, with all contacts, including policyholders, applicants, field sales personnel, managers and associates in other operational departments. Exhibits creativity by bringing innovative ideas to problem solving and continually offering new ways to achieve desired objectives and results through effective decision making. Collaborates to resolve complex problems. Ability to analyze performance and financial operating reports to assess cause and effect relationships, and make recommendations providing assistance, knowledge, leadership and improving and influencing overall team efficiency. Constructively resolve customer issues, and within the team and cross-functional areas. Ability to set work priorities that conform to time service and quality standards. Demonstrates resilience.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resources Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment and may have the option to work from home. Non-standard hours and some travel may be required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

We currently anticipate accepting applications until 12/31/2027. However, we encourage early submissions, as the posting may close sooner if a strong candidate slate is identified before the deadline.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

raw.excerpt: Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure.
raw.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.


What you'll be responsible for:


As Business Development Manager, DeFi Liquidity, you will lead the design, execution, and optimization of liquidity programs supporting trading activity on Arc, Circle's blockchain network for institutional-grade on-chain financial activity. Working closely with colleagues responsible for external venue partnerships and internal trading products, you will ensure that both internal and external venues have the liquidity infrastructure and participation needed to support effective trading. You will leverage existing relationships with DeFi liquidity providers, market makers, and trading firms while developing new partnerships, building data-driven liquidity strategies, and managing programs from initial structuring through deployment and ongoing performance optimization. Your work will help establish sustainable liquidity, improve trading execution, and support the growth of Arc's on-chain trading ecosystem.


What you'll work on:


  • Design and execute liquidity programs for internal and external Arc trading venues, aligning incentives with venue structure and trading requirements.
  • Develop and expand relationships with DeFi liquidity providers, market makers, and trading firms to support liquidity deployment across Arc.
  • Build financial and liquidity models evaluating TVL requirements, fee structures, incentive economics, slippage, and expected trading activity.
  • Partner with Product and Venue GTM teams to inform trading venue design, liquidity architecture, fee tiers, and integration strategies.
  • Lead liquidity partnership negotiations, including program proposals, commercial terms, capital commitments, and deployment coordination.
  • Monitor liquidity performance, trading volume, capital efficiency, and incentive effectiveness to identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Translate DeFi market structure developments and liquidity provider feedback into actionable recommendations that strengthen Arc's trading ecosystem.

What you'll bring to Circle:


Core Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience, including substantial hands-on experience in crypto, DeFi trading, or liquidity provision.
  • Direct experience designing, executing, or managing on-chain liquidity programs within a DeFi protocol, market maker, or trading firm.
  • Strong knowledge of DeFi market structure, including AMMs, concentrated liquidity, proprietary AMMs, liquidity provisioning models, and aggregator routing.
  • Demonstrated ability to model liquidity requirements, incentive economics, fee optimization, and slippage to support data-driven commercial decisions.
  • Established relationships with DeFi liquidity providers, market makers, and trading desks, with experience developing and managing commercial partnerships.
  • Experience negotiating liquidity arrangements and managing the commercial lifecycle from initial engagement through deployment and ongoing optimization.
  • Ability to collaborate with Product and Engineering teams, evaluate technical specifications, and translate liquidity requirements into actionable product recommendations.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience deploying liquidity across multiple decentralized trading venues or supporting new blockchain ecosystem launches.
  • Knowledge of emerging DeFi liquidity provisioning techniques, market structure innovations, and evolving liquidity incentive models.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

raw.excerpt: By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful.
raw.description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

Security Engineer III/DLP

.

Primary purpose


The Security Engineer is responsible for implementing, maintaining, monitoring, and managing secure solutions in accordance with the organization’s architectural designs, best practices, and regulatory or compliance requirements. As risks change, the engineer recommends modifications and enhancements so the organization keeps pace with the threat landscape, and contributes to the corporate security strategy alongside security leadership and senior technologists.


This role focuses on designing, implementing, and managing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Microsoft Purview solutions to protect sensitive organizational data. The engineer develops and enforces data protection policies, monitors data activity across endpoints, cloud services, and on-premises environments, and ensures compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements. The engineer also advances Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) capabilities by identifying data risks, improving data visibility, classifying sensitive information, and strengthening data governance and security controls.


The engineer’s work supports IT infrastructure, application development, security operations, security audit, and end users, with an emphasis on securing systems, applications, third-party connections, service providers, and business-to-business initiatives. The ideal candidate collaborates with cross-functional teams to continuously assess and improve the organization’s data security posture, respond to incidents, and align with evolving security standards and best practices.

Essential functions and responsibilities

Data protection and DSPM


  • Design, implement, and tune DLP and Microsoft Purview policies, including sensitivity labels, classification, and data protection controls across endpoints, cloud services, email, collaboration platforms, and on-premises repositories.
  • Monitor data activity, triage and investigate DLP alerts, and work with the SOC and incident responders on data exposure events.
  • Identify data risks, improve data visibility, and report on data security posture with measurable benchmarks.
  • Partner with data owners, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance to define classification schemes and handling requirements, and to support data governance.

Operations and delivery


  • Handle daily implementation, monitoring, and operational support of hardware, software, customer applications, managed solutions, and service provider relationships.
  • Deliver information security projects on time, within budget, and within SLAs, evaluating existing security infrastructure and proposing changes as directed by security leadership and architects.
  • Manage service and escalation tickets within SLA expectations.
  • Participate regularly in change and project management meetings, and work closely with project managers to meet milestones.
  • Develop security test plans from architectural designs, identify deficiencies, and make enhancements so production is not impacted.
  • Research, validate, and deploy solutions that meet security and business needs, following security engineering fundamentals and processes in NIST 800-160.

Incident response


  • Assist with incident response and system stability issues, which may include involvement outside regular work hours.
  • Influence the planning and execution of incident response and postmortem exercises, with measurable benchmarks that show progress or gaps.

Automation and improvement


  • Develop technical solutions and new security tools to mitigate vulnerabilities and automate repeatable tasks, enabling the team to focus on more advanced work.
  • Conduct performance testing to stress the limits of security solutions without harming business processes.
  • Lead IT groups and business units as needed in troubleshooting compatibility issues between security tools and business or productivity programs.

Communication and collaboration


  • Work with architects, the SOC, incident responders, and infrastructure and development teams.
  • Analyze client and customer needs and provide clear, concise reports to leadership.
  • Work with management on assigned projects from inception through implementation, maintaining internal communication and user involvement.
  • Provide feedback and suggestions to management to improve IT security processes and procedures.

Additional functions


  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Travel as required.

Qualifications

Education and licensing


  • Bachelor’s degree in management information systems or a related field, and be pursuing a master’s degree in business administration or an IT-related field. Licenses as needed.

Experience


  • Three or more years of experience in cybersecurity with a systems or network security engineering background.
  • Preferably 2+ years of additional IT experience in technology design, implementation, and delivery.
  • Hands-on experience with DLP and Microsoft Purview, including sensitivity labels, DLP policy design, and data classification.
  • Extensive knowledge of traditional and modern security controls, such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, PKI, IDAM, antivirus, firewalls, EDR, threat intelligence platforms, security automation and orchestration, deception technologies, and application controls.
  • Experience managing SIEM, threat intelligence, automation and orchestration, IDS/IPS, file integrity monitoring (FIM), DLP, and other monitoring tools.

Preferred experience


  • DSPM tools and practices.
  • Application control listing software, SIEM solutions, and XDR solutions.
  • Artificial intelligence and machine learning, including data security considerations for AI.
  • CIS hardening.
  • Researching and advising leadership on emerging security technologies.
  • One or more of ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS, HIPAA, HITECH, SOX, GDPR, CIS standards, or SOC 2.

Skills and knowledge


  • Ability to work independently and solve problems as they arise.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with integrity.
  • Ability to continuously learn new technologies and guide team collaboration.
  • CIA triad and IT security frameworks expertise.
  • CISSP preferred. CISM, SANS, Microsoft security certifications (such as SC-401), or other security-related certifications are a plus.

Work environment


  • When applicable and appropriate, reasonable accommodations will be considered.
  • Mental: clear, conceptual thinking, excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle stress, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.
  • Physical: computer keyboarding; travel as required.
  • Auditory/visual: hearing, vision, and talking.

Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

raw.excerpt: You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact.
raw.description:
You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact.

If you dream of a life that is more like an adventure than a stable life, then becoming the AI-native right hand of our CEO is for you.

This isn’t another chief of staff or right hand job.

Most companies call themselves AI-first because they gave everyone a ChatGPT licence. We think that’s level 2, and there are 10.

At Paradox our ambition is $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. Here, AI doesn’t assist the work. It runs the loops, in every department. Your job is to make that true for the whole company, side by side with the CEO.

But wait a minute.

Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…

  • 🗽Freedom: working remotely or hybrid, and being trusted to deliver

  • 🔥Ambition: building one of the first truly AI-native companies, with teammates who push AI to its limits every week

  • 😍Impact: changing the trajectory of a whole company, not one line of a roadmap, with a product that transforms people’s lives at scale

Then, you have found the next adventure that will fulfill you.

WHAT AI-NATIVE MEANS AT PARADOX 🤖

In a company of fewer than 10 people, the right hand used to be the person who absorbed everything the CEO couldn’t do. Here, the right hand builds the machine that does it.

Our company has to be able to:

  1. Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, decisions, procedures, member stories and past experiments, in one shared company brain that every person and every agent reads before acting.

  2. Turn every decision into execution. A meeting, a voice note or a call with the CEO becomes briefs, tickets, follow-ups and deadlines, without anyone retyping it.

  3. Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: agents read and write in our whole stack, from code to CRM, billing, analytics, ads, email, calendar and documents.

  4. Ship. Produce the analysis, the contract draft, the page, the offer or the process, and put it live.

  5. Measure with real KPIs. Revenue, cash, margin, retention and the transformation of our members, not activity.

  6. Learn and loop on its own. Keep what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

People set the ambition, the taste and the standards. The machine runs the loop, and gets better every week.

This is already real. Our company brain holds our decisions and procedures. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment with its result. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars and audit our tracking after every live. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day, by text and by voice.

But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY? 😉

We believe self-help is broken. Most people use learning platforms the same way: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

They deserve more than content and more than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges and grows with them.

That’s why we merge:

  • Human Intelligence (coaches, peers and mentors)

  • Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)

  • Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

into one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS, the Operating System for Human Greatness, augmented with AI.

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world, and for something that will outlive any individual, its founder included.

Here’s the bet: A small team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

And that’s where you come in.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company.

Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches.

The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls. With fewer than 10 people, there is no department to hand things to. You build it.

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

1 - Be the CEO’s operating system

  • ❌The old way: a chief of staff takes notes in meetings, chases people by email and builds the weekly report by hand.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every CEO decision into execution. Meetings, voice notes and calls become briefs, tickets and follow-ups. Every Monday, the CEO gets one brief: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs his call.

  • You decide what the CEO must see and what he never needs to see again. His time goes to vision, product and members, not to coordination.

2 - Run strategic projects as a Pirate Squad of one, plus agents

Depending on your zone of genius, these are examples of strategic projects you could own:

  • Growth: run experiments with agents that generate, ship and measure them

  • Partnerships & sponsorships: find and close partners aligned with our brand, for our YouTube channel and events

  • International: build the machine that turns our French content into English, and open new countries

  • Launches: take a new offer or product from idea to live

  • People: find and assess the rare people who join a team of fewer than 10

  • ❌The old way: each new initiative needs a team, a roadmap and three months.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: one person with the right agents launches an offer, a channel or a country without disrupting the core. That’s what our Pirate Squad means now.

3 - Build AI-native operations

  • ❌The old way: an ops manager processes invoices, chases contracts, onboards people and answers the same support questions every week.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: finance, legal, HR, admin and customer support each get their agents, their context, their KPIs and their loop. You write the skills, plug them into our tools and write the evals that define "good": a reconciliation that matches to the cent, a contract that respects our playbook, an answer a member is happy with.

  • You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. An agent moves up a level only when its track record earns it.

  • Example: in your first month, you build the agent that reconciles payments, refunds and failed charges every night. In month one it only reports. By month three it fixes the simple cases alone, and you only see the exceptions.

4 - Strategy and business intelligence that check themselves

  • ❌The old way: someone builds dashboards in a BI tool, exports them to a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody fully trusts the numbers.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: agents watch revenue, cash, acquisition, retention, churn and competitors continuously, find where our sources disagree, and explain what changed and why.

  • Strategy: screen markets and competition, build growth models, explore business models, partnerships and acquisitions. Then challenge, formalize and ensure good execution of the strategy.

  • At Paradox things move fast, and our CEO is always reading business books and meeting great entrepreneurs. You’ll turn the best strategies and tactics into systems and agents the whole company uses.

5 - Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul

  • ❌The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.

  • 🏴‍☠️At Paradox: every decision, result and lesson goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before acting. The company never learns the same lesson twice.

  • You measure the machine itself: the share of work done without a human, the time from decision to execution, the agents that moved up an autonomy level this month, and revenue per person. You push those numbers up.

  • You help the team become AI-native too: you spot the work still done by hand, and you build the agent or show a teammate how to build it.

  • And always: our members trust us with their lives. No fake claims, no fake scarcity, data handled with care. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. People do.

How you’ll know you’re AI-native: you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. The company’s output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF? 😍

Experience

  • Top tier Business or Engineering School (HEC, ESSEC, INSEAD, EM Lyon, EDHEC, ESCP, Stanford, …) or other high-level academic training (Les Mines, X, Sciences Po Paris, etc.)

  • A wide-scope role behind you: founder, chief of staff, founder’s associate, strategy, consulting or operations in a fast-growing startup

  • You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, agent SDKs, MCP, automations, APIs, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

Traits

  • Driven with strong work ethic: this position requires a strong commitment and perseverance

  • Entrepreneurship spirit: able to own a project from scratch, with few resources and little guidance, doing a lot yourself

  • Builder, not coordinator: you’d rather build the agent than chase a person twice

  • Taste: you know the difference between an output that works and one that is great, and you hold agents to the second

  • Growth over ego: you are at ease with regular feedback, obsessed with learning and growing, able to put your ego aside

  • Analytical and system thinker: you quickly identify and formulate problems, and solve complex ones with data

  • Excels in communication: both written and verbal

Language

French: native or bilingual. English: fluent, you can hold a detailed conversation with English-speaking colleagues. Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

  • We are inspired by a culture of performance and ambition. Everything is fast-paced and there is a lot of change. You won’t always be told what to do or how to do it.

  • We tell each other things, even if they are uncomfortable. We value growth over ego. At Paradox, expressing disagreement to a manager and knowing how to debate is valued! We encourage critical and strategic thinking.

  • ❌ If you use AI for first drafts but your way of working looks the same as two years ago: wrong role.

  • ❌ If you want to manage a lot of people: we aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each managing a dozen agents.

  • ❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

If all this makes sense with you, then we’ll love working with you (and you with us, you’ll be pampered!)

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Build one of the first truly AI-native companies from inside the CEO’s office, and write the playbook others will copy. You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

A work with Impact, Freedom and Ambition

Growth & Ambition 🚀

  • 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform, whilst being in a good mood

  • 🏋️‍♀️No more bosses, but ongoing conversations to support your growth

  • ⚡️Learning to build with AI faster than almost anywhere else

Impact & Meaning 🔥

  • 🦄Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products are used by millions of people

  • 🤩Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something! We receive messages every day from members who quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships and changed their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽☀️

  • 😎A company culture based on autonomy & accountability

  • 🗽Flexible working hours (but very hard working)

  • 🌎A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want

  • 🧍‍♀️Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices

  • 💻Work on Mac

  • 🏀350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, a dance class or whatever makes you feel great)

  • 📚150€ of books or education: at Paradox, we are learner lovers

  • 🔥Access to Athena, our AI coach, supporting you on anything personal or professional

HOW TO APPLY 📃

❌ Any copy-pasted and non-personalized application goes directly to the trash can.

⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this: do not apply ⚠️

Hiring process

  • 📃 A 6 to 8 minute application survey, with a short video and a link to something you built with AI

  • 💻 A 30-minute video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

  • 🛠️ A live build session: you solve a real Paradox problem with AI in front of us. We look at how you prompt, push back on the output and iterate, more than at a polished result.

  • 💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

  • 💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, on the company’s next milestones and how you’d build them

  • 💼 Reference calls with your previous managers

  • 🤗 Welcome aboard!

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀

Overview

Job Title: Program ManagerLocation: RemoteTravel Approximately 10%

The Program Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and supporting telecommunications and technology infrastructure projects supporting the Department of Defense (DoD), DISA, and other federal customers. This position manages projects involving inside plant (ISP) and outside plant (OSP) fiber optic infrastructure, structured cabling, telecommunications, network infrastructure, audiovisual (AV)/VTC systems, equipment installation, and related low-voltage and technology infrastructure from planning and site survey through installation, testing, customer acceptance, and project closeout.

The Program Manager works closely with government personnel, engineers, technicians, subcontractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders to coordinate project activities, track schedules and deliverables, resolve issues, and help ensure projects are completed within scope and in accordance with contractual, technical, security, and customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities:• Manage and support multiple DISA, DoD, and federal telecommunications and technology infrastructure projects from initiation through completion.• Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, budgets, action-item trackers, risk registers, procurement status, and deliverable schedules.• Coordinate ISP and OSP fiber, structured cabling, telecommunications, network infrastructure, AV/VTC, equipment installation, and related low-voltage and technology infrastructure activities.• Serve as a primary coordination point between government customers, technical teams, subcontractors, vendors, and company leadership.• Coordinate site surveys, design reviews, installation activities, testing, inspections, cutovers, customer acceptance, and project closeout.• Coordinate work within secure and mission-critical DoD environments, including facility access, escorts, maintenance windows, outages, change-control requirements, and other operational constraints.• Review Statements of Work (SOWs), Performance Work Statements (PWSs), task orders, drawings, specifications, cable schedules, bills of materials, technical requirements, subcontractor proposals, and related project documentation.• Monitor project scope and identify schedule impacts, risks, technical issues, dependencies, procurement concerns, and potential cost impacts requiring resolution or escalation.• Coordinate equipment and material procurement and track long-lead items that may affect project schedules.• Manage subcontractor and vendor coordination and monitor performance against project requirements, schedules, approved designs, and customer expectations.• Coordinate fiber optic installation, splicing, termination, labeling, testing, and certification activities and review associated test documentation as required.• Coordinate structured cabling installation, cable pathways, racks, cabinets, patch panels, terminations, labeling, testing, and related telecommunications infrastructure.• Coordinate telecommunications and technology work with electrical, facilities, construction, furniture, and other project activities as required.• Coordinate planned outages, system cutovers, installation windows, migrations, and other activities affecting operational communications infrastructure.• Maintain project documentation including meeting minutes, status reports, action-item logs, risk logs, punch lists, redlines, as-built documentation, test results, equipment inventories, and closeout packages.• Prepare and support Requests for Information (RFIs), project correspondence, subcontractor coordination, status updates, customer communications, and other project documentation.• Lead or participate in project kickoff meetings, recurring status meetings, technical coordination meetings, subcontractor meetings, and government customer briefings.• Provide concise program and project reporting addressing accomplishments, upcoming milestones, schedule, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, procurement status, and required customer decisions.• Track subcontractor deliverables, material status, field activities, testing requirements, customer actions, raw.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer focused on AI architecture research to help design, prototype, and validate next-generation model architectures. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production — turning new ideas into scalable, real-world systems.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys questioning architectural assumptions, experimenting with novel model designs, and pushing beyond standard Transformer-style approaches.

What You’ll Work On

  • Research and develop new neural network architectures (e.g. alternatives or extensions to Transformers, recurrent / hybrid models, long-context systems)

  • Design and run architecture-level experiments (scaling laws, memory mechanisms, compute trade-offs)

  • Prototype models end-to-end — from research code to training-ready implementations

  • Collaborate with inference and systems engineers to ensure architectures are deployable and efficient

  • Analyze model behavior, failure modes, and inductive biases

  • Read, reproduce, and extend cutting-edge research papers

  • Contribute to internal research notes, benchmarks, and open-source efforts (where applicable)

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong background in machine learning fundamentals and deep learning

  • Hands-on experience implementing model architectures from scratch

  • Solid understanding of:

    • Attention mechanisms, RNNs, state-space models, or hybrid architectures

    • Training dynamics, scaling behavior, and optimization

    • Memory, latency, and compute constraints at the model level

  • Comfortable working in PyTorch or JAX

  • Ability to move fluidly between theory, experimentation, and engineering

  • Clear communicator who can explain architectural trade-offs

Nice to Have

  • Experience with non-Transformer architectures (RNN variants, SSMs, long-context models)

  • Background in research-driven startups or open-source ML projects

  • Experience with large-scale training or custom training loops

  • Publications, preprints, or notable research contributions

  • Familiarity with inference optimization and deployment constraints

Why Join

  • Work on core model architecture, not just fine-tuning

  • Direct influence on the technical direction of a Series-A company

  • Small, high-caliber team with fast feedback loops

  • Opportunity to ship research into production

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful equity

raw.title: Director of Business Development – US
raw.excerpt: Who we are Arkeus builds AI-powered sensing systems that help autonomous platforms detect, track and understand what's happening in the most complex and contested environments.
raw.description:
Who we are

Arkeus builds AI-powered sensing systems that help autonomous platforms detect, track and understand what's happening in the most complex and contested environments. Our technology is deployed across defence and national security applications — already protecting lives and strengthening security across the U.S. and allied markets.

Backed by QIC, Main Sequence, R+VC, Salus Ventures, Folklore Ventures, DYNE Ventures and Beaten Zone Venture Partners, Arkeus is entering a major growth phase. We are a small, fast-moving company with the energy and ambition of a start-up and the technical credibility of a world-class defence technology provider.

We work at the intersection of optics, autonomy, robotics and real-time AI and we deploy what we build. If you want to ship technology that matters, not technology that ships decks, this is where you belong.

Check it yourself on News | Arkeus

We have developed an inclusive, transparent and engaging culture that focuses on building a diverse workforce — realising that to attract the very best, we need to ensure our culture is ready to welcome people from all ages, genders and backgrounds.

About the Role

As the Business Development Director for US, your primary mission is to get Arkeus’ autonomous sensing systems and edge-AI perception payloads, led by our Warden, integrated and deployed into the US military’s uncrewed aerial fleet. This is an elite hunter role. You will own the sales pipeline, customer relationships, and capture strategies for US Department of Defense (DoD) UAS programs, Group 1 through Group 4.

You will focus heavily on two fronts: winning prime opportunities directly with DoD innovation and acquisition branches (e.g., DIU, AFRL, NAVAIR, Army PM UAS), and driving sub-contract integration wins by selling directly to Tier-1 and Tier-2 UAS Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). You will turn technical demonstrations into multi-million-dollar production contracts.

As an entrepreneur, you will become a trusted advisor within the US autonomous systems ecosystem – developing opportunities to extend the value we can bring through extensions to our current products, or drive evolutions through close collaboration with our advanced development and product teams.

About You

You are a relentless defense business development professional with an established, active network in the US military UAS ecosystem. You know the programs, the key decision-makers, and the major industry primes. You aren't just a relationship manager; you understand payload integration, SWaP-C (Size, Weight, Power, and Cost) constraints, and how computer vision, machine learning and artificial intelligence changes the game for ISR.

You thrive in high-autonomy, venture-backed startup environments. You don't wait for incoming leads—you actively map requirements, identify program gaps, and position our technology as the must-have solution for software-defined warfare.

You thrive in ambiguity, excel at translating cutting-edge AI capability into high-value customer propositions, and know how to build pipelines with a strong MOAT from the ground up.

 

What You'll Do

  • Trusted Advisor: Develop a trusted advisor relationship with key stakeholders and influencers within the US Department of Defence (DoD) and US OEM’s
  • Pipeline Execution: Source, qualify, and close multi-million-dollar sales opportunities within the US Air Force, Army, Navy, Marine Corps, and Special Operations UAS, or related, programs.
  • OEM Account Management: Establish and scale strategic commercial relationships with leading US UAS manufacturers to design Arkeus payloads into their next-generation airframes.
  • Capture & Proposal Leadership: Lead the capture strategy for targeted US government RFPs, OTAs, and SBIR/STTR transitions. Write winning proposals backed by deep technical understanding.
  • Mission-Aligned Selling: Translate complex user requirements (e.g., GPS-denied navigation, autonomous targeting, multi-domain ISR) into tailored Arkeus system configurations.
  • Flight Tests & Demos: Coordinate and execute high-impact product demonstrations and military flight trials alongside our technical Customer Success and Integration teams.
  • Market Intelligence: Feed critical US customer requirements, policy updates (such as Replicator initiatives), and competitor insights back to the product and engineering teams, driving information sharing through our CRM.
  • Leadership: Demonstrate leadership through example by putting our customers first through a culture of leadership, ownership, disruption and audacity.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days:

  • You have mapped the top 10 US military UAS program opportunities and Tier-1 OEM targets for Arkeus.
  • You have established a seamless working rhythm with the US leadership and international product and engineering teams.
  • You have secured your first set of introductory pipeline meetings with target program offices or OEMs.

In your first year:

  • You have successfully secured at least two major program wins or hardware integration contracts with US defense UAS customers/primes.
  • You have built a robust, qualified multi-year sales pipeline that ensures predictable revenue growth for the US entity.
  • Arkeus is actively participating in key US military operational exercises and flight demonstrations.
  • You have established Arkeus as the premier choice for autonomous sensing payloads among targeted US drone manufacturers

 

Your Experience and Skills

  • Defense BD Track Record: 5+ years of proven success in defense business development, capture management, or sales, with a verifiable history of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • UAS Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of the uncrewed aerial systems market, including payloads, sensors (EO/IR, radar), open architectures (MOSA), and autonomous software.
  • Procurement Fluency: Comprehensive understanding of US DoD procurement pathways, budget cycles, and contract vehicles (e.g., FAR, non-FAR, OTAs).
  • Technical Credibility: Ability to confidently discuss sensor specifications, edge-computing limits, and airborne software architectures with military operators and aerospace engineers.
  • Military/Industry Network: An active, relevant network of contacts across the US DoD UAS program offices and defense aerospace primes.
  • Clearance: Must hold, or be readily capable of obtaining, a U.S. Secret (or higher) security clearance. (Prior military or civil service experience is highly valued).
  • Culture: Passion for a fast-paced, dynamic, and creative environment that prioritizes our Customers receiving a Compelling Experience through demonstration of leadership, ownership, disruption and audacity.
  • Travel: Must be willing to travel up to 50%.

 

What We Offer

  • You will work on the hardest problems in deep-tech — optics, autonomy, real-time AI and hardware-software integration in a single product. The gap between what you build and where it ends up is almost nonexistent.
  • You will collaborate with exceptional leaders who have decades of combined experience in AI, optics and defense. You will be learning from — and contributing to — the best in the field.
  • You will become part of a close-knit, ego-free team where ideas compete on merit, not seniority. Low politics, high trust. The kind of team you will still be talking about in ten years.
  • You will work hard and be expected to bring your best — and in return you will grow faster than you ever would at a large organization.
  • You will work on technology that is already deployed in real environments — protecting lives and strengthening security across defense and national security applications.
  • You will receive a competitive, market-benchmarked salary, structured career pathways built to grow with you, and the opportunity to participate in our Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP).
  • You will have the opportunity to mentor bright emerging talent through our highly sought-after intern program and strong connections with leading universities.

 

If this sounds like you, please apply even if you don't check every box listed above, and join our growing team in improving security and saving lives!
