Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne, where we have recently established new BLP hubs.
Regardless of your location, you will start with a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month). Afterwards, you can work from home or from one of our hubs, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region.
Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by BLP.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Project Manager, most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.

You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

  • Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

  • Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

  • Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

For the Project Manager level

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • The ability to run several projects at once without losing control of any of them.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

About the Role

Merchant Warrior is seeking a Merchant Operations & Customer Support Specialist to support its growing payments and merchant services business. This role is ideal for candidates with experience in merchant-facing support, fintech, or payment gateway environments, who are comfortable handling both customer service and operational configuration work.

This is not a data-entry role. The position involves frontline merchant communication (calls and email) alongside merchant account configuration and operational support within internal payment systems. Training will be provided on Merchant Warrior's platforms and processes, but prior exposure to payments or merchant environments will help candidates ramp faster.

The role reports directly to the Operations Manager and works closely with the Risk, Technical, and Development teams.

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

  • Serve as a frontline point of contact for merchants via phone and email, resolving payment-related inquiries and operational issues.
  • Support merchant onboarding activities, including information collection, account setup, and basic configuration within internal systems.
  • Handle day-to-day merchant account servicing, including transaction-related queries and system issues.
  • Manage and track support tickets, escalating issues to technical or development teams when required and ensuring merchants are kept informed.
  • Perform guided account configuration tasks following internal procedures and training.
  • Deliver consistent, high-quality customer service while balancing operational accuracy and compliance requirements.
  • Build a strong understanding of Merchant Warrior's products, payment flows, and internal processes within the first 60–90 days.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Management, or a related field preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 1+ year of experience in customer service, technical support, fintech, payments, or merchant support roles.
  • Experience in payment gateways, acquiring banks, fintechs, or merchant services environments is highly advantageous.
  • Senior profiles with deeper payments or merchant operations exposure are welcome and preferred if available.

Technical Systems & Tools

  • Ticketing systems (current platform migrating to Deskpro)
  • Internal merchant management and configuration portals
  • Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, basic Office tools)
  • Browser-based tools (Chrome or similar)
  • PDF editing tools (e.g., Adobe Acrobat)
  • Familiarity with merchant platforms or e-commerce environments is an advantage, but not required.

Key Skills & Core Competencies

In addition to relevant technical experience, Merchant Warrior is looking for someone who demonstrates strong ownership, independence, and the ability to perform effectively in a dynamic, remote working environment.

1. Strong Self-Management & Autonomy

  • Able to manage daily responsibilities independently with minimal supervision.
  • Takes ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables.
  • Organises workload effectively and manages competing priorities.
  • Demonstrates initiative rather than relying on constant direction.

2. Excellent Prioritisation & Time Management

  • Can distinguish between urgent and important tasks.
  • Consistently meets deadlines and agreed timelines.
  • Handles fluctuations in workload without losing focus.
  • Maintains productivity during high-volume periods.

3. Adaptability in a Dynamic Environment

  • Comfortable working in an evolving business environment where processes and priorities may change.
  • Adjusts quickly to new requirements and unexpected situations.
  • Able to work through ambiguity and make progress without becoming overly reliant on step-by-step direction.
  • Remains effective in a fast-paced setting.

4. Proactive Learning Mindset

  • Actively seeks knowledge and takes initiative to understand systems, processes, and procedures.
  • Uses available resources and documentation to find answers before escalating.
  • Learns from mistakes and applies feedback to improve performance.
  • Demonstrates curiosity and a commitment to continuous improvement.

5. Confidence & Resourcefulness

  • Approaches challenges with a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Makes informed decisions within the scope of the role.
  • Attempts to resolve issues independently before escalating when appropriate.
  • Demonstrates resilience and initiative when facing unfamiliar situations.

6. Process Adherence & Attention to Detail

  • Follows documented procedures and knowledge-base articles accurately.
  • Applies instructions consistently to minimise repeat errors.
  • Maintains accuracy when handling merchant information and operational tasks.
  • Takes feedback and corrections on board to improve work quality.

7. Accountability & Ownership

  • Takes responsibility for assigned tasks, decisions, and outcomes.
  • Owns mistakes and takes appropriate steps to resolve them.
  • Follows through on commitments and ensures tasks are completed.
  • Accepts feedback constructively and demonstrates personal responsibility.

8. Strong Communication & Collaboration

  • Communicates clearly and professionally with merchants and internal stakeholders.
  • Provides timely updates and sets appropriate expectations.
  • Escalates issues effectively and provides relevant information.
  • Works collaboratively with Operations, Risk, Technical, and Development teams.

9. Quality & Productivity Focus

  • Delivers accurate, high-quality work while maintaining productivity.
  • Balances speed and efficiency with attention to detail.
  • Maintains consistent performance during busy periods.
  • Takes ownership of meeting expected quality and productivity standards.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A high-performing Merchant Warrior Customer Support / Operations Specialist is someone who is:

  • Self-directed, independent, and accountable.
  • Strong in prioritisation and workload management.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a changing environment.
  • A proactive learner who takes initiative in finding solutions.
  • Confident and resourceful when troubleshooting issues.
  • Detail-oriented and consistent in following documented processes.
  • An effective communicator who works well with customers and internal teams.
  • Focused on delivering both quality and productivity.
  • Comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision.
  • Growth-oriented, receptive to feedback, and committed to continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate is expected to become increasingly independent and confident in managing their responsibilities, developing a strong understanding of Merchant Warrior's systems and processes, and consistently delivering accurate, timely, and high-quality work.

They should be able to manage their workload without constant direction, proactively find solutions, follow established procedures, and take accountability for their deliverables while contributing positively to the wider team.

iRobot is seeking a Customer Care Program Coordinator to support the integration of our China and US customer service operations. This role will serve as a critical liaison between China headquarters and North American customer service teams, ensuring effective communication, alignment of service strategies, and successful execution of operational initiatives.
The ideal candidate has experience working across global organizations, possesses strong customer service and program management capabilities, and is comfortable collaborating with stakeholders across multiple time zones. This individual will help ensure alignment between global customer care initiatives and local market execution while supporting efforts to improve service quality, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.

  • 3+ years of experience in customer service operations, customer experience, program coordination, vendor management, or related fields.

The Role: Leader, Supply Chain Risk and Innovation


The Position: The Head of Supply Chain Risk and Innovation is a senior commercial leadership position within S&P Global's Supply Chain Intelligence business. Reporting to the Leader of Global Supply Chain Intelligence and serving as a member of the Supply Chain Intelligence Leadership Team, this role owns the strategy, growth and financial performance of the Supply Chain Risk and Innovation portfolio, including the Panjiva and GTAS solutions, while shaping the introduction of new offerings across the broader Supply Chain Intelligence ecosystem. The leader will define and execute a multi-year plan designed to position the portfolio to achieve $100 million in annual contract value by year-end 2031, integrating trade intelligence, risk analytics, supplier and shipment visibility and emerging technologies to help clients assess exposure, anticipate disruption and make more informed sourcing and strategic decisions.


The Team: The Supply Chain Intelligence Leadership Team brings together portfolio leaders accountable for the breadth of S&P Global's supply-chain data, analytics and insight solutions. The team combines deep domain expertise across global trade, maritime activity, commodities and risk analytics with a mandate to deliver sustained commercial growth and meaningful client outcomes. Colleagues operate across a global, matrixed environment, partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, Research, Technology and Client Success to advance both the near-term commercial agenda and a longer-term innovation pipeline.


Responsibilities and Impact:

  • Drive the Supply Chain Risk and Innovation portfolio toward $100 million in annual contract value by year-end 2031, delivering annual revenue growth through new-client acquisition, cross-sell, upsell, and geographic and industry expansion, with defined annual milestones and clear investment commitments.
  • Define differentiated value propositions and go-to-market strategies for Panjiva, GTAS and future offerings, translating portfolio priorities into product roadmaps, pricing models and commercial plans for target markets.
  • Build and maintain high-value external partnerships with data providers, technology companies and distribution channels to expand market development, accelerate innovation and open new routes to market.
  • Serve as the senior commercial and subject-matter authority for supply-chain risk and trade intelligence, leading executive client engagements, supporting major sales opportunities and representing S&P Global at industry events.
  • Translate validated client needs into clear product requirements, investment cases and measurable commercial outcomes, maintaining governance over product quality, data usage, methodology, compliance and investment commitments.
  • Contribute to Supply Chain Intelligence Leadership Team decisions on business-line strategy, portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, talent planning and cross-business execution.

  • Experience leading data, analytics, research or technology products or solutions that support enterprise decision-making.
  • Strong understanding of global trade, supplier networks, sourcing, logistics, maritime activity, commodities or supply-chain risk.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience bringing new products or capabilities from concept through market launch and commercial scale.
  • Demonstrated success managing strategic client relationships and partnering with Sales organizations to accelerate pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Experience developing partnerships, evaluating external data providers or leading strategic alliances.
  • Experience working across a global, matrixed organization with multiple stakeholder groups including Product, Finance, Legal and Operations.
  • Familiarity with trade-compliance frameworks, third-party risk management or supply-chain resilience methodologies.
  • Experience with data licensing models, integrated solution packaging or strategic product bundling.
  • Demonstrated contribution to business-line strategy and operating-plan development at a leadership team level.

Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. After successfully launching our virtual clinic for ADHD and anxiety, we are expanding our pediatric care platform to address other common chronic conditions and are focused right now on Obesity and Overweight management. Our new clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and designed to deliver exceptional health outcomes that transform a child's trajectory.

We are seeking a passionate Pediatrician to join our multi-disciplinary clinical team as an Obesity Specialist. In this role, you will be at the forefront of our new program, providing virtual care centered around family-based behavioral therapy and individualized medical management for children and teens (ages 5-17).

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer, Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

What makes this role unique:

  • Integrated Care Model: Work within a multi-disciplinary team of physicians, nurse practitioners, Master’s level therapists and psychologists to provide integrated, evidence-based care.

  • Pioneer a New Program: Contribute directly to the development and iteration of our Obesity and Overweight care model, workflows, and clinical tools.

  • Professional Growth: We encourage clinicians to develop special areas of expertise and become leaders within the team. We provide ongoing training, guidance from experts, and stipends for professional development.

  • Conduct 60-minute virtual intake appointments to screen for obesity/overweight and determine individualized treatment plans.

  • Lead our "Positive Parenting for Healthy Weight" Shared Medical Appointment groups

  • Board Certification: Board certified by the American Board of Pediatrics. Board certification in Obesity Medicine preferred.

  • Experience: At least 5 years of patient care experience.

  • Specialized Interest: Deep interest or experience in Lifestyle Medicine, nutrition coaching, and physical activity.

  • Tech-Savvy: Confidence in using electronic medical records (EMR) and telemedicine tools to deliver virtual care.

  • Cultural Responsiveness: Experience working with families from diverse backgrounds and a commitment to providing culturally responsive treatment.

  • Startup Mindset: Excitement about joining a fast-growing startup and iterating on new care models.

  • Spanish-speaking (to support our upcoming Spanish-language initiatives).

Schedule: Part-time (16+ hours); some evening or weekend hours required

Location: Remote

  • Clinical time: $136-$178/hour

  • Admin time: $25/hour

Schedule:

  • Flexibility for part-time hours between Monday through Friday (Central) 8am - 8pm PT, and Saturday 8am - 2pm PT

You have a clear vision of where your career can go. And we have the leadership to help you get there. At CNA, we strive to create a culture in which people know they matter and are part of something important, ensuring the abilities of all employees are used to their fullest potential.

This individual contributor position works under moderate direction, and within defined authority limits, to manage commercial claims with moderate to high complexity and exposure for a specific line of business. Responsibilities include investigating and resolving claims according to company protocols, quality and customer service standards. Position requires regular communication with customers and insureds and may be dedicated to specific account(s).

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Performs a combination of duties in accordance with departmental guidelines:

  • Manages an inventory of moderate to high complexity and exposure commercial claims by following company protocols to verify policy coverage, conduct investigations, develop and employ resolution strategies, and authorize disbursements within authority limits.
  • Provides exceptional customer service by interacting professionally and effectively with insureds, claimants and business partners, achieving quality and cycle time standards, providing regular, timely updates and responding promptly to inquiries and requests for information.
  • Verifies coverage and establishes timely and adequate reserves by reviewing and interpreting policy language and partnering with coverage counsel on more complex matters , estimating potential claim valuation, and following company's claim handling protocols.
  • Conducts focused investigation to determine compensability, liability and covered damages by gathering pertinent information, such as contracts or other documents, taking recorded statements from customers, claimants, injured workers, witnesses, and working with experts, or other parties, as necessary to verify the facts of the claim.
  • Establishes and maintains working relationships with appropriate internal and external work partners, suppliers and experts by identifying and collaborating with resources that are needed to effectively resolve claims.
  • Authorizes and ensures claim disbursements within authority limit by determining liability and compensability of the claim, negotiating settlements and escalating to manager as appropriate.
  • Contributes to expense management by timely and accurately resolving claims, selecting and actively overseeing appropriate resources, and delivering high quality service.
  • Identifies and addresses subrogation/salvage opportunities or potential fraud occurrences by evaluating the facts of the claim and making referrals to appropriate Recovery or SIU resources for further investigation.
  • Achieves quality standards on every file by following all company guidelines, achieving quality and cycle time targets, ensuring proper documentation and issuing appropriate claim disbursements.
  • Maintains compliance with state/local regulatory requirements by following company guidelines, and staying current on commercial insurance laws, regulations or trends for line of business.
  • May serve as a mentor/coach to less experienced claim professionals

May perform additional duties as assigned.


Reporting Relationship

Typically Manager or above


Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

  • Solid working knowledge of the commercial insurance industry, products, policy language, coverage, and claim practices.
  • Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to develop positive working relationships, summarize and present information to customers, claimants and senior management as needed.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop collaborative business relationships with internal and external work partners.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement, solve moderately complex problems and make sound business decisions.
  • Demonstrated investigative experience with an analytical mindset and critical thinking skills.
  • Strong work ethic, with demonstrated time management and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment at high levels of productivity.
  • Developing ability to negotiate low to moderately complex settlements.
  • Adaptable to a changing environment.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and ability to learn business-related software.
  • Demonstrated ability to value diverse opinions and ideas

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Typically a minimum four years of relevant experience, preferably in claim handling.
  • Candidates who have successfully completed the CNA Claim Training Program may be considered after 2 years of claim handling experience.
  • Must have or be able to obtain and maintain an Insurance Adjuster License within 90 days of hire, where applicable.
  • Professional designations are a plus (e.g. CPCU)

This individual provides expert consulting services across the suite of WEX solutions to ensure the success of our customers. This role is responsible for bridging complex customer business requirements with scalable platform capabilities across WEX solutions.


Working across the standard four-phase operating model—Intake & Alignment, Discovery, Delivery, and Hypercare—the consultant translates partner business processes into detailed functional specifications, authors Statements of Work (SOWs), and executable implementation plans. The consultant works closely with client business and IT leads, as well as internal Product, Engineering, and Project Management teams to ensure solution feasibility, delivery excellence, and commercial value.


How you will make an impact:

Functional Solution Design & Architecture (50%)

  • Functional Requirements:Lead functional discovery sessions with partner business stakeholders and IT contacts to evaluate inbound/outbound file formats, APIs, data structures, and operational workflows.
  • Solution Definition:Design clear, supportable end-to-end integration designs for accounts, leveraging standard product offerings and proprietary accelerators where applicable.
  • Standard Operating Model (SOM) Execution:Guide partner requests through the structured intake, qualification, and functional mapping process, ensuring alignment with overall platform architecture.
  • Process Modeling: Create workflow diagrams, data mapping matrices, and functional specs for integrations involving transaction data, pricing files, billing, credit manager, and master data files.

Solution Scoping, Estimation & SOW Authoring (30%)

  • SOW Authoring: Author high-quality, comprehensive Statements of Work (SOWs), including clear functional scope, client dependencies, explicit out-of-scope items, acceptance criteria, and project milestones.
  • Estimation Integrity: Collaborate with technical leads and project managers to formulate initial "T-Shirt" SWAG estimates as well as refined, high-fidelity delivery effort estimates.
  • Commercial Discipline:Support commercial discipline by evaluating custom requests, identifying billable engagement opportunities, and protecting program margins.

Partner Engagement & Program Execution (10%)

  • Consultative Support: Serve as a primary functional point of contact during the discovery and UAT prep phases of customer engagements.
  • Risk & Issue Remediation: Identify, document, and escalate potential project risks, functional gaps, or technical blockers early in the delivery lifecycle.
  • Hypercare Transition: Support smooth post-deployment hypercare transitions to standard production support teams once UAT and release validations are accepted.

Cross-Functional Alignment (10%)

  • Product Alignment: Partner with Product and Technology teams to ensure proposed solutions align with core capabilities and platform roadmaps.

Experience you will bring:

  • Minimum 5 years of consulting or industry-related experience in Fleet, OTR, or North American Mobility.
  • Proven track record of supporting large transformational programs and direct customer engagements for strategic accounts.
  • Experience in solution selling and transitioning from transactional relationships to strategic partnerships.

Skills & Competencies

  • Domain Expertise: Knowledge of OTR and Mobility systems, including an understanding of reimbursement processes, payment technologies, and integration capabilities.
  • Business Case Development: Ability to assist sales, account management, and leadership teams in building business cases.
  • Consultative Abilities: Exceptional ability to build rapport with stakeholders, and facilitate analysis on complex issues under deadline pressure.
  • Technical Proficiency: Ability to define technical approaches, consult partners through technical specifications, create process flow diagrams, and ability to translate technical requirements to the business SME’s.

Travel Requirements

  • Ability to travel up to 25% is required to support client engagements and strategic workshops.

The Medical Writer is responsible for interpreting complex clinical study protocols and other medical/scientific documentation to prepare and coordinate laboratory specification and study‑specific medical/technical documents for ACM Global Laboratories. They will partner with internal departments in the development, drafting, review, editing, and finalization of documents used to conduct clinical studies.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development, revision, and maintenance of complex clinical study and amendments in accordance to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and regulatory requirements.
  • With support of a mentor, work on the development, revision, and maintenance of high profile and expedited complex study documents and amendments in accordance to SOPs and regulatory requirements.

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert (SME) for medical documentation utilized throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Lead, initiate, and manage multiple rounds of internal and external document review.
  • Liaise and drive timely collaboration between key stakeholders to ensure technical documentation meet high quality standards and aligns with business process.
  • Participate in client interactions during study start-up activities and/or during study amendment process.
  • Review of low to medium complexity GLSD in accordance to SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • With support of a mentor, work on the review of high complexity GLSD in accordance with SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • Lead the development, revision, and maintenance of lab manuals in accordance to SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Review lab manuals to ensure alignment with SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • Resolve challenges and build consensus between all cross-functional groups and collaborators in a timely manner.
  • Maintain a general working knowledge of Food & Drug Administration (FDA), Medical & Healthcare Regulatory Agency (MHRA), New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH and other pertinent regulations.
  • Demonstrate initiative in professional self-development to improve job performance to maintain relevant working knowledge of clinical trials.
  • Resolve queries for complex studies by using knowledge of regional differences and internal ACM processes for low and medium complexity GLSD and understanding of department responsibilities.

  • BA/BS, or equivalent experience in scientific field
  • 1 yrs clinical trials or other laboratory experience required

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Applied knowledge of routine document content preparation, including the use of style guides, medical dictionaries, regulatory guidance documents, and templates
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and desktop publishing or word processing
  • Education in medical or technical writing
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to effectively influence others, work in a team environment, and collaborate across lines of business and functions
  • 1+ years’ experience drafting clinical trials documentation

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. Some roles may require flexible hours, TB screening, or a valid driver’s license.

raw.description:
Workforce Classification:

Telecommuter

Join Our Team: Do Meaningful Work and Improve People’s Lives

Our purpose, to improve customers’ lives by making healthcare work better, is far from ordinary. And so are our employees. Working at Premera means you have the opportunity to drive real change by transforming healthcare.

Premera is committed to being a workplace where people feel empowered to grow, innovate, and lead with purpose. By investing in our employees and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous development, we’re able to better serve our customers. It’s this commitment that has earned us recognition as one of the best companies to work for. Learn more about our recent awards and recognitions as a greatest workplace.

Learn how Premera supports our members, customers and the communities that we serve through our Healthsource blog: .

Please note this position aligns to PST business hours.

The Manager, Case Management Team is a Supervisor for Case Managers. This position is responsible for the execution and implementation of Clinical Programs’ strategy and goals and the oversight of Clinical Programs’ operations. The incumbent oversees the effective integration and continuous improvement of processes and systems to meet Premera’s current and future business goals. Responsibilities also include managing and developing a team of clinical and support staff promoting their professional growth and operational effectiveness.

What you'll do:

  • Participate in development of Clinical Programs’ strategy and planning in accordance with company's mission and strategic goals, federal and state law and regulations, and accreditation standards.

  • Assist in the selection, training, evaluation, and development of professional paraprofessional, and administrative team members.

  • Lead Care Management teams in effective performance of job functions, which may include case management and delegated management oversight.

  • Participate in the development and monitoring of budgets in accordance with department and organizational objectives.

  • Participate in the development, implementation, and monitoring of the department's performance standards, utilizing quality improvement methodologies to refine procedures.

  • Foster collaborative work environment that encourages team building, facilitates cohesive synergetic performance of Case Management functions, while valuing the individual diversity and uniqueness of all employees.

  • Build and maintain cooperative business relationships.

  • Participate in activities and processes to ensure operational compliance with regulatory requirements, including NCQA and OIC.

  • Provide effective oversight and developmental support for team members to meet productivity and satisfy expectations. Facilitate team building across the team so that team members feel connected to one another and the larger department.

  • Effectively manages deficits with improvement plans and consistent follow-up.

  • Use data effectively to monitor performance, identify opportunities and address problems and opportunities timely.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Candidates with a RN License are highly preferred.

  • Current state credential (e.g. licensure) that allows the professional to conduct an assessment independently as permitted within the discipline's scope of practice (Required):
    • For nurses, required registration (e.g. RN, ARNP).
    • For behavioral health, required licensure (e.g. LMFT, LICSW, LPC, LMHC)
    • For psychologist, required board certification
    • For dietitians, required certification as a nutritionist or dietician
    • Or licensure in related healthcare discipline

  • Certified in CCM (Certified Case Management) or obtain certification within 24 months of date of hire. (Required)

  • Five (5) years case management or health care experience. (Required)

  • Three (3) years management experience. (Required)

  • Advanced degree such as Master's Degree in a Health-Related field preferred.

  • Experience with NCQA, URAC, or accreditation review processes.

  • Experience in continuous process improvement and creative problem solving (e.g. LEAN, Synectic).

  • Advanced training in Motivational Interviewing.

  • Experience training clinical and non-clinical staff.

  • Experience managing case management teams and integrated case management model.

Premera total rewards

Our comprehensive total rewards package provides support, resources, and opportunities to help employees thrive and grow. Our total rewards are more than a collection of perks, they're a reflection of our commitment to your health and well-being. We offer a broad array of rewards including physical, financial, emotional, and community benefits, including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental coverage with low employee premiums.

  • Voluntary benefit offerings, including pet insurance for paw parents.

  • Life and disability insurance.

  • Retirement programs, including a 401K employer match and, believe it or not, a pension plan that is vested after 3 years of service.

  • Wellness incentives with a wide range of mental well-being resources for you and your dependents, including counseling services, stress management programs, and mindfulness programs, just to name a few.

  • Generous paid time off to reenergize.

  • Looking for continuing education? We have tuition assistance for both undergraduate and graduate degrees.

  • Employee recognition program to celebrate anniversaries, team accomplishments, and more.

For our hybrid employees, our on-campus model provides flexibility to create your own routine with access to on-site resources, networking opportunities, and team engagement.

  • Commuter perks make your trip to work less impactful on the environment and your wallet.

  • Free convenient on-site parking.

  • Subsidized on-campus cafes make lunchtime connections with colleagues fun and affordable.

  • Participate in engaging on-site activities such as health and wellness events, coffee connects, disaster preparedness fairs and more.

  • Our complementary fitness & well-being center offers both in-person and virtual workouts and nutritional counseling.

  • Need a brain break? Challenge someone to a game of shuffleboard or ping pong while on campus.

Equal employment opportunity/affirmative action:

Premera is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Premera seeks to attract and retain the most qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

If you need an accommodation to apply online for positions at Premera, please contact Premera Human Resources via email at or via phone at 425-918-4785.

Premera is hiring in the following states, with some limitations based on role or city: Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Maine, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, Wisconsin.

The pay for this role will vary based on a range of factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographic location, market conditions, and specific skills and experience.

The salary range for this role is posted below; we generally target up to and around the midpoint of the range.

National Salary Range:

$98,100.00 - $166,800.00

National Plus Salary Range:

$111,900.00 - $190,200.00

*National Plus salary range is used in higher cost of labor markets including Western Washington and Alaska.

We’re happy to discuss compensation further during the interview because we believe that open communication leads to better outcomes for all. We’re committed to creating an environment where all employees are celebrated for their unique skills and contributions.

raw.title: Fractional CFO / Financial Modeling & Capital Raising Specialist
raw.excerpt: This is a remote position.  Company: Blessed Accountants of GA, Inc.
raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Company: Blessed Accountants of GA, Inc. (BFG Tax) | Location: India, remote (Kochi preferred; qualified applicants
across India welcome)
Engagement: Independent consultant, fixed-fee project | Initial duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks
Reports to: Founder & CEO | Collaborates with: Finance, Delivery, Marketing, Sales and U.S. Securities & Corporate
Attorney
1. About BFG Tax
BFG Tax is a U.S.-based accounting, tax, payroll and financial advisory business established in 2004. The company is
planning industry-focused expansion supported by marketing, customer acquisition, technology, strategic partnerships and
centralized service delivery.
2. Position Overview
We seek a hands-on fractional CFO or corporate finance specialist in India to develop investor-ready financial models,
forecasts, valuation scenarios and capital requirements for a U.S. private fundraising initiative. This is not a routine
bookkeeping, tax compliance or accounting management position.
3. Fundraising Project
Stage Proposed funding objective
1 - Existing client relationships $50,000-$100,000
2 - Additional private investors Balance required to reach $250,000 cumulative
3 - Potential subsequent round $750,000
Overall potential financing Up to $1,000,000
Management is considering business loans, equity and convertible notes for the initial financing. The CFO will evaluate
financial implications; U.S. legal counsel will determine legal feasibility and securities compliance. The CFO must
independently assess whether proposed funding amounts are appropriate.
4. Key Responsibilities
A. Historical Financial Review
  • Review historical income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, liabilities and operating costs.
  • Reconcile records supplied by the Finance Manager; identify gaps and material assumptions.
  • Separate recurring, one-time, seasonal and project-based revenue and analyze revenue by service.
  • Assess cash balances, outstanding loans, working capital and U.S.-India cost arrangements.
B. Financial Modeling and Forecasting
  • Build an integrated, formula-driven and editable Microsoft Excel financial model.
BFG Tax | Recruitment - Fractional CFO Page 2
  • Prepare monthly 2027 forecasts, detailed January-June 2027 cash flow, a rolling 13-week cash forecast, and three-year
projections.
  • Produce conservative, base and growth scenarios, break-even, cash runway and sensitivity analysis.
  • Document data sources, drivers, assumptions and model checks.
C. Marketing and Customer Acquisition
  • Model the proposed January-June 2027 advertising budget of $155,000, subject to approval.
  • Analyze lead costs, lead qualification, conversion, onboarding, acquisition costs and recurring-revenue timing.
  • Test retention, service delivery costs, contribution margin and alternative marketing spend levels.
D. Capital Requirements and Use of Funds
  • Determine minimum viable capital needs and recommended financing schedule.
  • Produce use-of-funds and liquidity scenarios for $50,000, $100,000 and $250,000.
  • Assess operating reserves, funding milestones, and the timing and need for a later $750,000 round.
E. Financing Alternatives
  • Compare business loans, equity and convertible notes.
  • Model debt service, repayment, interest, dilution, conversion and subsequent fundraising effects.
  • Coordinate with securities counsel on S corporation constraints and permissible instruments; do not provide legal opinions.
F. Valuation and Investor Materials
  • Prepare supportable valuation methodologies and pre-/post-money capitalization scenarios.
  • Clearly distinguish total annual revenue from recurring revenue.
  • Prepare financial exhibits, risks, assumptions, sensitivities and presentation-ready schedules.
5. Required Deliverables
  • Historical financial review and findings memorandum.
  • Fully editable, integrated Excel model with transparent assumptions and formulas.
  • January-June 2027 cash-flow forecast and rolling 13-week cash forecast.
  • Three-year financial projections and conservative/base/growth scenarios.
  • Marketing and customer acquisition model.
  • Use-of-funds schedules for $50,000, $100,000 and $250,000.
  • Debt, equity and convertible-note financial comparison.
  • Valuation, capitalization and dilution scenarios.
  • Investor-ready financial summary and supporting exhibits.
  • Written recommendations on funding amount, timing and financial risks.
  • Management presentation and handover of all model files.
6. Required Qualifications
  • CA, CPA, CFA, MBA (Finance) or equivalent professional qualification; preferably 10+ years relevant experience.
  • Proven investor-ready modeling work for U.S. businesses, including financial statements and cash-flow analysis.
  • Advanced Excel skills, valuation, capitalization and scenario modeling.
  • Understanding of U.S. financial reporting and strong written/spoken English.
  • Availability for scheduled U.S. Eastern Time meetings.
BFG Tax | Recruitment - Fractional CFO Page 3
7. Preferred Experience
  • Fractional CFO or transaction advisory work for U.S. small and midsize businesses.
  • Private fundraising, recurring-revenue economics and professional services businesses.
  • U.S.-India outsourced operations and cross-border financial analysis.
  • Investor/lender due diligence; familiarity with Xero, QuickBooks or Zoho Books.
8. Timeline and Compensation
The engagement is expected to last approximately 4-6 weeks. An initial financial assessment and preliminary model are
expected within 1-2 weeks, followed by iterative review and final delivery. Candidates should propose a realistic milestone
schedule and fixed-fee quote, identifying payment milestones, assumptions, exclusions, revision costs and possible ongoing
advisory support.
The consultant is not authorized to solicit investors, negotiate securities transactions or receive transaction-based fundraising
compensation under this engagement.
9. Application Requirements
  • Resume or firm profile and summary of relevant U.S. work.
  • Two or three comparable project examples; redacted model sample where permitted.
  • Proposed approach, project timeline, fixed-fee quote and earliest start date.
  • References from relevant U.S. or international clients where available.
10. Selection Process
Shortlisted applicants will complete a technical interview covering minimum funding requirements, marketing-led cash
forecasts, a $100,000 debt-versus-equity comparison, valuation and dilution, and investor due diligence. A short paid
modeling exercise may be used for finalists.
11. Confidentiality and Ownership
Engagement is subject to signed confidentiality and consulting agreements. All BFG-specific models and deliverables must
be handed over in editable form, with ownership and permitted reuse governed by contract. Confidential company, client,
employee and investor information must be handled under approved security procedures.
BFG Tax | Blessed Accountants of GA, Inc. |

raw.title: Marketing Strategist, SEO and AI Search
raw.excerpt: Full-time | Remote, U. S.  | 9 a. m.  to 5 p. m.  Central Who We Are and What We Do We believe the best marketing comes from what a business owner already knows.
raw.description:
Full-time | Remote, U.S. | 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central

Who We Are and What We Do

We believe the best marketing comes from what a business owner already knows. Fluxe Digital Marketing is a content marketing agency that interviews business owners about their expertise, then turns one hour of their time each month into a month of content in their own voice. Since 2009 we have worked with more than 150 clients across more than 30 industries, from concierge medical practices to ecommerce brands.

Please take some time to learn about our mission and values. They drive everything we do.

Why This Role Exists

Search is changing. AI answers now handle more questions before anyone visits a site, so showing up in search no longer guarantees the click. We are hiring a strategist who knows search deeply and can work out what each client should do about it, then own the plan from start to follow-through.

If this sounds like the work you want to do, we’d like to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Lead search and AI visibility

  • Track each client’s rankings and how often AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Overviews mention and cite them.
  • Find out why traffic moved, and decide what to fix, refresh, write, or stop.
  • Turn that into a three-month plan our writers and web team can act on.
  • Write the copy that matters most for search: product, category, and landing page copy, content briefs, and titles and meta descriptions.
  • Write clear specs a developer can build from, such as page templates, redirects, and structured data.

Own each client’s plan

  • Write and update a three-month plan for each client you lead.
  • Turn every client call into clear next steps with an owner and a date, then follow up until each one is done.
  • Bring us ideas that grow each client’s results.

Run the monthly reports and call prep

  • Pull the numbers from GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and the ad platforms, and explain what changed and what we will do next.
  • Write the agenda for each client call so the team walks in ready.

You’ll start with about five clients and add more as you settle in, working with our head strategist, our editors, and our CRO and ads specialist. To see the kind of work our clients get, look at our case studies and how our process works.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Every client you lead has tracking in place and a search plan built from the data.
  • Your clients’ rankings, AI visibility, organic clicks, and the inquiries search brings in move in the right direction against where they started.
  • Every client you lead has a current plan, every commitment from a client call is tracked and closed, and reports and call prep arrive on time.

Logistics

  • Full-time, 100 percent remote position.
  • Working hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central time.
  • We expect to close applications by December 31, 2026, and may extend.

How We Hire

We keep our process simple and we pay you for your time on the test.

  1. Apply and answer the questions in the application.
  2. A 30-minute video call with our team, including a short screen-share walkthrough of one piece of your work.
  3. A short paid test project based on a real search situation.
  4. Two interviews: one about your career so far, and one with our founder.

What to send: your resume, your LinkedIn profile, a search audit, plan, or report you are proud of, and one page or landing page you wrote for search (anonymized is fine).

A note on AI: we use AI every day and expect you to as well. In your answers, give us the specifics only you would know: the situation, the numbers, and what changed. Polished but general answers will not move forward.

Interested? We’d love to hear from you!

Fluxe Digital Marketing is an equal opportunity employer.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • At least three years of hands-on SEO strategy, at an agency or in-house, where you owned the plan and the results for at least a few sites or clients.
  • Weekly use of Ahrefs or Semrush, plus GA4 and Google Search Console.
  • Experience diagnosing a traffic drop or a ranking problem, including technical causes.
  • A working understanding of how AI search tools choose what to cite, and experience tracking it.
  • Strong writing for search, including page copy, landing page drafts, content briefs, and titles and meta descriptions, with samples you can share.
  • Writing that a busy business owner can read once and act on.
  • Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, along with the judgment to know when the output is wrong.
  • Strong organization. You track every open item and nothing slips.
  • Based in the U.S. and able to work 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central time.

Preferred

  • Experience with healthcare or financial services clients.
  • Experience with ecommerce SEO on Shopify.
  • Experience leading SEO through a site migration or platform change.
  • Experience with Ahrefs Brand Radar or another AI visibility tracker.
  • Experience writing conversion copy for ads or promotional email.
  • Experience presenting a report to a client on a call.
  • You have built an AI workflow or agent that took over repeat work.

Benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, with Fluxe paying 50 percent of the premium.
  • Regular performance reviews, with opportunities for pay increases as you grow in the role.
  • Paid time off and 13 paid company holidays. Time off is planned ahead with the team so client work stays covered.
  • Fully remote.
  • No nights or weekends.

raw.description:
As a member of the Data Platform Reliability Services team, this role is responsible for monitoring operational signals and ticket queues, troubleshooting and resolving routine production issues, and escalating more complex issues to senior team members and engineering teams. The analyst will also help identify recurring issues and opportunities to proactively improve platform reliability.
This is an early-career role designed for someone who has a strong technical aptitude, enjoys troubleshooting problems, and is interested in developing their skills in data platforms, cloud technologies, automation, and reliability operations.

The Day-to-Day

  • Monitor Data Platform services, alerts, and support queues, ensuring incidents and service requests are acknowledged, prioritized, and addressed within established SLAs.
    • Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues using established procedures, technical documentation, and available monitoring and support tools.
    • Escalate issues when appropriate, gathering relevant technical information and working with senior Reliability and engineering team members through resolution.
    • Identify recurring incidents and operational patterns and contribute to proactive solutions that reduce repeat issues and improve Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).
    • Maintain operational documentation and runbooks to improve troubleshooting, escalation, and resolution of common Data Platform issues.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support and coordinate production deployments and change activities as experience and knowledge of the Data Platform grows.
    • Communicate and coordinate incident status, service impacts, and resolution progress across technical teams and business partners.
    • Partner with senior Reliability team members on automation and process improvements that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.
    • Explore and apply AI-enabled tools and automation to improve monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and other Data Platform Reliability activities.

raw.title: Horizon: Infrastructure Engineer (Senior)
raw.excerpt: We’re seeking a skilled Infrastructure Engineer to build the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness.
raw.description:
We’re seeking a skilled Infrastructure Engineer to build the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness.

Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure.

Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success.

What you’ll do

We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include:

  • Design and implement cloud architecture.

  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi.

  • Build CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines.

  • Continuously deploy to AWS cloud and air-gapped environments.

  • Monitor applications/services with OpenTelemetry, Sentry, and SigNoz.

  • Enforce CMMC compliance policies and rules.

  • Manage secrets and configuration.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with strong Software Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

  • You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage.

  • You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build.

  • You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed.

  • You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding.

  • You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

  • You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited.

Why work with us

  • We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished.

  • Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

  • We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

  • We’re remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub.

  • We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

  • We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

  • We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Important skills

  • Expert in Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi or Terraform.

  • Expert in Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Expert in CI/CD and DevSecOps with GitHub Actions.

  • Proficiency in AWS and/or other cloud services.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and Go.

  • Proficiency with networking.

  • Familiar with cybersecurity compliance frameworks like CMMC, PCI, or SOC.

  • Familiar with Single Sign-on and Identity Providers (IdP) like Authentik and Keycloak.

  • Experience deploying to air-gapped environments.

  • Experience self-hosting on bare metal servers.

Nice to have

  • Familiar with working in monorepos.

  • Experience with Change Data Capture.

  • Experience with IoT devices and sensors.

  • Digital signal processing experience.

  • Geospatial analysis and GIS experience.

What we offer

  • Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first.

  • Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected.

  • 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones.

raw.title: Machine Learning Engineer — Training Optimization
raw.excerpt: About the Role We’re looking for an ML Engineer focused on training optimization to help us scale and improve large-scale model training.
raw.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for an ML Engineer focused on training optimization to help us scale and improve large-scale model training. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production, optimizing training pipelines for speed, stability, and cost—while collaborating closely with researchers pushing model architecture and capability forward.

This is a high-impact role with real ownership: your work directly affects how fast we can iterate, how large we can scale, and how efficiently we deploy new models.

What You’ll Do

  • Optimize large-scale model training pipelines (throughput, convergence, stability, and cost)

  • Improve distributed training strategies (data, model, and pipeline parallelism)

  • Tune optimizers, schedulers, batch sizing, and precision (bf16 / fp16 / fp8)

  • Reduce training time and compute cost via profiling, bottleneck analysis, and systems-level improvements

  • Collaborate with researchers on architecture-aware training strategies

  • Build and maintain robust training infrastructure (checkpointing, fault tolerance, reproducibility)

  • Evaluate and integrate new training techniques (e.g. gradient checkpointing, ZeRO, FSDP, custom kernels)

  • Own training performance metrics and continuously push them forward

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience training large neural networks (LLMs or similarly large models)

  • Hands-on experience with training optimization (not just model usage)

  • Solid understanding of:

    • Backpropagation, optimization algorithms, and training dynamics

    • Distributed systems for ML training

  • Experience with PyTorch (required)

  • Comfort working close to hardware (GPUs, memory, networking constraints)

  • Ability to move fluidly between research ideas and production-ready code

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale distributed training (multi-node, multi-GPU)

  • Familiarity with DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron, or custom training stacks

  • Experience optimizing training on AMD or NVIDIA GPUs

  • Contributions to open-source ML infrastructure or research codebases

  • Exposure to non-Transformer architectures (RNNs, hybrid models, etc.)

Why Join Us

  • Real ownership at Series-A stage — your work shapes the company’s trajectory

  • Work on cutting-edge models and training systems at scale

  • Small, highly technical team with fast feedback loops

  • Strong emphasis on engineering quality and research rigor

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful equity

raw.title: Customer Delivery Manager
raw.excerpt: As a Customer Delivery Manager at vCluster Labs, you aren't just keeping a project plan up to date; you are the person who turns a signed AI Cloud deal into a platform that's live, consuming GPUs, and ready to expand.
raw.description:
As a Customer Delivery Manager at vCluster Labs, you aren't just keeping a project plan up to date; you are the person who turns a signed AI Cloud deal into a platform that's live, consuming GPUs, and ready to expand. Our AI Cloud engagements are growing in number and complexity, and you will own each one from kickoff to handoff: the plan, the timeline, the scope, and the call when something is about to slip. You'll sit at the center of our AEs, AI infrastructure architects, customer engineering team, and executive leadership and make sure every customer always knows exactly where they stand.

As a Customer Delivery Manager, your role will include:

  • Owning engagements end to end: You own timeline management, scope, and outcome for every active AI Cloud engagement, from kickoff to handoff. You set the cadence, run the working sessions, and keep the work moving.

  • Building implementation plans customers trust: You'll write the plans our customers ask for, with prerequisites, dependencies, milestones, and change management built in. When scope shifts, you run change control.

  • Holding the team accountable: You depend on AEs, architects, and engineers internally and on customer teams externally. You chase the inputs that block progress, follow up on every open request, and escalate early when success is at risk.

  • Tracking GPU consumption: Revenue depends on consumption. You'll track when strategic accounts expect GPUs, whether they've landed, and when customers plan to deploy on our platform, even between active engagements, so we know who is consuming what they bought and where they can grow.

  • Keeping leadership informed: You'll own a weekly executive summary of every engagement: where it stands, what's at risk, and what you need. When something needs escalation, you make the ask and the next steps unmistakable.

  • Improving how we deliver: You'll spot where our delivery motion breaks, push back when something isn't working, and drive the process changes that fix it.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Multi-party delivery experience: You've run multi-month engagements across several internal and external parties, with real change control and governance. Internal-only project management won't be enough here.

  • Infrastructure fluency: Working knowledge of Kubernetes and data center infrastructure. You can follow a technical customer call and push it forward without needing to make the technical decisions yourself.

  • Executive communication: You can turn a messy engagement into a summary an executive reads in two minutes, and you can articulate an escalation and exactly what it needs.

  • Backbone: You're comfortable pushing back on peers, customers, and leaders, and you advocate for process change when the current way isn't working.

  • Customer delivery roots: A background in technical account management, professional services delivery, consulting engagement management, or management consulting.

  • Global flexibility: Based in North America (EMEA considered), and comfortable flexing early or late to work with customers and teammates in Europe.

Bonus points for:

  • AI Cloud experience: Time at an AI Cloud provider or an NVIDIA Cloud Partner.

  • Hyperscaler experience: Delivery or customer-facing work at a major cloud provider.

  • Infrastructure software services: Professional services or forward-deployed engineering at an infrastructure software company.

  • GPU ecosystem familiarity: You know how GPU capacity gets bought, delivered, and put to work.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: $160K - $190K
