EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:


EverHealth, a business within EverCommerce, provides modern end-to-end solutions for healthcare providers. Our open, connected ecosystem of solutions and services helps providers engage patients, increase revenue, improve business efficiency, and remain market competitive. We serve 72,000 healthcare practices and counting. EverHealth consists of five SaaS products; DrChrono, iSalus, CollaborateMD, Updox, and MDTec, combined these products offer end to end solutions for the health care industry.


Overview:

We are looking for an Account Executive to focus on Healthcare Software and RCM sales. This is a hunter role — we need someone who brings consistent prospecting and activity, builds pipeline through strategic and creative outreach, and drives opportunities through to close using a consultative, value-based sales approach. Our team is growing and we're looking for sales professionals passionate about helping us drive our mission to modernize healthcare with technology and AI. With 95% customer satisfaction and a best-in-class medical platform, we've built software that doctors, medical professionals, partners and patients love to use.


Responsibilities:

  • Drive consistent prospecting and outbound activity to build and maintain a strong, self-sourced pipeline — don't rely on inbound flow alone
  • Take a strategic and creative approach to pipeline generation (targeted outreach, referrals, networking) to uncover new opportunities in independent medical practices
  • Become a product expert and learn to masterfully demonstrate the entire platform from scheduling to the clinical workflow to billing using both a computer and iPad
  • Run a consultative, value-based sales process from first conversation through close — diagnose practice needs and tie our platform to measurable business outcomes
  • Maintain account and opportunity updates within Salesforce
  • Serve as a role model and mentor for new team members and help them achieve success
  • Send out world-class proposals and get back signed contracts
  • Use the latest and greatest technology to get your job done; including Gmail, Salesforce, Groove, MS Office, Zoom and more.
  • Reach and/or exceed monthly quota
  • Participate in a winning and supportive team environment

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • Demonstrated hunter mentality — proven ability to self-generate pipeline through proactive prospecting, not just work inbound leads
  • 2+ years of EHR experience is preferred
  • 2+ years of experience in a full-cycle sales role (prospecting through close)
  • Knowledge of SaaS and/or subscription-based business sales models
  • An understanding of the RCM industry and services, preferred
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding against quota and outlined metrics
  • Salesforce experience
  • Strong communication, negotiating, and time management skills with excellent interpersonal skills
  • Skilled in consultative, value-based selling — able to diagnose customer problems and position solutions around business impact, not just features
  • High energy, company first, positive attitude: Passionate about this opportunity and making a massive impact in the healthcare world
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • A college degree or equivalent business experience

Where:
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States -- if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


Benefits & Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 401k with company match
  • Annual wellness stipend
  • Flexible and generous paid time off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation:

The On Target Earnings (base + commission) for this position is $140,000 to $150,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

raw.description:
About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

As a Deployment Strategy Director at Abridge, you will play a critical role in ensuring the successful deployment and implementation of Abridge products and services. You will be the primary point of contact for our Implementation workstream and you will be the driving force behind seamless project execution. You’ll use your exceptional communication skills as you work closely with the Abridge team, internal, and external stakeholders to deliver projects on time, while exceeding the needs and expectations of our clinicians.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead new site, product implementations, and large scale expansion events. Serve as the primary point of contact for Abridge’s counterparts during their new and ongoing product implementation deployments.

  • Own the creation, coordination, and execution of project plans, in collaboration with internal and external cross-functional teams.

  • Accountable for leading through each of the project phases, including kickoffs, technical configuration, testing, clinician training, go-live, and post-live success.

  • Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop contingency plans as needed.

  • Push our goals forward with a focus on new site activations and ongoing feature and product adoption. You’ll develop the implementation strategy as well as execute critical work efforts, either yourself or managing teams to execute dependent work

  • Collaborate within the broader company to identify and implement areas for process and tool improvements in a dynamic and growing environment.

  • Participate in the creation of repeatable processes that will scale to build a thriving Kaiser team and function at Abridge.

What You’ll Bring

  • Have a track record of driving successful healthcare technology implementation projects from initiation to completion.

  • Experience in both new site implementation as well as driving ongoing implementation efforts with a focus on product implementation and product adoption.

  • Both an exceptional strategist as well as an executor. You’ll own the implementation methodology for our accounts as well as the execution of the Implementation efforts. This will be both as a direct contributor as well as managing scaled teams for work efforts.

  • Are extremely organized and seek continuous process improvement. You’re able to manage multiple priorities at once, while maintaining attention to detail and quality in a high-speed and results driven environment.

  • Build strong relationships with various stakeholders, to ensure a long lasting partnership in alignment with our Partner Experience principles and high caliber of service.

  • Use data to inform all aspects of your work. Data drives our decisions, recommendations, is an early indicator of issues, and tells the story of our partnership and success with Abridge.

  • Have the ability to smell smoke and escalate early, with proposed solutions. You are creative and scrappy with strong problem solving skills, tactful conflict resolution skills, and a bias to action.

  • Have 7+ years of experience in project management, with a focus on software deployment and implementation.

This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in our San Francisco office, with flexibility for remote work on other days. Please note that approximately 20% travel is expected for this position.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

This role owns the commercial strategy, customer experience, pipeline and business results for the International Academics segment. At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs—the human touch. Job Description Your role: Commercial academic relationships and account strategy • Build and maintain trusted, senior relationships with leading academic medical centers, research institutions, universities and scientific societies in the focus markets. • Personally own a portfolio of about 20 strategic academic collaborations, from identification and structuring through governance, delivery and renewal. • Develop flagship, multi-year and cross-modality commercial partnerships and enterprise solutions, including differentiated customer experience and co-location models where appropriate. • Use proven models from the United States and Canada and scale them to international accounts. • Establish reference and showcase sites that demonstrate GE HealthCare solutions, customer outcomes and innovation adoption, with any research claims or scientific outputs led and approved through Scientific Affairs and the appropriate functions. International Academics commercial framework • Develop and own the international academic commercial framework: one engagement model, standard work for academic account management, rules of engagement, key performance indicators (KPIs) and governance, including executive and C-suite governance for strategic accounts. • Segment academic accounts, including research-active private accounts, and define targeted value propositions and growth plans for each segment. • Lead with differentiated entry points, such as care pathways, theranostics, photon-counting CT, nuclear medicine, AI and areas such as human performance and longevity. • Continuously improve the framework based on results, customer feedback and learnings from the United States and Canada. Country orchestration • Work hand in hand with country and zone leadership teams to embed academics in every focus country plan and in plans for the top 50 global academic accounts. • Orchestrate the framework across countries, aligning country commercial teams, segment and care pathway leaders, product teams and services behind shared academic priorities. • Coordinate a virtual network of country academic account leads, clinical specialists and regional academic leaders, with clear roles and accountability. • Share best practices and results across markets, and escalate and resolve barriers to collaboration quickly. Scientific Affairs partnership • Partner closely with Scientific Affairs while maintaining clear separation of commercial and research activities and following the agreed Research-Commercial rules of engagement. • Align commercial stakeholder mapping and engagement plans with the Scientific Affairs-led KOL framework. • Support adoption of new product introductions at academic accounts through coordinated commercial launch planning, customer readiness and white-glove application and service support • Translate existing, approved evidence and scientific outputs into compliant commercial value propositions and customer communications in partnership with Scientific Affairs, Marketing, Legal, Regulatory and Compliance. • Identify customer needs or opportunities related to research, grants, evidence generation, publications, symposia or scientific meetings and refer them to Scientific Affairs for assessment, ownership and execution. Commercial performance • Own orders, revenue and margin targets for the international academic segment, and grow GE HealthCare’s share of wallet in target academic accounts. • Build and manage the international academic commercial pipeline, and run a disciplined cadence of account plans, opportunity reviews and forecasts. • Work with country commercial teams to close large, multi-year academic deals. • Ensure all engagements follow research-commercial policies and quality, regulatory and integrity standards. Your profile: Required • A master’s degree or higher, such as a PhD, MD, MBA, MS or MPH, or equivalent professional experience • Significant progressive commercial or general-management leadership experience in complex healthcare, medtech or academic-health-system environments • Established, credible relationships with academic leaders, KOLs and research institutions in several of the focus markets • A proven record of developing and closing large, multi-year, multi-modality healthcare solutions or strategic commercial partnerships • Experience designing and rolling out frameworks, engagement models or standard work across multiple countries • Strong understanding of academic health-system operations, capital and technology investment decisions, procurement and complex enterprise selling • The ability to orchestrate complex, matrixed organizations across countries and functions, including close work with scientific, medical, legal and compliance teams • Excellent executive engagement, communication and negotiation skills • A strong commitment to Research-Commercial separation, compliance and integrity • Fluent English, and willingness to travel internationally about 50 percent of the time Preferred • Experience leading academic or enterprise accounts across Europe and Asia-Pacific • Knowledge of advanced imaging, theranostics, nuclear medicine, photon-counting CT or AI • Experience using Salesforce, commercial analytics and data-visualization tools to drive account execution • Additional languages relevant to the focus markets This role can be remote based anywhere in Europe or EEU. About us GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally. We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health - digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world. Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. GE HealthCare - Creating a world where healthcare has no limits Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No At GE HealthCare, we see possibilities through innovation. We’re partnering with our customers to fulfill healthcare’s greatest potential through groundbreaking medical technology, intelligent devices, and care solutions. Better tools enabling better patient care. Together, we are not only building a healthier future but living our purpose to create a world where healthcare has no limits.

Rolle: Sales Development Representative
Standort: Hybrid / Full Remote (Homeoffice in Österreich oder Deutschland / Wien/ Hamburg)
Die Mission:Eine digitale Welt ohne Barrieren

Bei Accessiway sind wir nicht einfach nur ein SaaS-Unternehmen; wir sind ein Scale-up, das mit Lichtgeschwindigkeit wächst und ein ehrgeiziges Ziel verfolgt: Technologie für alle zugänglich zu machen – ohne „Wenn“ und „Aber“. Wir glauben, dass Barrierefreiheit kein einfaches Häkchen auf einer Checkliste ist, sondern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen die Welt erleben und gestalten.

Als Sales Development Representative (SDR) baust du nicht einfach nur Kontaktlisten auf oder telefonierst Leads ab. Du bist der erste Berührungspunkt mit unserer Vision, der strategische Türöffner für Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Inklusion und die Schlüsselperson, die aus ersten Gesprächen echte Business-Chancen und konkreten gesellschaftlichen Impact entstehen lässt.

Was wir dir bieten (Über die üblichen Versprechen hinaus)

  • Echten Impact: Deine Arbeit legt den Grundstein für die digitale Transformation von Unternehmen und trägt direkt dazu bei, dass deren Produkte für mehr als 1,3 Milliarden Menschen weltweit nutzbar werden.

  • Ein Spitzen-Team & echte Verbindungen: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives, dem Marketing-Team und internen Stakeholder:innen zusammen – unterstützt durch regelmäßige Team-Events und interne Initiativen, die den Zusammenhalt stärken.

  • Autonomie, Growth & Ownership: Wir pflegen eine Kultur, in der deine Ideen zählen. Du erhältst viel Raum für persönliches Wachstum, Eigenverantwortung und tägliches Lernen in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

  • Radikale Inklusion: Wir sind ein dynamisches, internationales und inklusives Team mit mehr als 15 Nationalitäten, in dem Vielfalt aktiv gelebt wird.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Profitiere von einem flexiblen Arbeitsmodell (Full Remote oder Hybrid – ganz nach deinen Bedürfnissen), das dein Privatleben ebenso respektiert wie deine berufliche Effizienz.

Deine Mission bei Accessiway

Indem du das Fundament für unser Neukundengeschäft legst, konzentrierst du dich auf:

  • Lead-Generierung & Qualifizierung: Identifikation und Qualifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten durch gezielte Outbound-Aktivitäten (Calls, E-Mails, LinkedIn) sowie die Bearbeitung von Inbound-Anfragen.

  • Demo-Koordination & Pipeline-Aufbau: Planung und Organisation qualifizierter Produkt-Demos für unsere Account Executives, um den gesamten Verkaufsprozess optimal vorzubereiten und voranzutreiben.

  • Interne Synergien: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Account Executives, dem Marketing und weiteren internen Teams, um unsere gemeinsamen Verkaufsergebnisse zu maximieren.

  • CRM & Struktur: Konsequente Nutzung unseres CRM-Systems für eine strukturierte Verwaltung von Pipeline, Forecasts und täglichen Aktivitäten.

  • Markttrends & Regulierungen: Ständiges Auf-dem-Laufenden-Bleiben über aktuelle Trends, den Markt und Regulierungen (wie RGAA / EAA / BITV) im Bereich der digitalen Barrierefreiheit.

  • Sales-Kultur & Wachstum: Eine proaktive, neugierige und lernbereite Arbeitsweise, mit der du aktiv zum Wachstum und zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Sales-Teams beiträgst.

Was wir bei dir suchen

  • Du bringst 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in Sales-Rollen oder in der Lead-Generierung mit.

  • Du bist hochmotiviert, stark ergebnisorientiert und zeichnest dich durch eine hohe Belastbarkeit sowie Resilienz im Vertriebsalltag aus.

  • Du verfügst über hervorragende Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Beziehungsfähigkeiten, mit denen du potenzielle Kund:innen schnell abholst und begeisterst.

  • Du zeichnest dich durch ein hohes Maß an Organisationsfähigkeit und Selbstständigkeit aus, um deine Arbeit in einem dynamischen, stark wachsenden Umfeld effizient zu strukturieren.

  • Du verfügst über gute Grundkenntnisse in CRM-Systemen und modernen Sales-Tools (wie HubSpot, Lemlist, Lusha oder Apollo).

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Bonuspunkte, wenn:

  • Du bereits Erfahrung im B2B-, SaaS- oder Tech-Vertrieb gesammelt hast.

  • Du ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an digitalen, Web- oder IT-Lösungen mitbringst.

  • Du ein ehrliches Interesse und eine hohe Sensibilität für digitale Barrierefreiheit, Inklusion und gesellschaftlichen Impact mitbringst.

Bist du bereit, das Wachstum eines sinnstiftenden Projekts voranzutreiben?Bewirb dich jetzt – Werde Teil des Accessiway-Teams!

Das finale Angebot wird auf der Grundlage objektiver, geschlechtsneutraler Kriterien festgelegt (insbesondere relevanter Berufserfahrung, Senioritätsstufe und für die Stelle erforderlicher Kompetenzen), die im Einklang mit unserem internen Stellenbewertungssystem einheitlich auf alle Bewerber:innen angewendet werden. Bewerber:innen können weitere Informationen zu den Kriterien anfordern, die für die Gehaltsentwicklung innerhalb dieser Spanne herangezogen werden.

Accessiway ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir feiern Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeiter:innen zu schaffen.

raw.description:
Job Title: Enterprise Architect, Integrated Eligibility and Enrollment (IE&E) Program
Work Arrangement: Fully remote within the United States; 35 to 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday between 7:45 AM and 4:30 PM Eastern Time (client working days only; no client holidays)
Location: Remote, United States (Eastern Time schedule)
Employment Type: W-2, 35 to 40 hours per week
Pay Rate: $60-$80/hr (W-2)
Engagement Type: Contract, January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2027, with possible extension
Final Interview: Client interview by phone or in person

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring an Enterprise Architect on behalf of the client, a state government agency, to support the state human services agency's Integrated Eligibility and Enrollment (IE&E) program. The Enterprise Architect helps the state build a modern, responsive, stable and secure infrastructure for IE&E program work, providing guidance, recommendations and technical expertise on enterprise architecture processes and practices across the application, technology and information architecture domains.

The engagement covers architecture leadership, governance and technical deliverables across four workstreams: Governance and Agile Integration, DataOps Modernization, Microsoft Stack Expansion, and Legacy Workflow Retirement. The Enterprise Architect is a member of the state's Enterprise Architecture Office, reports to the Director of Enterprise Architecture, and works with state enterprise architects and solution providers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop technology and architecture roadmaps and implementation plans, plus analysis and readiness plans for adopting new processes or technologies.
  • Produce enterprise reference and logical architecture diagrams (current and future state), integration architecture, system integration and data-flow diagrams, and architecture vision documentation for business partners.
  • Carry out architecture governance work and take part in the Enterprise Architecture Review Board or similar change control boards for architecture changes.
  • Prepare architecture gap analyses and document alternatives analyses when needed.
  • Advise the state on architecture changes to its integrated eligibility and enrollment systems, its comprehensive child welfare information system (CCWIS) and its customer communication and notification platforms.
  • Provide input to and review RFPs and contracts, support procurements by reviewing demonstrations and bid submissions, and support service level agreements with solution vendors and internal service providers across the human services agency's departments.
  • Define infrastructure, application, cloud-services and data-services non-functional requirements, and review design documents (DDI).
  • Where needed, deliver Governance and Agile Integration architecture (enterprise governance architecture, architecture decision frameworks, Agile-enterprise integration architecture), DataOps Modernization architecture (data ingestion, entity resolution, data quality, lineage, metadata and semantic layer) and Legacy Workflow Retirement architecture (legacy system inventory and assessment, transition-state, decommissioning and cutover/rollback architecture).
  • Prepare CMS certification artifacts when applicable, and provide data governance assistance on assigned projects.
  • Deliver a weekly status report and scrum to the Director of the Enterprise Architecture Office, and attend, and when appropriate lead, design sessions, steering committee meetings and project meetings.
  • Attend a monthly engagement meeting with the state's enterprise architecture staff, and other meetings when requested.
  • Work on state-provided tools: a state-issued computer, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Visio Professional and Azure DevOps.

Requirements

Required:

  • Experience working within an architecture framework such as TOGAF or FEAF.
  • Experience working within at least two architecture domains: business architecture, application architecture, information/data architecture and technology architecture.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work within a team, meet shifting deadlines and work within a set budget.
  • Current annual cybersecurity awareness and HIPAA training certificates (copies are submitted to the client with your resume), or the ability to complete both before submission; the client's annual compliance training must also be completed and kept current during the engagement.
  • Three professional references, submitted with the application, who can speak to your enterprise architecture work.
  • Available 35 to 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday between 7:45 AM and 4:30 PM Eastern Time, for the full 12-month term.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States; work cannot be performed from outside the United States; W-2 only (no C2C or 1099).
  • Must pass a national criminal background check, sign the client's acceptable use and confidentiality terms, work only on client-provided systems, disclose any conflict of interest and any planned use of AI tools in the work, and not use AI meeting assistants in client meetings.

Preferred:

  • Enterprise architecture experience on state integrated eligibility and enrollment systems or other health and human services benefit systems.
  • Experience with child welfare information systems (CCWIS), customer communication and notification platforms, data warehouse or DataOps modernization, or Microsoft technology stack architecture.
  • TOGAF or a comparable architecture certification.
  • Prior work with a state central IT agency or enterprise architecture office.

How to Apply

Please send your resume, three professional references and copies of your certificates (TOGAF or other certifications listed on your resume, and your current HIPAA and cybersecurity awareness training certificates) to with "Enterprise Architect, IE&E" in the subject line. For each reference, include the name, title, organization, email address, phone number and the work the reference can speak to.

raw.title: Director of Growth
raw.excerpt: About Darkroom Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
raw.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a senior growth marketer to own acquisition and lifecycle for Shadow, the most advanced marketing agent in the world, and Darkroom, our tech-enabled growth firm. Ad Age recently described us as “if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI.” Your job is to turn the attention we create into sign-ups, paying users and qualified leads. Shadow comes first.

This is a media and lifecycle role. You run paid acquisition, own the funnel from first click to paying user, and keep testing until the numbers move. Paid media and lifecycle sit under you. You work closely with our SEO and creator teams, the Director of Content, sales and the Shadow product team, and you run the work in Shadow from day one.

This is a New York-based role operating in the EST Time Zone, on-site at our NYC office, and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you'll own

  1. Paid Acquisition: Meta, Google, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok, and new platforms. The budget split, audiences, bidding, and testing priorities.

  2. Creative Testing: A standing testing system for messages, use cases, audiences and formats. Brief the creative team, scale what works, and kill what doesn’t.

  3. Content Distribution: Turn our weekly long-form and short-form video content into paid distribution that brings people to Shadow.

  4. Sign-up & Activation: The Shadow sign-up and onboarding flow, with Product: activation milestones, in-app prompts, and the path to the first useful result. Landing pages and conversion tests.

  5. Lifecycle: Email and HubSpot. Onboarding, engagement, win-back, and upgrade for Shadow, and lead nurture for Darkroom.

  6. Darkroom Inbound: Qualified leads, cost per lead, and routing with sales so leads turn into meetings.

  7. Measurement: From spend to sign-up to paid to retention for Shadow, and from spend to lead to pipeline for Darkroom. Attribution, incrementality tests, clean CRM data, a weekly growth review, and a monthly report to leadership.

  8. Team: Lead the lifecycle manager and paid media specialists day-to-day, and work tightly with the SEO and creator team so everything feeds the same funnel.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  1. 4+ years in growth or performance marketing, with paid budgets you managed yourself. You have scaled acquisition on Meta and Google and at least one of LinkedIn, TikTok or YouTube, and you can show what happened to CAC, conversion and revenue.

  2. You have grown a self-serve product: a SaaS, subscription or app where people sign up, activate and pay without talking to sales. You have moved activation and retention, not only the top of the funnel, and you have run lifecycle yourself: onboarding, nurture, segmentation and re-engagement, ideally in HubSpot.

  3. You know our world. DTC, e-commerce, performance marketing, AI tooling. Shadow’s users are marketers, so you can tell a strong ad from a weak one and explain why. B2B lead generation for an agency or services business is a strong plus.

  4. You are AI forward and already work with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar daily for analysis and execution, and have shipped real work with them. We are a Claude-first company.

Hard disqualifiers

  1. Less than 4 years of experience in growth or performance marketing.

  2. Never managed paid budgets yourself, only through agencies.

  3. No experience growing a self-serve product (SaaS, subscription or app).

  4. No ownership of acquisition targets like CAC, conversion, sign-ups or qualified leads.

  5. Experience mainly in events, partnerships or brand marketing.

  6. No experience using AI tools.



What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We're looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect everyone to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity and ownership, and we support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work.

  • In person in NYC: You'll work from our New York office at 40 Wall St, side by side with the CEO.

  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Finances and retirement: A 401(k) with company match and profit-sharing opportunities.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave for new parents.

  • Growth: A direct path to running a line of the business.

  • Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $180,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace. We are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

raw.title: Senior Security Consultant
raw.excerpt: Are you a cybersecurity professional with a passion for helping organizations build secure, compliant, and resilient environments?
raw.description:
Are you a cybersecurity professional with a passion for helping organizations build secure, compliant, and resilient environments? Join our growing team as a Senior Cybersecurity Consultant and work directly with clients to design and implement solutions that align with regulatory requirements, modern cloud infrastructures, and real-world threat scenarios.

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Consultant with expertise in regulatory compliance, cloud security, vulnerability management, attack surface management, incident response, security awareness training, and virtual CISO (vCISO) services. In this role, you will work closely with clients to assess risk, strengthen cybersecurity programs, and align security initiatives with industry frameworks such as NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls. You will conduct security assessments and cloud environment reviews, run vulnerability and attack surface management programs, deliver clear security reporting, and help develop and implement scalable security policies and technical controls. You will also use AI tools to sharpen your own analysis and help clients adopt AI securely.

Consider your day-to-day responsibilities in this role:

  • Conduct comprehensive cyber risk assessments to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and business impacts.

  • Lead cybersecurity assessments aligned with frameworks such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST 800-171, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.

  • Run vulnerability management programs for clients: configure and tune scanning, prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact (CVSS, EPSS, and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog), and work with client IT teams to drive remediation through closure.

  • Deliver attack surface management services, including external asset discovery, monitoring for exposed services and misconfigurations, dark web and credential exposure checks, and penetration test scoping and follow-up.

  • Evaluate and strengthen cloud security architectures across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.

  • Develop and implement security policies, technical controls, and remediation strategies.

  • Develop and implement security awareness training programs and assist clients in creating a culture of security.

  • Provide vCISO services including cybersecurity strategy development, governance leadership, and executive-level risk reporting.

  • Produce client-ready security reporting, including assessment findings, recurring vulnerability and attack surface reports, Microsoft Secure Score reviews, incident reports, and executive briefings that turn technical risk into prioritized business decisions.

  • Design and facilitate incident response plans and tabletop exercises to ensure clients are prepared for real-world threats.

  • Use AI tools to speed up security analysis, alert and phishing triage, and report development, and advise clients on secure AI adoption, including AI risk assessments and governance aligned with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity consulting or advisory services.

  • Strong understanding of cyber risk management, regulatory compliance, and cloud security principles.

  • Experience performing cyber risk assessments and developing prioritized remediation plans.

  • Background in delivering vCISO services or leading security program initiatives.

  • Skilled in developing and testing incident response plans and running tabletop exercises.

  • Practical experience using AI tools (such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude) in security work, plus working knowledge of AI security risks and governance frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Excellent communication and reporting skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive leadership and turn technical findings into clear, prioritized security reports.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP, or similar) are required.

  • Experience with GRC or Cyber Risk Management tools is preferred.

What you should know about Resultant:

  • Rezzers are humble, hungry, and smart. We solve big problems, serve lots of clients, and are entirely committed to delivering transformative outcomes.
  • Rezzers are team players, deeply dedicated to the mission of the organization and to helping everyone around us be successful.
  • Resultant compensates well, rewarding performance that delivers positive outcomes for our clients and ensuring incentives are aligned to achieve our goals.
  • Resultant leaders work hard, serving as a shining example of what it means to be a great Rezzer. They are servant leaders, helping their team to be successful in all possible ways.
  • We have a great benefits package including unlimited vacation, significant 401k contributions, and several opportunities to develop yourself.
  • We pride ourselves in having the best talent in the industry and hope that you’re up for the challenge!

What our team members say about us…

  • “I love our true empathy and concern for our clients, it's very rare and appreciated. It is a pleasure to be a part of an organization like Resultant.”
  • “I learn something new every single day, and I feel like I'm a part of building an organization that has legs. I appreciate that I'm consistently humbled by the talent and caliber of our team.”
  • “The culture of the company is amazing, and the climate of my team is great. The benefits that employees are offered are better than competitors, and the one-on-one presence that my team lead gives is extremely beneficial to me.”

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We embrace AI across everything we do, and that includes how you prepare for this interview. Feel free to use AI tools to research the role, practice your responses, and put your best foot forward. What matters to us is getting to know the real you — how you think, how you communicate, and what you genuinely bring to the table. Our interviews are designed to go deeper than any polished answer, so come curious and come as yourself without the support of an AI tool during our conversation.

Resultant is a modern consulting firm with a radically different approach to solving problems.

We don’t solve problems for our clients. We solve problems with them.

Through outcomes driven by data analytics, technology solutions, digital transformation, and beyond, our team works with clients in both the public and private sectors to solve their most complex challenges. We start by learning as much as we can about who they are, how they work, and what they’re striving for so we can feel their problems as our own. Partnering with our clients means their desired outcomes are always top of mind, their challenges and strengths guiding our efforts. We build client-focused relationships before we build unique solutions that blaze past expectations.

raw.title: EMEA - Data Programme Manager
raw.excerpt: About the role As a Programme Manager at Infinite Lambda, you'll be a pivotal force behind the successful delivery of large-scale, complex client projects for our most important clients.
raw.description:
About the role

As a Programme Manager at Infinite Lambda, you'll be a pivotal force behind the successful delivery of large-scale, complex client projects for our most important clients. You will be at the forefront of business transformation, holding ultimate accountability for project execution and owning the entire project lifecycle. You will ensure all projects and workstreams deliver tangible, measurable business value, on time and within budget, helping clients innovate and compete.

You are a key partner in our client relationships, working with our Account Managers to nurture long-term partnerships and spot new opportunities, contributing to the growth of our client accounts. You will use your positive and collaborative attitude to foster a culture of excellence, self-organisation, and high accountability across delivery streams. Your empathy and problem-solving skills will be essential as you guide your team to become more self-organised and accountable, celebrating successes along the way.

*NOTE: At Infinite Lambda, the role of Data Programme Manager is simply a local variation of the job title, internally the job title is Programme Manager.

  • Anticipated start date: Early January 2027

  • Interview process

    1. Intro call with TABP: 45 minutes

    2. Take-home technical assignment.

    3. Technical interview with Head of Programme Management: 60 minutes.

    4. Cultural interview with APAC General Manager: 45 minutes.

  • Location: Bulgaria and Hungary (Permanent contract), Slovakia & Romania (B2B contract)

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of client projects using Agile or Waterfall methodologies (depending on the best fit with the client), expertly tailoring your approach to the specific needs and phase of each project.

  • Develop and maintain clear scope and timelines, ensuring you can protect projects against scope creep and provide alternative solutions to recover as needed.

  • Gather, analyse, and document business requirements, working closely with clients and internal teams to translate business needs into clear, actionable specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Facilitate stakeholder interviews and discovery sessions to elicit needs and uncover pain points, constraints, and opportunities.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, including test planning, UAT coordination, and defect triage, ensuring delivered solutions meet agreed acceptance criteria.

  • Conduct data analysis and profiling to validate requirements, support migration activities, and inform data model and reporting design.

  • Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, clarifying scope, managing ambiguity, and communicating trade offs.

  • Proactively develop and champion creative, non-standard solutions to execution challenges, ensuring optimal recovery and continuous improvement in delivery standards.

  • Establish and uphold stringent project standards and governance models to ensure predictable, high-quality execution across all workstreams.

  • Facilitate steering committees and provide clear, trusted updates to executive sponsors.

  • Work with teams from both Infinite Lambda and the client to deliver projects, earning their trust and getting 360-degree feedback on feasibility and plans.

  • Leverage your technical understanding to constructively challenge assumptions, guide recovery plans, and facilitate trade-off decisions between engineering quality and delivery speed, ensuring alignment with overall project goals.

  • Create and maintain essential documentation (such as RAID Logs, RACI matrices, business requirement documents, and Gantt charts) and lead ceremonies like standups, retrospectives, and client presentations.

  • Proactively identify risks and remove roadblocks, helping the team find the pathway to excellence that earns the admiration and respect of your clients.

  • Track progress and communicate updates to stakeholders regularly through reports and presentations. Conduct project reviews and identify areas for improvement.

  • Deliver structured, clear, and professional communication, tailoring your style to best suit each client's environment, this is pivotal to how our clients perceive Infinite Lambda.

  • Maintain a safe and congenial working environment for your team.

  • Support with client prospects - meetings, follow up and relationship management.

  • Liaise with our staffing team to ensure visibility on what will be needed to deliver projects.

  • Work with Account Manager(s) to provide constant and stable visibility on accounts.

  • Provide active coaching and mentorship to delivery teams, helping them adopt best practices, adhere to project standards, and elevate their own delivery capabilities.

Requirements

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience leading complex client projects, with a focus on data warehouse migration and/or AI.

  • Consulting background.

  • Proven background in leading and managing projects from start to finish.

  • Demonstrated business analysis experience, eliciting requirements, process mapping, and translating business needs into clear technical and functional specifications.

  • Extensive experience with agile methodologies and continuous improvement.

  • Strong conceptual understanding of software engineering and data delivery principles (e.g., architectural patterns, tools, modern development practices) to effectively challenge, guide, and support technical leadership.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and people skills, able to articulate a compelling vision.

  • Experience working with fixed-cost projects as well as T&M.

  • Travel requirements for this role are mandated by the need of the client and depending on the client some travel is required.

Skills:

  • Proficiency in a variety of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello).

  • Strong business analysis toolkit: requirements gathering, process and workflow mapping, user story writing, and stakeholder workshops.

  • Exceptional problem-solving, conflict resolution, and change management skills.

  • Ability to break down complex projects into manageable tasks and create work breakdown structures.

  • Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Familiarity and practical experience with modern methodologies and the ability to choose and adapt the most suitable ones for the project.

Mindset:

  • Demonstrated ability to orchestrate the big picture while also managing the details.

  • A collaborative and positive approach to people and projects.

  • Willingness to take new directions and adapt to changing priorities.

Nice to have skills

  • Working knowledge of SQL and data warehousing concepts.

  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Omni, Sigma, Tableau, PowerBI).

  • Proven experience leading data warehousing and analytics projects, preferably migrations.

Soft skills

  • Servant leadership mindset with the ability to manage, motivate, inspire and support others.

  • Outstanding communication skills.

  • A considerate, curious, positive, naturally collaborative and supportive approach to people.

  • Proactivity regarding risk, issues and planning.

  • Ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Natural problem-solving attitude, facilitation skills, and creative thinking.

  • Proficient in English; French language skills are preferred.

Why join Infinite Lambda

  • We support your growth with dedicated learning time, access to top-notch resources and a knowledge-sharing culture;

  • You work autonomously here in a wholesome environment and get as much paid holiday as you need;

  • The projects are diverse and give you plenty of opportunity to experiment with new tech;

  • The benefits are plenty, with private health insurance, work-from-home budget, a company MacBook and more on the list.

▶ ▶ Submit your CV in English in PDF.

▶ ▶ Mind that as we are an international team, internal communication is in English.

Infinite Lambda is an equal opportunity employer. Our inclusive culture celebrates diversity and treats everyone with dignity and respect. Accordingly, our selection process will never discriminate against applicants on the grounds of any characteristics, such as disability, age, gender, sexual orientation, family status, race, faith or other.

Mainframe Network Engineering will be supporting a firmwide initiative to enable encryption for all data in transit. raw.title: Product Manager — Retention & Customer Value (B2B SaaS)
raw.excerpt: Precoro is an AI-powered B2B SaaS platform for procurement centralization and automation.
raw.description:
Precoro is an AI-powered B2B SaaS platform for procurement centralization and automation. We help 1,000+ companies in 80+ countries cut manual work, control spend across all subsidiaries and make better purchasing decisions.

Our customer base is growing fast — and so is the cost of losing a customer. Today, every CSM evaluates customer risk in their own way, EBRs look different from one account to the next, and we don't have a shared answer to two simple questions: how much does this customer cost us, and how much value are they actually getting?

We're looking for a senior, hands-on Product Manager — Retention & Customer Value to own churn and customer value as a business metric. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success and Sales: you'll set the process, own the numbers, and make sure product decisions protect real revenue.

What makes this role exciting?

  • You own the metric, not just a backlog. Churn, GRR/NRR and time-to-value are yours. CS, Product and Sales are your levers.

  • Real money on the line. Every decision you make is tied to revenue: which customers we can save, what it takes, and what it's worth.

  • Building from zero. There's no customer scoring, standardized EBR or cost-to-serve model yet — you'll design them and make them stick.

  • Senior scope with room to grow. This is a business role with a direct path toward COO/CRO-level responsibility as the company scales.

What you'll do

Predict and prevent churn

  • Build a standardized customer scoring process — product fit and churn probability based on tracked metrics, activities and events, not individual CSM judgement.

  • Standardize customer health evaluation and set up a clear process for working with at-risk accounts.

  • Build a forecast that shows how much revenue is at risk, which actions will save how much, and what we'll lose regardless.

Make customer value measurable

  • Implement a customer ROI calculation that becomes the central point of every EBR.

  • Standardize EBRs: key questions, who we talk to on the customer side (incl. C-level), what we show and what we agree on — so Precoro sets the agenda, not the customer.

  • Shorten time-to-value, starting from onboarding and implementation.

Own the economics of each customer

  • Implement tracking of implementation cost and ongoing cost-to-serve per customer.

  • Make business decisions on it — e.g., setting limits on how much we invest in a single account.

Turn churn signals into product decisions

  • Collect all churn-affecting requests and product gaps, and drive a clear decision on each. "Won't do" becomes a tracked risk factor, not a silent no.

  • Deliver the product gaps that are business-justified and directly reduce churn risk.

Stay hands-on

  • Join customer calls, listen to EBRs, dig into the data. Processes only change when you understand what really happens on the ground.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS in a cross-team, cross-department role (Product, Customer Success, RevOps, Business Operations or similar). B2C experience alone won't be a fit.

  • Hands-on experience with ARR, churn, GRR/NRR, customer cost and unit economics — you can build the model yourself, not just read the dashboard.

  • A track record of business-critical decisions that affected revenue, with measurable results you can point to.

  • Experience changing processes across teams — especially where nobody wanted to own the problem — and making the change stick.

  • Solid understanding of how Customer Success and product development work, and how to make them speak the same language.

  • Strong critical thinking, structured communication and confidence talking to customers' C-level.

  • English at B2+ level.

Nice to have

  • Product management experience.

  • Background in iPaaS, payments infrastructure, fintech or service companies where cost-to-serve is tracked closely.

  • Experience setting up customer health scoring or EBR/QBR programs.

Why Precoro?

  • Trust and ownership: no micromanagement — we value initiative and independent decision-making.

  • Real influence: direct impact on company revenue and on how Product, CS and Sales work together.

  • Learning and development: reimbursement for professional courses, lectures and other learning opportunities.

  • Flexible working hours: we focus on results, not hours at the desk.

  • 26 days off annually

  • Health and well-being: medical insurance and unlimited sick leave without a medical certificate.

  • Pet-friendly office in Kyiv.

  • Supporting Ukraine: we assist the Armed Forces and contribute to projects that bring victory closer.

Our hiring process

  1. Recruiter interview (45 min)

  2. Interview with the hiring manager — Nataliia (60 min)

  3. Test task

  4. Final decision

Ready to turn customer value into a number everyone can act on? We'd love to hear from you

Join a team that values trust, transparency, and open communication. You can read more about Precoro’s values at this link.

We foster an environment where everyone is encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive business growth!

Closing date for applications is: 7 December 2026

ACCA is committed to a workplace culture which is inclusive, diverse, human and connected.

We welcome applications from candidates who meet some but not all of the criteria listed below.

We’re currently looking for a Head of Continuous Learning & Members Support on a full time, fixed term contract until March 2028. This position sits within the Learning & Commercial team. We are flexible on the location of this role.

The Job


Reporting to the Director of Learning & Commercial, this role:


  • Is responsible for leading on the development and delivery of ACCA’s Professional Learning and Members’ Support portfolio, including development, performance and contribution to ACCA’s wider organisational objectives
  • Leads on the design, development and delivery of relevant and innovative professional learning products and ACCA’s digital CPD portfolio globally, ensuring it meets the evolving needs of members and enhances their professional development and satisfaction
  • Leads on managing relationships with ACCA’s global CPD partners, ensuring effective collaboration, high-quality delivery and the continued development of the CPD portfolio and membership benefits
  • Ensures that member insight, research, feedback and data are used systematically to inform the development and evolution of the Professional Learning and Members’ Support portfolio, identifying changing needs, emerging trends and opportunities to improve the member experience
  • Works collaboratively with Brand & Marketing and Relationship teams to identify and deliver strategic initiatives that grow ACCA’s professional learning portfolio, strengthen member engagement and maximise commercial opportunities
  • Manages financial and other resources effectively to maximise return on investment, including responsibility for the planning, budgeting, performance management and reporting of the professional learning and member support portfolio
  • Leads and develop a globally distributed team, fostering a high-performance culture, effective collaboration and a strong focus on delivery, continuous improvement and member satisfaction.

The Person

  • Relevant work experience, ideally in a strategic or continuing professional development role (experience of accountancy is desirable but not essential)
  • A proven track record of leadership in a senior role, with experience of delivering strategic objectives against agreed performance measures within a global organisation
  • Strong commercial acumen, with demonstrable experience of business development, identifying growth opportunities and delivering commercial outcomes
  • An active interest and strong understanding in professional learning, continuing professional development and evolving needs to financial professionals
  • Proven experience of using customer or member insight, research and data to shape products, services and propositions, improve customer experience and demonstrate measurable impact
  • Proven experience of building and managing effective strategic partnerships to deliver business objectives and measurable outcomes
  • Proven experience of leading, motivating and developing a high-performing team
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build credibility and engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, both internally and externally
  • Highly motivated, proactive and results-oriented, with the ability to demonstrate resilience, adaptability and sound judgement when leading complex and strategically important initiatives.

Our Benefits

We strive to create an environment where you can prioritise your wellbeing and so have designed our benefits to give you the flexibility and power to do so. Our core benefits include private healthcare, life assurance and income protection as well as a fantastic defined contribution pension scheme.

We provide an employee assistance programme and are proud to offer a financial wellbeing tool called Nudge, to our employees.

Our flexible benefits platform gives you the power to customise your benefit plan to suit your needs, you can choose to add a number of benefits including extra holidays, PMI family cover, cycle to work, Travel and Gym loans and more! You can also enjoy exclusive access to our discount site and wellbeing centre platform.

We are committed to equal opportunities across our recruitment activities and have a real commitment to ensuring the inclusion and well-being of all employees. We have a blended approach to working to support our employees to balance the needs of their job with other aspects of their life.

raw.title: Senior Clinical Research Associate - Oncology - CNS - France
raw.excerpt: Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose.
raw.description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior Clinical Research Associate at Worldwide

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you’ll play a key role in ensuring clinical studies are conducted to the highest standards of quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance. You’ll take ownership of site qualification, initiation, monitoring, management, and close-out activities, helping sites deliver accurate and timely study data.

You’ll work closely with investigative sites, Project Management, and global study teams, bringing your monitoring expertise to complex studies. Depending on the study, you may also step into a Lead CRA role, coordinating CRAs, reviewing monitoring reports, and supporting effective study delivery.

Your experience will also give you the opportunity to guide less experienced CRAs and site staff, contribute to study-specific tools and monitoring plans, and share your expertise through training, investigator meetings, and bid defences.


Where You'll Work

This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across France. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 6-8 days per month.

To best support our sites, we're seeking candidates who are based in France.


What You'll Do

  • Lead qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, site management, and close-out visits in line with study protocols, GCP, regulatory requirements, and SOPs.
  • Monitor site performance, data quality, protocol adherence, informed consent, subject safety, and investigational product accountability.
  • Review source documentation and CRFs across paper and electronic data capture systems, supporting sites with timely data query resolution.
  • Partner with sites to maintain essential regulatory and ethical documentation, Investigator Site Files, and required Trial Master File documentation.
  • Coordinate CRAs as a Lead CRA on global studies where required, including reviewing site visit reports and providing guidance and feedback.
  • Mentor less experienced CRAs and site staff, conduct accompanied visits where appropriate and deliver study or team training.
  • Collaborate with Project Management and study teams to evaluate deliverables, milestones, monitoring requirements, and site-related activities.
  • Contribute to Clinical Monitoring Plans, study-specific tools and templates, protocols, CRFs, investigator meetings, and bid defences.
  • Maintain strong communication with investigative sites and coordinate study materials to support effective study conduct from start-up through close-out.

What You'll Bring

  • Education and experience: An MD or Pharmacy qualification with at least 3 years of CRA experience; a four-year degree in a relevant medical, biological, physical, health, pharmacy, or related science with at least 5 years of CRA experience; or a two-year college curriculum/equivalent education or training, preferably in nursing or life sciences, with at least 7 years of CRA experience.
  • Experience in full-service monitoring PREFERRED.
  • Extensive knowledge of clinical research principles and processes, with a thorough understanding of GCP, ICH Guidelines, FDA and/or EU regulations, local regulatory requirements, and SOPs.
  • Strong knowledge of two to three therapeutic areas, with the expertise required to operate as a Lead CRA where appropriate.
  • Proven planning, organisation, communication, leadership, mentoring, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively manage competing priorities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, IxRS, and electronic data capture systems.
  • A valid current passport and driving licence, with willingness to travel as required by the role.
  • Fluency in the local language required for the country under responsibility, together with proficiency in spoken and written English.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us onLinkedIn.

raw.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

CRA executes clinical monitoring activities at clinical trial sites and monitors clinical trials in accordance with ICH guidelines and GCP, local regulations, and applicable SOPs.

CRA performs monitoring activities related to selection, initiation, conduct (recruitment, quality data collection) and timely completion of oncology/onco-hematology clinical trials within the assigned country/region.

May be assigned to CRA activities or start-up activities, depending on experience and project needs.

CRA is responsible for collaborating closely with the Country and Regional Clinical Study Teams to ensure study timelines are adhered to and required quality standards are maintained.

CRA identifies gaps and areas for improvement and propose CAPA.

CRA supports start-up and provides local expertise.

⠀

Essential Job Functions:

  • Complete appropriate therapeutic, protocol and clinical research training/CRA training to perform job duties.
  • Gain experience in BeOne and study procedures by working with experienced clinical staff.
  • Perform site selection and evaluation, supporting initial list of sites and recruitment targets.
  • Provide protocol and related study training to assigned sites.
  • Conduct onsite/remote pre-study, initiation, routine monitoring and closeout visits per monitoring plan and applicable SOPs.
  • Conduct co-monitoring visits, if required.
  • Create and maintain appropriate documentation regarding site management, monitoring visit findings and action plans by submitting regular visit reports, generating follow-up letters and other required study documentation, in accordance with ICH-GCP, BeOne standards and SOPs.
  • Manage sites and site performance by tracking regulatory submissions, recruitment, case report form (CRF) completion, and data query resolution.
  • Ensure copies/originals (as required) site documents are available for filing in the Trial Master File (TMF) and verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) / International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) and local regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure inspection readiness of the study and sites.
  • Establish regular lines of communication with sites and reports site progress, issues and proposed action to Clinical Operations.
  • Collaborate with Country and Regional Clinical Study Managers and clinical study sites to ensure timely delivery of study milestones (i.e., study startup, recruitment, database analyses, closeout, etc.).
  • Facilitate Study Compliance Visits (SCVs), site audits and/or inspections, as required.
  • Evaluate the quality and integrity of site practices – escalating quality and/or GCP issues with Investigators and internal team as appropriate.
  • Anticipate and identify site issues; propose corrective and preventative actions; identify gaps and utilize opportunities. Constantly strive for operating excellence, question status-quo and promote innovation.

⠀

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Not Applicable

⠀

Education Required:

  • BS in a scientific or healthcare discipline preferred.
  • At least 2 years of monitoring experience.

⠀

Qualifications:

⠀

Required:

  • Proficient knowledge of applicable clinical research regulatory requirements, i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP), International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines and associated regulatory guidelines.
  • At least 2 years of (CRA) monitoring experience in the pharmaceutical or CRO industry.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and other internal/external stakeholders as applicable.
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize and multi-task.
  • Effective time management skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.

⠀

Preferred:

  • Experience in oncology/onco-hematology global trials preferred.
  • Experience in oncology/onco-hematology trials preferred.

⠀

Computer Skills:

  • Efficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and use of a laptop computer and iPhone.

⠀

Travel:

  • Up to 60%.

Salary Range EU: 1,641,500.00 TRY - 2,051,900.00 TRY

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
