raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions tohundreds of thousands of businessesand empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer (L3)

About the job

This position is needed to scope, design, and deploy machine learning systems into the real world to ensure that communication across Twilio platforms remains legal, safe and wanted.

As a Staff Software oftware Engineer, you will work in the design and implementation phases of Cloud-based distributed systems built to seamlessly scale to several million transactions per day and automating processes. You will partner with Architects, Product Managers and Operational Leaders for developing anti-fraud/ anti-abuse systems for our customers.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code for our distributed systems and microservices, utilizing asynchronous communication patterns for optimal performance. Contribute to the design and implementation of highly scalable architectures, prioritizing reliability, performance, and future-proof growth.
  • Collaborate in defining and monitoring key Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) to ensure our systems deliver exceptional user experiences.
  • Learn and grow with your colleagues, actively participating in code reviews, knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Partner effectively with cross-functional teams, bridging the gap between technical vision and business goals. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Create clear and concise technical documentation, including design decisions, architecture diagrams, and best practices, for future reference and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and ensure timely response to production incidents and system outages.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 5+ years experience in designing, building and operating high-scale, mission critical cloud based production systems
  • 5+ years of experience with at least two programming languages such as Java, Scala, Python, Ruby or Go
  • 2+ years of experience leading teams of engineers in an agile environment.
  • 2+ years of Experience with distributed caching systems such as Redis or Memcached understanding common use cases and performance pitfalls
  • Proficient in concepts such as DDD, SOLID, Cloud Native Patterns, distributed systems and architecture. Capable of understanding pitfalls and anticipating common failure modes of a microservice environment
  • Strong communication skills: able to communicate effectively with technical and non technical stakeholders in english
  • Passion for new technologies and proven capability in analysis and problem-solving

Desired:

  • Track record as a full-stack engineer
  • Experience with AWS related technologies

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India (only in Karnataka, Tamil nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi).

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

raw.description:
About Jack Westin

Jack Westin is a leading Medical College Admissions Test (MCAT) preparation company which is known for crafting high quality, but free, practice materials. The MCAT tests students on the scientific reasoning skills and scientific knowledge which can be learned during typical undergraduate coursework.

MCAT Psych/Soc Curriculum Designer (Remote, Project-based)

Role Summary

The MCAT Psych/Soc Curriculum Developer is responsible for building lesson materials for Jack Westin's relaunched live MCAT courses, which launch in January 2027 with a new modular curriculum. This project-based role focuses on turning detailed lesson outlines into clear, engaging slide decks and student handouts for four Psych/Soc lessons across two topic blocks: Research Methods & Social Psychology and Neuroscience & Cognition. The Curriculum Developer works independently and collaboratively with our curriculum and instructor teams to deliver high-quality, teachable materials that follow Jack Westin's template and style standards.

Compensation Terms:

  • $300 per lesson, or $1,200 for all four lessons
  • Pay includes one round of revisions after review
  • All lessons due by January 1, 2027
  • Project-based contract
  • Work remotely with flexible scheduling

Primary Responsibilities
We're looking for a contractor to build four Psych/Soc lessons across two blocks.

Research Methods & Social Psychology

    • RM.1 Research Design & Social Influence: observational vs. experimental research, biases, statistical analysis, and related topics
    • RM.2 Stress, Identity & Society: mixed P/S topics taught through famous research experiments, with a close look at how those studies were designed

Neuroscience & Cognition

    • NC.1 Brain, Senses & Learning: a science lesson focused on clinical applications and content connections
    • NC.2 Memory, Perception & Cognition: a science lesson focused on clinical applications and content connections

Each lesson is a 3-hour live class. It opens with a case study, builds on key concepts from the prep work, shows interdisciplinary connections that are often tested together on the MCAT, and then moves into strategy, practice questions, and an AAMC passage. You'll turn a detailed lesson outline from our Director of Curriculum Design (often 10 to 20 pages per lesson) into clear, teachable material.

Slide & Handout Creation

  • Create a "Prep in 15" slide deck for each lesson, giving an overview of foundational and high-yield topics
  • Create an in-class slide deck covering the content portion of each live class (about 1.5 hours)
  • Build fillable student note handouts for both the Prep in 15 and the in-class lecture once slides are final
  • Follow Jack Westin's slide template and style guide throughout

Quality Assurance

  • Ensure content is accurate, clear, and aligned with the learning objectives in each lesson outline
  • Self-review lessons against Jack Westin's template and style standards before submission
  • Complete one round of revisions based on lead instructor feedback before final approval

Collaboration & Communication

  • Track all lessons and communicate with the team in ClickUp
  • Respond to lead instructor reviews, which are given within 2 business days of submission
  • Focus on lesson content only (quiz questions, homework, and passage selection are handled by other teams)
Qualifications

Education & Credentials

  • Strong command of MCAT Psych/Soc content, including research methods and neuroscience
  • A strong MCAT score is a plus

Experience

  • Experience teaching or tutoring the MCAT
  • Experience turning detailed outlines into lesson materials or slide-based instruction

Skills & Competencies

  • Ability to build clean, clear slides that follow a template and style guide
  • Strong understanding of how students learn MCAT Psych/Soc content
  • Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines
  • Responsive to feedback and comfortable with revision cycles
  • Proficiency with slide tools and ClickUp or similar project management tools

raw.description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

We’re looking for a talented LLM/Generative-AI Developer to join the AVA Team.

Working in an Agile, multi-disciplinary team, you will design, build, and fine-tune generative-AI services that power personalized, conversational experiences for our members. You’ll partner closely with product managers, UX designers, data scientists, and backend engineers to ship AI-driven features that enhance member engagement, self-service, and satisfaction.

This is an applied engineering role focused on building production LLM applications—RAG pipelines, agentic and tool-using workflows, and inference services—rather than foundational model research.

You don’t need to match every requirement. If you’ve shipped real LLM features in production and are excited by this work, we’d like to hear from you!

What's In It For You:

  • Competitive base salary plus performance bonus.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Flexible hours and a flexible workstyle policy.
  • The chance to shape AI-driven experiences for millions of AVA members across Canada.

What You'll Do:

LLM Engineering

  • Design and integrate LLM services (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, IBM Watson, etc.) for the AVA chatbot and feature releases.
  • Apply prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-use/agentic orchestration (function calling, structured outputs), and token-management best practices.

Evaluation & Quality

  • Build evaluation harnesses for LLM outputs — curated eval sets, automated scoring, and regression checks — alongside unit and integration tests, so prompt and model changes ship safely.

Infrastructure & CI/CD

  • Build and operate scalable inference pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Functions). Automate CI/CD (Azure DevOps) for rapid, reliable deployment of model updates and new features.

Data Ingestion & RAG

  • Ingest client data (PDF, Excel, CSV) into Azure AI Search/Pinecone; design index schemas, skillsets, and hybrid vector-keyword queries.
  • Build frameworks for new client data, demographics, and expression rules.
  • Document runbooks and validate datasets and access-control rules.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Instrument tracing and monitoring (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor) for model performance, cost, and safety.
  • Set up alerts for latency, error-rate, and token-usage spikes.

Safety, Compliance & Governance

  • Implement content moderation, PII redaction, prompt-injection defences, bias mitigation, and company-specific privacy and security compliance.
  • Produce audit logs and maintain documentation for regulatory reviews.

Collaboration & Mentoring

  • Partner with UX to define conversational flows and UI components.
  • Mentor peers on LLM best practices and contribute to internal knowledge bases and tech talks.

Continuous Improvement

  • Run A/B testing and analytics to measure impact on member satisfaction and portal KPIs.
  • Identify automation opportunities across the software-development lifecycle.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years in software or ML engineering, with 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping LLM/generative-AI applications in production.*
  • Bilingual in both French and English, oral and written.
  • Demonstrated depth of applied GenAI work (shipped RAG systems, chatbots, agents, or inference services).
  • Strong hands-on experience with the core stack: Node.js/Express (REST APIs, async patterns); LLM/RAG (Azure OpenAI & OpenAI SDKs, prompt design, tool-use/function calling, token management); vector search (Azure AI Search or Pinecone); and LLM evaluation (eval sets, automated scoring, regression checks).
  • Sound judgment on model selection across providers, balancing quality, latency, and cost.
  • Working familiarity with several of the following (not all required): Python; agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel); MongoDB/SQL Server; Azure platform (Blob Storage, Entra ID); observability (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry); data ingestion (PDF/Excel/CSV parsing, Azure Document Intelligence); Docker & Azure DevOps; Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Strong analytical mindset, clear communication, a collaborative attitude, and the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with enterprise software architecture, Agile delivery, and chatbot products.

Assets:

  • Experience with Octopus Deploy or similar deployment tools.
  • Prior work on multimodal RAG pipelines (text + image).
  • Exposure to MLOps (MLflow, DVC, Terraform).
  • Knowledge of member-services or health-care portals.

*Note: Given the rapid emergence of Large Language Models, we prioritize demonstrated success in shipping GenAI products to production and strong software fundamentals over total years of experience in this specific domain.


Intermediate knowledge of English is required because you will on a regular basis interact in English with external parties (clients, suppliers, candidates, external partners, etc.); interact in English with internal parties (colleagues, internal partners, stakeholders, etc.); and work with IT tools whose interface is only accessible in English as part of this position's main responsibilities given its international scope.

A bit about us

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. We improve lives through our technology solutions and foster a culture of innovation that empowers team members to solve complex problems and create remarkable human outcomes in a digital world.

TELUS is proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to fair employment practices and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities, as required, during the recruitment process.

Disclaimer: In accordance with the TELUS Health Solutions Data Center Security Policy, as a condition of employment, all team members whose job functions require they work at a Data Center and/or have access to detailed knowledge of technology related to client service delivery, are subject to a Personnel Security Screening conducted through the Government of Canada.

Note for Quebec candidates: if knowledge of English is required for this position, it is because the team member will be asked, on a regular basis, to interact in English with external or internal parties or to use English applications or software as part of their tasks.

By applying to this role, you understand and agree that your information will be shared with the TELUS Group of Companies’ Talent Acquisition team(s) and/or any leader(s) who will be part of the selection process.

Director Business Portfolio- In Vivo

About the role

JAX is looking for a commercial leader to take charge of our In Vivo business unit, part of the JMCRS Portfolio organization. You will bring JAX mouse models, preclinical services, and cohort and breeding services together on one commercial and operational backbone, with full ownership of the P&L, revenue and product lines.

This is a role for someone who has run a large, multi-product business, loves developing product managers, and gets energized by turning scientific capability into customer growth. You will set the direction for how In Vivo delivers, partner with Portfolio Innovation to bring new products and services to market, and connect In Vivo with the broader JAX portfolio so customers get one seamless experience.

This role is remote with travel as needed - 30% of the time, including internationally

What you'll do

  • Own the In Vivo P&L. Be accountable for revenue, gross margin and operating margin, and deliver growth targets across mouse models, preclinical services and cohort services.
  • Set the strategy. Define the In Vivo business strategy and annual operating plans with Product and Operations leads, and drive execution through Marketing & Sales, Operations and Delivery.
  • Lead and grow a team. Coach and develop Product Managers and Product Operations leads, building product management capability, clear accountabilities and a consistent operating rhythm.
  • Shape pricing. Own pricing strategy for the unit, including the annual price adjustment cycle, deal and discount governance, and international pricing inputs in partnership with Finance.
  • Forecast with confidence. Own the In Vivo demand forecast and provide accurate inputs for production planning, capacity management and long-range strategic planning.
  • Extend our reach. Working with Channel management, define the channel strategy, including distributors and partner models that expand JAX's presence in priority global regions.
  • Grow the portfolio. Increase market share for current offerings and, with Portfolio Innovation, bring forward new products, services and markets that build on JAX's core competencies.
  • Stay close to customers. Engage directly with customers to sharpen JAX's competitive position, and propose and implement changes that improve their experience.
  • Manage by the numbers. Track performance against KPIs and make data-driven recommendations to optimize growth and profitability.

What you bring

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business, Economics or Marketing, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Master’s degree,MBA or advanced scientific degree is preferred
  • 10 years of relevant experience, 12 years preferred
  • 7 years of supervisory experience, 9 years preferred
  • Demonstrated success running a large, multi-product P&L with full accountability for revenue, margin and growth
  • Proven experience leading, developing and scaling teams of product managers
  • Strong financial acumen across forecasting, budgeting, pricing, margin management and business-case development
  • Exceptional interpersonal and influencing skills across cultures, disciplines and organizational levels

  • Experience shaping channel strategy, distribution partnerships, or CRO and licensing partnerships, including in international markets is preferred
  • Ability to travel up to 30% of the time, including internationally

The salary range for this position is $157,563–$228,467, based on years of related experience and internal equity considerations.


About JAX:

The Jackson Laboratory is an independent, nonprofit biomedical research institution with a National Cancer Institute-designated Cancer Center and nearly 3,000 employees in locations across the United States (Maine, Connecticut, California, New York, Florida), Japan and China. Its mission is to discover precise genomic solutions for disease and empower the global biomedical community in the shared quest to improve human health.


Founded in 1929, JAX applies over nine decades of expertise in genetics to increase understanding of human disease, advancing treatments and cures for cancer, neurological and immune disorders, diabetes, aging and heart disease. As part of our team, you’ll make an immediate, measurable impact on Safeguarding everyday essentials. You’ll also belong to a respectful and collaborative community that fosters career growth and professional development. You’ll be supported by resources that make a positive difference in your life because, at Videojet, we value your authenticity and want your talents to shine.

About the role:

Videojet North America is seeking a Software Sales Manager to lead growth for Velicity, Videojet’s next-generation cloud-based software solution with ERP integration capabilities. This role is accountable for owning Velicity software sales performance and achieving NA revenue targets. The Software Sales Manager will build and scale the Velicity sales function - developing the sales team, establishing and documenting repeatable commercial processes, and leading the Solution Architect function to increase win rates that enable successful delivery of the project statement of work.

Reporting line and key partnerships

•Reports to: VP Commercial, NA

  • Leads: Velicity Software Sales Team and Solution Architects (to be built)
  • Partners closely with: Field Sales (Territory/Key Account teams), Strategic Account Team, Marketing, Product Management, Project Management (Implementation), Technical Support, Finance/Pricing, and Customer Care

Key Responsibilities:

Sales ownership and revenue accountability

  • Own NA Velicity revenue results, including pipeline creation, conversion, and attainment of quarterly/annual sales targets.
  • Drive disciplined execution of the end-to-end sales process: qualification, discovery, value-based solution selling, competitive positioning, proposal/SOW development, negotiation, and closing.
  • Establish operating cadence for forecasting, pipeline reviews, deal strategy, and win/loss analysis, renewals, upgrades, and ensuring strong CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.

Partnership with field sales and funnel development

  • Build strong trust and credibility with the field sales team to enable joint account planning and consistent funnel development and management practices.

Team buildout and talent development

  • Coach sellers and field sales on discovery, value messaging, competitive differentiation, and deal execution, especially for SaaS + integration-led sales cycles.
  • Build a bench of talent through structured onboarding, playbooks, coaching routines, and performance management.

Lead the Solution Architect function

  • Manage and develop the Solution Architect team, ensuring strong technical selling capabilities, discovery-to-solutioning execution, technical validation, and customer confidence.
  • Implement “quality gates” for technical discovery, integration feasibility, and risk identification to reduce late-stage deal friction.
  • Align Solution Architect activities to commercial priorities: Annual Recurring Revenue, equipment pull through, objection handling, demo/POV strategy, and delivery readiness for a configurable, productized solution.

Commercial process, SOW ownership, and professional services pricing

  • Own commercial packaging standards for Velicity opportunities, including:

oSubscriptions, implementation/professional services and premium support packaging

oscope definition, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance approach

odelivery readiness criteria and handoff success (Sales → Implementation)

oidentifying, pricing and managing upgrades, upsells and renewals

  • Lead a team of Solution Architects who own the development and pricing of SOWs and associated professional services, including sizing/effort estimation, milestone and billing structure, and change control posture in partnership with Project Management and Tech Support.
  • Support and/or lead responses to RFI/RFPs and customer security/IT questionnaires, ensuring consistent solution positioning and delivery approach.

Cross-functional alignment and scalable GTM execution

  • Partner with Implementation Project Managers, equipment sales and enablement teams, and Tech Support to ensure clean transitions from Closed Won through go-live readiness, minimizing delivery risk caused by unclear scope.
  • Provide feedback loops to Product and Engineering on recurring objections, integration patterns, feature gaps, and enablement needs.
  • Drive standard work: account planning templates, discovery guides, proposal/SOW templates, pricing guardrails, competitive battlecards, product demos and ROI/value tools.
  • Develop and scale third-party partnerships (e.g., ERP providers, middleware/integration partners, and complementary SaaS vendors) to generate pipeline, expand Velicity’s integration ecosystem, and accelerate sales through co-selling and referral motions.
  • Travel: Up to 50%+ to customer sites and field sales engagements, as needed

What success looks like (12–18 months)

  • Predictable pipeline generation and attainment of Velicity sales targets with improving win rate and sales cycle time.
  • Strong field sales engagement: consistent co-selling, shared account plans, and increased funnel sourced or influenced with field sellers.
  • A scaled team with clear coverage model, repeatable processes, and a developed bench of talent.
  • High-quality SOWs and services pricing discipline that improves delivery outcomes and reduces change-order friction.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of B2B software sales experience, including 3+ years of people leadership (sales management and coaching).
  • Demonstrated success selling SaaS/software solutions with multi-stakeholder buying cycles (IT + Operations + Procurement).
  • Proven ability to build pipeline and improve funnel performance through disciplined operating rhythms and data-driven management.
  • Experience leading or partnering closely with Solution Architects / presales to secure technical wins and manage customer objections.
  • Strong executive communication skills and ability to lead complex pursuits with internal and customer stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience with ERP or enterprise integration concepts (APIs, file-based interfaces, middleware/iPaaS patterns).
  • Familiarity with professional services packaging: scope definition, assumptions, milestones, acceptance criteria, and change control.
  • Experience in manufacturing/packaging/plant environments or adjacent operational technology ecosystems.

Core competencies

  • Sales leadership & accountability: owns outcomes; drives execution and performance rigor.
  • Credible field partner: builds trust with field sales; enables co-selling and account traction.
  • Commercial discipline: scopes clearly, prices responsibly, and protects delivery outcomes.

raw.description:
Job Description

This role is 40 hours/week, fully remote and must be located within one of the contiguous 50 states. You must be able and willing to work Monday-Friday 8-hour shifts per week 8am-5pm MST/PST preferred, but willing to consider EST/CST working hours.

About Responsive Care:

Responsive Care is a cornerstone of the company's care model, designed to meet members where they are — through digital-first, highly accessible, and thoughtfully coordinated care. Our Everyday Care APPs operate at the intersection of clinical excellence, innovation, and technology, ensuring members receive the right care at the right time, in the right way. We bridge the gap between chronic disease management and acute care needs, supporting members across various teams throughout the company.

A bit about this role:

This position represents an amazing opportunity for an Advanced Practice Provider ( NP or PA) with a big heart and entrepreneurial spirit who is passionate about chronic disease management.

EDC, an integral part of Responsive Care, is the company's centralized hub for ongoing clinical management — a model built on a collaborative, shared patient management relationship with our members' primary care providers. In this role, you will work alongside a cross-functional team to deliver innovative care across Digital and traditional platforms.

You will serve as a member of our ONE PCP team, as a prescriber of centralized prescription renewals and refills and also you will manage centralized results.

You will utilize and help improve our home-grown technology and electronic health information platform to carry out virtual visits as well as managing asynchronous prescription refills for patients.

Required skills and experience:

  • APP with three or more years working in outpatient clinical practice ideally with experience in management of hypertension, hyperlipidemia and primary and secondary prevention of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience concentrated in primary care or a subspecialty with heavy focus on hypertension and lipid management required (e.g. cardiology, nephrology, neurology, endocrinology, primary care, urgent care).

Licensure and certification

  • For Nurse Practitioners: active and in-good-standing RN and APRN licenses.

  • For Physician Assistants: an active and in-good-standing Physician Assistant license.

  • Role licensure and certification in good standing is required and the ability to get licensed in requested states within 90 days of hire date, starting at offer letter signing. You will be required to get licensed in additional states as needed. We believe in making it easy for you to focus on patient care. Devoted Health will cover all costs and provide full administrative support for obtaining and maintaining licenses in all required states.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Skilled APP with thorough understanding of cardiometabolic condition management including disease process, treatment modalities, medication management and lifestyle modification as it pertains to hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and primary care management of coronary artery disease and diabetes.

  • Comfortable working across Digital (live portal chat) and emerging AI-powered clinical tools (e.g., prescribing support and triage agents) as an active participant in testing, feedback, and iterative improvement — not just as an end user.

  • Virtual care experience is preferred along with a strong desire to continue practicing clinical nursing and performing virtual visits - you believe in the mission of bringing care to where the patient lives.

  • STARS/HEDIS measures, code clinical comorbidities, and identify clinical care gaps.

  • Experience with or strong interest in centralized results management, live digital/chat-based patient engagement, and AI-enabled clinical workflows is a plus.

  • Proficiency in English and Spanish preferred for this position.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Conduct focused and thorough assessments of patients with conditions that impact chronic health including hypertension, hyperlipidemia, coronary artery disease, and diabetes who are running out of medications. We expect that 40-60% of your clinical effort will be performing virtual visits.

  • Formulate accurate diagnoses and develop individualized treatment plans for patients with chronic medical conditions, including medication management, lifestyle modifications, and monitoring recommendations.

  • Manage a refill inbox for patients with chronic health conditions in accordance with established protocols and guidelines. We expect that 40-60% of your clinical effort will be spent managing a prescription refill queue.

  • Participate in centralized results management workflows, ensuring timely review, triage, and follow-up on lab and diagnostic results across the patient panel in accordance with established risk-tiering protocols.

  • Leverage Digital (live portal chat) and AI-assisted clinical tools — including agent-supported prescribing and inbox triage workflows — to improve efficiency, consistency, and safety in medication renewal, results management, and patient communication, while providing clinician feedback to help refine these tools as they evolve.

  • Identify and evaluate risk factors, comorbidities and possible contraindications for treatment.

  • Provide counseling on medication adherence, potential side effects.

  • Collaborate closely with a cross-functional care team — including PCPs, specialists, and other the company team members such as pharmacy, clinical nursing, and social work — as well as interfacing with family members and caregivers as needed to coordinate holistic care for the member, to ensure continuity of care and deliver a collaborative care plan.

  • Utilize our home grown electronic health information system for visits while also providing feedback on how to improve the interface.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient medical records, ensuring compliance with relevant legal and ethical guidelines.

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and ongoing professional development to stay current on best practices and advancements in cardiometabolic care.

  • Adhere to all relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards, including patient privacy and telehealth regulations.

Salary Range:$120K-155K base range plus performance based bonus paid out quarterly or annually ($10K-$20K) for a total comp range of $130K-170K

Employer-sponsored health insurance and dental and vision plan with low or no premium

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

raw.excerpt: As a forward-deployed engineer, you’ll work on-site with customers — writing code, integrating systems, and solving hard problems in the field.
raw.description:
As a forward-deployed engineer, you’ll work on-site with customers — writing code, integrating systems, and solving hard problems in the field. You’re part engineer, part technical advisor, and wholly accountable for making the mission succeed. The position requires a current or active U.S. TS/SCI clearance.

Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure.

Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success.

What you’ll do

We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include:

  • Design and implement cloud architecture.

  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi.

  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines.

  • Continuously deploy to AWS cloud and air-gapped environments.

  • Monitor applications/services with OpenTelemetry, Sentry, and SigNoz.

  • Enforce CMMC compliance policies and rules.

  • Manage secrets and configuration.

  • Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure within customer and air-gapped environments.

  • Support RHEL/Linux-based platforms using Kubernetes, Podman, Docker, and Helm in operational environments.

  • Partner directly with customer engineering teams to integrate, test, and resolve infrastructure issues.

  • Travel to customer sites as needed to support deployments, upgrades, and mission execution.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with strong Software Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

  • You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage.

  • You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build.

  • You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed.

  • You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding.

  • You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

  • You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited.

Why work with us

  • We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished.

  • Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

  • We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

  • We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

  • We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

  • We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Important skills

  • Expert in Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi or Terraform.

  • Expert in Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Linux system administration, and Podman.

  • Experience deploying and managing containerized environments using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Podman.

  • Expert in CI/CD and DevSecOps, including GitLab CI/CD and GitHub Actions.

  • Proficiency in AWS and/or other cloud services.

  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, Go, or TypeScript.

  • Proficiency with networking.

  • Familiar with cybersecurity compliance frameworks like CMMC, PCI, or SOC.

  • Familiar with Single Sign-on and Identity Providers (IdP) like Authentik and Keycloak.

  • Experience deploying to air-gapped environments.

  • Experience self-hosting on bare metal servers.

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting classified DoD or Navy environments.

  • Experience deploying infrastructure to air-gapped environments.

  • Familiarity with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Sentry, or SigNoz.

  • Experience supporting edge computing, maritime systems, or sensor platforms.

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other secure cloud environments.

  • Experience working directly with government customers in operational environments.

What we offer

  • Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first.

  • Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected.

  • 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones.

  • Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

  • Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter.

  • Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact.

  • Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future.

Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI:

  • 401(k) with company match.

  • Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent).

  • Relocation assistance (position dependent).

  • Referral bonuses.

  • Performance bonuses.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Technology home office setup stipend.

  • Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent).

We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Principal Software Development Engineer is a hands-on technical architect responsible for designing, building, and supporting complex ServiceNow data and integration solutions. The role ensures ServiceNow has trusted customer, account, service, product, location, contract, entitlement, configuration-item, install-base, and sold-product data required to support Enterprise and Public Sector customer-service and ticketing workflows.

This engineer translates business and architecture requirements into scalable ServiceNow data models, APIs, ingestion pipelines, and reusable integration patterns. The role works across ServiceNow, enterprise data platforms, API gateways, messaging platforms, databases, and cloud services, while providing technical leadership for data quality, integration reliability, security, and maintainability.

Location

This is a work from home position within the US.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, build, and maintain ServiceNow foundational data and integrations for customer, account, service, product, location, contract, entitlement, configuration-item, Install Base Item, and Sold Product data.
  • Govern ServiceNow CMDB- and CSDM-aligned data models, including CI classes and relationships, identification and reconciliation rules, source keys, normalization, deduplication, data quality, authoritative sources, source-to-target mappings, lineage, ownership, reconciliation, and sustainable target-state interfaces.
  • Build scalable inbound, outbound, and bi-directional integrations using Scripted REST APIs, REST Messages, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, Data Sources, Import Sets, Transform Maps, IRE APIs, JDBC, JSON, and scheduled or event-driven processing. Connect ServiceNow and external ServiceNow instances with Palantir Foundry, Data Hubs/Databricks, Apigee, Kafka, databases, inventory platforms, and other enterprise systems through secure, reusable patterns.
  • Use complex SQL across enterprise systems and data platforms to profile data, identify authoritative records and relationships, verify completeness and quality, find duplicates and gaps, and determine foundational data for ServiceNow. Review production data flows and large data sets for record counts, duplicates, completeness, mappings, performance, pagination, batching, timeouts, and incremental-load behavior.
  • Design and maintain ServiceNow eBonding and B2B integrations, including ticket or case synchronization, correlation identifiers, field and choice mappings, comments, attachments, priorities, authentication, customer onboarding, UAT, cutover, and production support. Develop secure API and connectivity patterns using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, client credentials, Application Registries, role-based service accounts, secrets management, firewall rules, and access governance.
  • Establish integration observability, persistent processing records, error handling, retries, replay and recovery, dashboards, runbooks, and support procedures. Lead root-cause analysis of complex issues across ServiceNow, APIs, MID Servers, data platforms, databases, authentication, networks, and upstream or downstream systems.
  • Provide technical leadership through architecture decisions, design and code reviews, production-readiness assessments, mentoring, stakeholder workshops, solution documentation, and hands-on delivery of the most complex work. Ensure development, test, and production solutions meet enterprise security, data governance, compliance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability standards.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 10+ years in software engineering, enterprise integration, data engineering, or solution architecture, including 7+ years delivering advanced ServiceNow development and integrations. Hands-on expertise in server-side JavaScript, Script Includes, Business Rules, scoped applications, RESTMessageV2, Scripted REST APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, Import Sets, Transform Maps, debugging, logging, and production support.
  • In-depth ServiceNow CMDB and CSDM expertise: CI modeling and relationships; Identification Rules; the Identification and Reconciliation Engine; reconciliation, deduplication, and data-quality governance. Experience modeling and integrating customer, account, service, product, location, contract, entitlement, inventory, Install Base Item, and Sold Product data for CSM, ITSM, and customer-facing workflows.
  • Integration expertise in REST, JSON, JDBC, pub/sub and queueing patterns, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, API gateways such as Apigee, Kafka, secrets management, and secure service-account design.
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms and pipelines, including Palantir Foundry, Data Hubs, Databricks, SQL databases, ETL/ELT, source-to-target mapping, validation, reconciliation, and lineage.
  • Advanced SQL skills include complex joins, aggregations, common table expressions, window functions, data profiling, reconciliation, duplicate detection, and large-data-set analysis for ServiceNow foundational-data decisions.
  • Success developing resilient, high-volume integrations using pagination, throttling, batching, retries, resumability, observability, and performance optimization.
  • Experience delivering ServiceNow-to-ServiceNow or external-platform eBonding and customer onboarding, as well as field-mapping workshops, UAT, go-live, and production support.
  • Ability to assess architectural risks before implementation and build reusable frameworks rather than one-off integrations.
  • Strong production troubleshooting, technical documentation, mentoring, cross-functional leadership, and communication skills.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain applicable Public Trust suitability and authorized access for assigned GSA, USDA, USPS, DOI, or other Public Sector environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ServiceNow Customer Service Management, IT Service Management, Service Bridge or ShareLogic Unifi, and telecommunications customer or service data.
    Experience delivering ServiceNow data and integration solutions in FedRAMP-authorized or other regulated environments.

Role Title: AI Product Tester (Consumer Safety & Security)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: United States (Remote)

micro1 is engaging AI Product Testers (Consumer Safety & Security) to take part in an exciting AI-driven project for a valued customer. In this role, you’ll test leading AI assistants on everyday personal cybersecurity tasks and help shape how these systems guide real people through real problems. No prior AI experience is required. Your attention to detail and everyday digital know-how are what matter.

Scope of Work

  1. Evaluate multiple AI assistants side by side on personal cybersecurity tasks such as password security, scam detection, identity theft recovery and removing personal information from people-search sites.

  1. Must be based in the United States.
  2. Regular user of AI chatbots (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot).
  3. Excellent written English, with the ability to give detailed, structured and actionable feedback.
  4. Experience in QA, product testing or AI evaluation (AI rating/RLHF) is a strong plus.
  5. Personal experience dealing with scams, identity theft or removing personal information from people-search sites is a plus.
  6. Available for at least 10 hours per week, with strong time management and an organized, detail-oriented approach.

Job Description


The Director of Operations & Risk Management is a senior leader who owns dealer and inventory operations for the Autotrader Consumer Marketplace. The Director champions the dealer perspective throughout strategy development and execution, ensuring that dealer impact, feasibility, and risk are weighed in the decisions that shape the marketplace. This leader also owns the commercial relationships, partner economics, and contracts for the vendor relationships required to enable Consumer Marketplace success.

The Director builds a repeatable system for turning dealer needs, feedback, and root causes into global standards, audits, and policy. This leader translates dealer group client needs into product and commercialization requirements, shapes market and sales positioning, and carries thought leadership with dealers and partners. The Director brings dealer and risk insight to marketplace health strategy and day-to-day execution, working closely with the Business Readiness and Strategic Planning leaders.

The Director protects the marketplace by working with boundary partners to own billing, legal, regulatory, compliance, consent, pricing transparency, and brand risk for the business. This includes leading the Consumer brand management and fraud team. This role requires close partnership with Legal, Compliance, Sales, Product, and Client Services, and serves as a trusted advisor to executives on dealer sentiment, risk, and commercial exposure.


*Atlanta is the preferred location but can be remote anywhere in the USA.*


Primary Duties and Responsibilities:


Dealer Escalation & Marketplace Operations

  • Own key client escalation and mitigation across all segments, with primary ownership for dealer and public groups and their vendors.
  • Convert escalation root causes into global standards and audits, turning firefighting into policy.
  • Oversee dealer and inventory operations, including accounts, listings, and billing and invoicing optimization and management.
  • Own market and sales positioning, including Voice of Field and nVision access and user agreements.

Dealer Relationships & Commercial Strategy

  • Own senior relationships with dealer and public group leadership and their vendors.
  • Lead vendor and partner economics and negotiation for dealer clients (e.g., Experian), with strong fluency in vendor contract and payment/breach terms and the ability to build strategic options.
  • Coordinate vendor work with Legal on terms, exposure, and exit paths.
  • Translate dealer group client needs into product and commercialization requirements.
  • Coordinate RFI responses with solution design, applicable SMEs, and account teams.
  • Lead vendor and partnership development, including thought leadership that positions Autotrader with dealers and partners.

Risk, Legal, Regulatory & Brand

  • Own legal, regulatory, consent, pricing transparency, and compliance management, partnering with Legal and Compliance.
  • Own brand, regulatory, and enterprise risk management, and lead the Consumer brand management and fraud team.
  • Embed compliance and risk requirements into launches and marketplace changes in partnership with Business Readiness.

Dealer Voice in Strategy & Execution

  • Champion the dealer perspective throughout strategy development and execution, bringing dealer impact, feasibility, and risk into portfolio, product, and growth decisions.
  • Maintain competitive intelligence with field and dealer input and share it with Strategic Planning and Product.
  • Contribute dealer insight to marketplace health strategy and day-to-day marketplace execution, working with the Business Readiness & Execution and Strategic Planning leaders.

Cross-Functional Influence & Executive Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executives, offering data-driven insights on dealer sentiment, risk, and commercial exposure that balance speed, quality, and adoption.
  • Represent dealer, operations, and risk perspectives in cross-enterprise forums, shaping portfolio priorities, funding, and resourcing decisions.
  • Partner with boundary organizations (Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Client Services, Legal) to resolve dealer issues and align on standards and policy.
  • Represent Autotrader and Consumer Marketplace capabilities as a thought leader to dealer groups, industry partners, and automotive media.

Capability Building & Team Leadership

  • Build and mentor a high-performing team that blends dealer operations, risk management, process optimization, and data literacy.
  • Establish success metrics for escalation resolution, repeat-issue reduction, and dealer satisfaction.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning through retrospectives, performance insights, and knowledge-sharing across teams.

Financial & Vendor Management

raw.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Segment Manager Industries

In this role you will focus on building a high-quality sales pipeline, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving revenue growth by positioning ABB as a key enabler of flexible, safe, and scalable automation.

The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical knowledge, business development acumen, and field sales expertise in collaborative robotics or industrial automation. You will be instrumental in expanding ABB’s footprint in small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) as well as large manufacturers.

You will be instrumental in expanding the customer base and driving spec position of ABB robots and ABB Function Packages in General Industries based applications. These include welding and metal finishing, machine tending, assembly, 3D printing, vision supported applications and more - all within the broad General Industries space. Focused industries include Aerospace, Metal Finishing, Construction, Data Centers, Defense, and more.

Role can be based remotely, in the North Western US. Preferred location of candidates will be near major airports and transportation hubs such as Portland, Seattle or Las Vegas

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute a strategic go-to-market plan to grow ABB’s pipeline and convert opportunities into sales.
  • Identify and engage with potential end users, system integrators, machine builders, and channel partners to promote ABB’s collaborative robot portfolio in the industrial and consumer electronics areas.
  • Collaborate closely with ABB’s robotics channel partners and territory sales teams to support robotics opportunity development and qualification, and conduct technical discovery sessions and product demonstrations to showcase robotics capabilities and value propositions.
  • Partner with marketing to implement targeted campaigns, regional events, and webinars to raise awareness of ABB's offerings, and represent ABB at industry trade shows, expos, and automation events to increase ABB Robotics visibility and market share.
  • Provide voice-of-customer feedback to global product management and engineering teams to support portfolio evolution, and maintain deep knowledge of competitive offerings and industry trends in all robotics.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mechatronics, Business, or related field, and 8+ years of experience in sales or business development within industrial automation, robotics, or collaborative robotics; or other combination of degree and work experience, i.e. Associate's degree and 10+ years.
  • Deep experience and knowledge in environments core to the Electronics Industries manufacturing and production environments
  • Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools to manage a sales pipeline.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% within the U.S. and a focus within your specified territory
  • Strong understanding of robotic applications used in the Electronics Industry applications (assembly, picking, packing, palletizing, mobile robotics) desired.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to communicate value-based selling strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences desired.
  • Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

What's in it for you

We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward

raw.excerpt: We Go Beyond: At Bed Bath & Beyond, we believe that everyone should “Be You!
raw.description:
We Go Beyond:

At Bed Bath & Beyond, we believe that everyone should “Be You!”. Bed Bath & Beyond is a community that upholds a culture of understanding, acceptance, and respect. We believe a person’s individuality is at the core of diversity, and those traits, beliefs, and characteristics should be valued and embraced. Living by this ethos is essential to the success of our business. Our goal is to foster a more diverse environment where every employee visibly demonstrates inclusive behaviors and respect for individuals.

The Accounts Receivable Cash Accountant is part of the Shared Services Accounting team and is responsible for recording, applying, and reconciling cash receipts across stores and eCommerce. This role manages daily cash application and bank and credit card reconciliations, and supports an accurate and timely month-end close. The Cash Accountant works closely with Treasury, Accounts Payable, Merchandising, and the general ledger team.


Job Responsibilities

    • Record and apply daily cash receipts, including store deposits and eCommerce settlements
    • Reconcile store deposits to sales audit and bank activity; research and resolve deposit shortages and overages
    • Reconcile credit card, debit card, and third-party payment processor settlements (e.g., Adyen, PayPal, Shopify) to sales and bank deposits
    • Monitor accounts receivable aging and follow up with vendors and internal departments on past-due balances
    • Research and resolve unapplied cash, payment disputes, and customer or vendor inquiries
    • Prepare monthly bank reconciliations and cash-related journal entries
    • Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations for cash, accounts receivable, and related clearing accounts
    • Support credit card chargeback processing and gift card cash reconciliations
    • Assist with unclaimed property (escheat) reporting for uncashed checks and credit balances
    • Support month-end close deliverables accurately and on time
    • Provide support for internal and external audit requests
    • Provide accounting support for ad hoc requests and new business activities
    • Perform other duties as assigned
    • Adhere to company policies and internal controls

Job Requirements

    • Intermediate knowledge of U.S. GAAP
    • Intermediate knowledge of Oracle accounting software (Oracle E-Business Suite)
    • 2-4 years accounting experience, with a focus on cash application, accounts receivable, or bank reconciliations
    • Retail or multi-location accounting experience preferred
    • Experience with high-volume transactions and credit card settlement reconciliations preferred

Skills

    • Proficient in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables)
    • Experience with online banking platforms
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
    • Strong attention to detail with the ability to meet tight deadlines
    • Effective communication skills with vendors and internal teams

Education

    • BA/BS in Accounting or related field

Location: Salt Lake City or Remote

Physical Requirements:

This position requires you to sit, stand and perform general office functions. You may also be required to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally. Bending, stooping and reaching are also frequently required.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and associates.  This policy includes our commitment to ensure that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, pregnancy, veteran status (including Vietnam era veterans), age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other non-job-related characteristic protected by law.
